    function _staffFindUnityPath(path) {
        // GameObject.Find resolves the active root. Subsequent exact child
        // traversal also resolves inactive descendants, which is required for
        // the outside PATH before Open Staff enables it.
        try {
            const parts = path.split("/");
            if (!parts.length) return null;
            let current = GameObject.method("Find", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(parts[0]));
            if (!unityAlive(current)) return null;
            for (let i = 1; i < parts.length; i++) {
                current = _staffImmediateChildNamed(current, parts[i]);
                if (!unityAlive(current)) return null;
            }
            return current;
        } catch (e) {
            ARC.warnOnce("staff-path:" + path, "Open Staff Unity path failed: " + path + " :: " + e);
            return null;
        }
    }
    function _staffComponent(go, componentClass) {
        if (!unityAlive(go)) return null;
        try { return getComponent(go, componentClass); }
        catch (_) { return null; }
    }
    function _staffTargetsAlive() {
        const required = [
            _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "mirror"),
            _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "fish"),
            _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "creator"),
            _staffRuleBehaviours, _staffRuleObjects,
            _staffPathObjects, _staffPathColliders, _staffHiddenRenderers
        ];
        return required.every(list => list.length > 0 && list.every(x => unityAlive(x.object)));
    }
    function _discoverOpenStaffTargets() {
        // Keep surviving entries (and their original state snapshots) while
        // dropping scene objects destroyed during a map transition.
        _staffBarrierColliders = _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));
        _staffRuleBehaviours = _staffRuleBehaviours.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));
        _staffRuleObjects = _staffRuleObjects.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));
        _staffPathObjects = _staffPathObjects.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));
        _staffPathColliders = _staffPathColliders.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));
        _staffHiddenRenderers = _staffHiddenRenderers.filter(x => unityAlive(x.object));

        const mirrorFront = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.mirrorFront);
        const ruleOne = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.ruleOne);
        const ruleTwo = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.ruleTwo);
        const pathGo = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.outsidePath);
        const ahPlane = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.creatorPlane);
        const fishTank = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.fishTank);
        const outerGlass = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.fishOuterGlass);
        const innerGlass = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.fishInnerGlass);
        const waterSurface = _staffFindUnityPath(_staffPaths.fishWater);

        const mirrorRoots = unityAlive(mirrorFront) ? 1 : 0;
        const fishRoots = unityAlive(fishTank) ? 1 : 0;
        const pathRoots = unityAlive(pathGo) ? 1 : 0;
        const creatorRoots = unityAlive(ahPlane) ? 1 : 0;
        _staffRemember(_staffBarrierColliders, _staffComponent(mirrorFront, Collider), { area: "mirror" });
        _staffRemember(_staffBarrierColliders, _staffComponent(ahPlane, Collider), { area: "creator" });

        // Only the front plane is opened. The mirror root and the interior
        // `glassss` collider are untouched, so the bottom mirror and mirror
        // interior stay closed. The two rule objects inside this one mirror
        // are separately disabled.
        let ruleCount = 0;
        try {
            if (!_staffRuleClass) _staffRuleClass = AssemblyCSharp.class("youbroketherules");
            for (const ruleGo of [ruleOne, ruleTwo]) {
                if (!unityAlive(ruleGo)) continue;
                ruleCount++;
                _staffRemember(_staffRuleObjects, ruleGo, { area: "rules" });
                _staffRemember(_staffRuleBehaviours,
                    _staffComponent(ruleGo, _staffRuleClass), { area: "rules" });
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("staff-rules", "Open Staff rule paths: " + e); }

        if (unityAlive(pathGo)) {
            _staffRemember(_staffPathObjects, pathGo, { area: "path" });
            _staffRemember(_staffPathColliders, _staffComponent(pathGo, Collider), { area: "path" });
        }

        // Fish: remove only its four blocking surfaces and hide only the two
        // Glass renderers. `OuterGlass (1)` is the water and stays visible.
        for (const target of [fishTank, outerGlass, innerGlass, waterSurface])
            _staffRemember(_staffBarrierColliders, _staffComponent(target, Collider), { area: "fish" });
        for (const target of [outerGlass, innerGlass])
            _staffRemember(_staffHiddenRenderers, _staffComponent(target, Renderer), { area: "fish-glass" });

        _staffHasScan = true;
        _staffRescanAt = _staffTargetsAlive() ? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY : time + 5.0;
        const mirrorCols = _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "mirror").length;
        const fishCols = _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "fish").length;
        const creatorCols = _staffBarrierColliders.filter(x => x.area === "creator").length;
        const state = [mirrorRoots, fishRoots, pathRoots, ruleCount, creatorRoots,
            _staffHiddenRenderers.length].join(":");
        ARC.warnOnce("staff-unity-paths:" + state,
            "Open Staff Unity paths: top-spawn mirror front plane " + mirrorRoots + " target/" + mirrorCols +
            " colliders, fish tank " + fishRoots + " root/" + fishCols +
            " colliders/" + _staffHiddenRenderers.length + " hidden glass renderers, AH creator " +
            creatorRoots + " roots/" + creatorCols + " colliders, rules " + ruleCount +
            ", PATH " + pathRoots);
    }
    function _enforceOpenStaffTargets() {
        for (const entry of _staffPathObjects) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object)) entry.object.method("SetActive").invoke(true); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffPathColliders) {
            try {
                if (!unityAlive(entry.object)) continue;
                entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(true);
                entry.object.method("set_isTrigger").invoke(false);
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffBarrierColliders) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object)) entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffHiddenRenderers) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object)) entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffRuleBehaviours) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object)) entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffRuleObjects) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object)) entry.object.method("SetActive").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
        }
    }
    function _maintainOpenStaff(force = false) {
        if (force || !_staffHasScan || !_staffTargetsAlive() || time >= _staffRescanAt)
            _discoverOpenStaffTargets();
        _enforceOpenStaffTargets();
    }
    function _restoreOpenStaffTargets() {
        // Restore GameObjects before their components, and PATH activity last.
        for (const entry of _staffRuleObjects) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object) && entry.active !== null) entry.object.method("SetActive").invoke(entry.active); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffRuleBehaviours.concat(_staffBarrierColliders, _staffHiddenRenderers)) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object) && entry.enabled !== null) entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(entry.enabled); } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffPathColliders) {
            try {
                if (!unityAlive(entry.object)) continue;
                if (entry.enabled !== null) entry.object.method("set_enabled").invoke(entry.enabled);
                if (entry.isTrigger !== null) entry.object.method("set_isTrigger").invoke(entry.isTrigger);
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        for (const entry of _staffPathObjects) {
            try { if (unityAlive(entry.object) && entry.active !== null) entry.object.method("SetActive").invoke(entry.active); } catch (_) { }
        }
        _staffBarrierColliders = [];
        _staffRuleBehaviours = [];
        _staffRuleObjects = [];
        _staffPathObjects = [];
        _staffPathColliders = [];
        _staffHiddenRenderers = [];
        _staffHasScan = false;
        _staffRescanAt = 0;
    }
    // ======================================================================
    function arrObj(a, i) {
        try {
            const p = arrData(a).add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
            if (!p || p.isNull()) return null;
            return new Il2Cpp.Object(p);
        } catch (_) { return null; }
    }

    // A destroyed UnityEngine.Object keeps a live il2cpp handle, so isNull()
    // reports false and stale references sail through every guard. C#'s
    // `== null` is an operator overload that accounts for destruction.
    function unityAlive(o) {
        if (!o) return false;
        try { if (o.isNull?.()) return false; } catch (_) { return false; }
        try { if (Object.method("op_Equality", 2).invoke(o, ptr(0))) return false; }
        catch (_) { /* operator unavailable - fall through to the probe */ }
        return true;
    }

    // ---- OVRInput thumbsticks (this game's own input path) ----------------
    // Enum constants are read BY NAME so an OVR version bump cannot silently
    // shift them; the hardcoded values are only a fallback.
    let _stickLogged = false;
    let _ovrClass = null, _ovrInit = false;
    let _ovrThumb = 0x01000000, _ovrL = 0x00000001, _ovrR = 0x00000002;
    function _initOvr() {
        if (_ovrInit) return _ovrClass;
        _ovrInit = true;
        let img = null;
        for (const asm of ["Oculus.VR", "Assembly-CSharp", "Assembly-CSharp-firstpass"]) {
            try {
                const i = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image;
                const k = i.class("OVRInput");
                if (k) { _ovrClass = k; img = i; break; }
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        if (!_ovrClass) { console.warn("[Arcane] OVRInput not found; joystick fly disabled"); return null; }
        const readEnum = (nested, name, fallback) => {
            for (const path of ["OVRInput/" + nested, "OVRInput+" + nested, nested]) {
                try {
                    const v = img.class(path).field(name).value;
                    if (typeof v === "number") return v;
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            return fallback;
        };
        _ovrThumb = readEnum("Axis2D", "PrimaryThumbstick", _ovrThumb);
        _ovrL = readEnum("Controller", "LTouch", _ovrL);
        _ovrR = readEnum("Controller", "RTouch", _ovrR);
        console.log("[Arcane] OVRInput ready (thumb=0x" + _ovrThumb.toString(16) +
                    " L=0x" + _ovrL.toString(16) + " R=0x" + _ovrR.toString(16) + ")");
        return _ovrClass;
    }
    // Vector2 comes back as a plain [x, y] array through the bridge here, not
    // as an object with .field() -- handle both.
    // OVRInput.Get has TEN 2-arg overloads (Button, RawButton, Touch,
    // RawTouch, NearTouch, RawNearTouch, Axis1D, RawAxis1D, Axis2D,
    // RawAxis2D). method("Get", 2) picks the FIRST -- Get(Button, Controller),
    // which returns bool. Feeding it an Axis2D constant and reading the result
    // as a Vector2 is what crashed joystick fly. Bind the exact overload.
    let _ovrGet = null;
    function _ovrGetMethod(k) {
        if (_ovrGet) return _ovrGet;
        for (const sig of [["OVRInput.Axis2D", "OVRInput.Controller"],
                           ["OVRInput+Axis2D", "OVRInput+Controller"]]) {
            try { _ovrGet = k.method("Get").overload(sig[0], sig[1]); if (_ovrGet) return _ovrGet; }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        // Last resort: scan for the 2-arg Get that actually returns Vector2.
        try {
            for (const m of k.methods) {
                if (m.name === "Get" && m.parameterCount === 2 &&
                    /Vector2/.test(m.returnType.name)) { _ovrGet = m; return _ovrGet; }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        return null;
    }
    function _ovrStick(right) {
        const k = _initOvr();
        if (!k) return [0, 0];
        try {
            const get = _ovrGetMethod(k);
            if (!get) return [0, 0];
            const v = get.invoke(_ovrThumb, right ? _ovrR : _ovrL);
            if (v == null) return [0, 0];
            if (Array.isArray(v)) return [v[0] || 0, v[1] || 0];
            return [v.field("x").value, v.field("y").value];
        } catch (_) { return [0, 0]; }
    }

    function setMenuTextScale(textTransform, scaleObject, baseScale) {
        try {
            const menuScale = getTransform(scaleObject).method("get_localScale").invoke();
            const sx = Math.abs(menuScale.field("x").value) || 1.0;
            const sy = Math.abs(menuScale.field("y").value) || 1.0;
            const sz = Math.abs(menuScale.field("z").value) || 1.0;
            // Text is rotated (0,90,90): glyph X maps to menu Y, glyph Y maps to
            // menu Z, and glyph depth maps to menu X. Compensate those mapped axes,
            // not the same-numbered local axes, or labels become stretched sideways.
            textTransform.method("set_localScale").invoke([
                -baseScale / sy,
                 baseScale / sz,
                 baseScale / sx
            ]);
        }
        catch (_) {
            try {
                textTransform.method("set_localScale").invoke([-baseScale, baseScale, baseScale]);
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
    }
    function createEmptyObject(name = "", parent = null) {
        let obj = null;
        try {
            obj = GameObject.alloc();
            try {
                obj.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(name));
            }
            catch (_) {
                obj.method(".ctor", 0).invoke();
                try {
                    obj.method("set_name").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(name));
                }
                catch (_) { }
            }
        }
        catch (_) {
            obj = createObject(zeroVector, identityQuaternion, oneVector, 3, [0, 0, 0, 0], parent);
            try {
                const col = getComponent(obj, Collider);
                if (col && !col.isNull())
                    col.method("set_enabled").invoke(false);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            return obj;
        }
        const transform = getTransform(obj);
        if (parent != null)
            transform.method("SetParent", 2).invoke(parent, false);
        return obj;
    }
    // Hardcoded forest entrance (logged in-game and sent by the user). Config load can still override it.
    let forestEntrancePos = [916.42236328125, -506.4110107421875, -475.5328063964844];
    // ---- Menu config saving (toggleable) ----
    // Saves theme + key settings to Documents\arcane_menu\config.json and restores them on load.
    var _configAutoSave = false, _configLoadedOnce = false, _configSaveTimer = 0;
    // === ARCANE FILE PATHS ===
    // Steam/Windows: use the user's real Documents folder. Quest/Android: use the game's writable
    // external persistentDataPath. Keeping this platform-aware makes every feature share the same
    // arcane_menu root without breaking the Quest build.
    var _arcaneRootCached = "";
    function _arcaneRoot() {
        if (_arcaneRootCached) return _arcaneRootCached;
        var root = "/sdcard/Android/data/woosterGames.animalCompany/files/arcane_menu";
        try {
            var App = null, platform = -1;
            try { App = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.CoreModule").image.class("UnityEngine.Application"); } catch (_) { }
            if (!App) { try { App = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine").image.class("UnityEngine.Application"); } catch (_) { } }
            try { if (App) platform = App.method("get_platform").invoke() | 0; } catch (_) { }
            if (platform !== 11) { // RuntimePlatform.Android = 11
                try {
                    var env = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("mscorlib").image.class("System.Environment");
                    var docsObj = env.method("GetFolderPath", 1).invoke(5); // SpecialFolder.MyDocuments
                    var docs = docsObj ? (docsObj.content || docsObj.toString()) : "";
                    if (docs) root = String(docs).replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/+$/, "") + "/arcane_menu";
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            if (platform === 11 || !root) {
                try {
                    var p = App ? App.method("get_persistentDataPath").invoke() : null;
                    var s = p ? (p.content || p.toString()) : null;
                    if (s) root = String(s).replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/+$/, "") + "/arcane_menu";
                } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        _arcaneRootCached = root;
        console.log("[ArcaneFiles] Root: " + root);
        return root;
    }
    // <root>/<sub> with forward slashes, created if missing. sub omitted = the root itself.
    function _arcaneDir(sub) {
        var dir = sub ? (_arcaneRoot() + "/" + String(sub).replace(/\\/g, "/")) : _arcaneRoot();
        try {
            var c = ArcaneFS.getClasses();
            if (!c.dir.method("Exists", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir))) c.dir.method("CreateDirectory", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir));
        } catch (_) { }
        return dir;
    }

    var ArcaneConfig = {
        path: "",
        _resolve: function () {
            if (this.path) return this.path;
            try {
                this.path = _arcaneDir() + "/config.json";   // Quest: persistentDataPath/arcane_menu/config.json
            } catch (_) { }
            return this.path;
        },
        // Read a global safely â€” a missing/renamed/TDZ var returns the fallback instead of throwing.
        // (The old save died with "launchPower is not defined" because ONE bad field in the object
        // literal threw before WriteAllText, so NOTHING ever saved. Every field is now isolated.)
        _get: function (fn, fallback) { try { var v = fn(); return (v === undefined) ? fallback : v; } catch (_) { return fallback; } },
        save: function () {
            try {
                var c = ArcaneFS.getClasses();
                var cfg = {};
                cfg.themeMode          = this._get(function () { return themeMode; }, 11);
                cfg.flySpeed           = this._get(function () { return flySpeed; }, 35);
                cfg.gunLineStyle       = this._get(function () { return gunLineStyle; }, 0);
                cfg.forestEntrancePos  = this._get(function () { return forestEntrancePos; }, null);
                // Legacy inventionUseGoopBalls is intentionally not saved; native StickyAnchors are mandatory.
                cfg.bgColor            = this._get(function () { return bgColor; }, null);
                cfg.textColor          = this._get(function () { return textColor; }, null);
                cfg.buttonColor        = this._get(function () { return buttonColor; }, null);
                cfg.buttonPressedColor = this._get(function () { return buttonPressedColor; }, null);
                // Record which toggle mods are currently ON so they come back after a restart.
                var enabledMods = {};
                try { buttons.flat().forEach(function (b) { if (b && b.isTogglable && b.enabled && b.buttonText) enabledMods[b.buttonText] = true; }); }
                catch (e) { console.error("[Config] collect mods:", e); }
                cfg.enabledMods = enabledMods;
                var json = JSON.stringify(cfg, null, 2);
                c.file.method("WriteAllText", 2).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(this._resolve()), Il2Cpp.string(json));
                return true;
            } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] save:", e); return false; }
        },
        // Apply one field, guarded, so a single bad/renamed field can't abort the whole load.
        _set: function (fn) { try { fn(); } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] apply field:", e); } },
        load: function (restoreEnabledMods = false) {
            try {
                var c = ArcaneFS.getClasses();
                var p = this._resolve();
                if (!c.file.method("Exists", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(p))) return false;
                var raw = c.file.method("ReadAllText", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(p));
                var txt = raw ? (raw.content || raw.toString()) : "";
                if (!txt) return false;
                var cfg;
                try { cfg = JSON.parse(txt); } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] load: corrupt JSON, ignoring:", e); return false; }
                if (!cfg || typeof cfg !== "object") return false;
                var self = this;
                if (typeof cfg.themeMode === "number") self._set(function () { themeMode = cfg.themeMode; });
                if (typeof cfg.flySpeed === "number") self._set(function () { flySpeed = cfg.flySpeed; });
                if (typeof cfg.gunLineStyle === "number") self._set(function () { gunLineStyle = cfg.gunLineStyle; });
                if (Array.isArray(cfg.forestEntrancePos) && cfg.forestEntrancePos.length === 3) self._set(function () { forestEntrancePos = cfg.forestEntrancePos; });
                // Ignore stale inventionUseGoopBalls values from older config files.
                if (Array.isArray(cfg.bgColor)) self._set(function () { bgColor = cfg.bgColor; });
                if (Array.isArray(cfg.textColor)) self._set(function () { textColor = cfg.textColor; });
                if (Array.isArray(cfg.buttonColor)) self._set(function () { buttonColor = cfg.buttonColor; });
                if (Array.isArray(cfg.buttonPressedColor)) self._set(function () { buttonPressedColor = cfg.buttonPressedColor; });
                // Re-enable the toggle mods that were ON when saved (calls each mod's enableMethod once).
                if (restoreEnabledMods && cfg.enabledMods && typeof cfg.enabledMods === "object") {
                    try {
                        buttons.flat().forEach(function (b) {
                            if (!b || !b.isTogglable || !b.buttonText) return;
                            if (cfg.enabledMods[b.buttonText] && !b.enabled) {
                                b.enabled = true;
                                try { if (b.enableMethod) b.enableMethod(); } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] re-enable " + b.buttonText + ":", e); }
                            }
                        });
                    } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] restore mods:", e); }
                }
                return true;
            } catch (e) { console.error("[Config] load:", e); return false; }
        }
    };
    function getLaunchForward(sourceTransform, referenceTransform = null) {
        try {
            const refTf = (referenceTransform && !referenceTransform.isNull?.())
                ? referenceTransform
                : (headCollider && !headCollider.isNull?.() ? getTransform(headCollider) : null);
            const referenceForward = refTf && !refTf.isNull?.()
                ? readVec3Components(refTf.method("get_forward").invoke())
                : [0, 0, 1];
            const cacheKey = normalizeSceneObjectHandle(sourceTransform) || String(sourceTransform);
            const cachedAxis = launchAxisCache.get(cacheKey);
            const readAxis = (axisName) => {
                switch (axisName) {
                    case "forward": return sourceTransform.method("get_forward").invoke();
                    case "-forward": return Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(sourceTransform.method("get_forward").invoke(), -1);
                    case "up": return sourceTransform.method("get_up").invoke();
                    case "-up": return Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(sourceTransform.method("get_up").invoke(), -1);
                    case "right": return sourceTransform.method("get_right").invoke();
                    case "-right": return Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(sourceTransform.method("get_right").invoke(), -1);
                    default: return sourceTransform.method("get_forward").invoke();
                }
            };
            if (cachedAxis) {
                return Vector3.method("Normalize").invoke(readAxis(cachedAxis));
            }
            const candidates = ["forward", "-forward"];
            let bestAxis = "forward";
            let bestScore = -999999;
            for (const axisName of candidates) {
                try {
                    const vec = readAxis(axisName);
                    const v = readVec3Components(vec);
                    const score = (v[0] * referenceForward[0]) + (v[1] * referenceForward[1]) + (v[2] * referenceForward[2]);
                    if (score > bestScore) {
                        bestScore = score;
                        bestAxis = axisName;
                    }
                }
                catch (_) { }
            }
            launchAxisCache.set(cacheKey, bestAxis);
            return Vector3.method("Normalize").invoke(readAxis(bestAxis));
        }
        catch (_) {
            try {
                return sourceTransform.method("get_forward").invoke();
            }
            catch (_) {
                return [0, 0, 1];
            }
        }
    }
// Minimal System.IO class handles. The config saver/loader is the only thing
// that still touches the filesystem now that the goop/import systems are gone.
var ArcaneFS = {
    _classes: null,
    getClasses: function () {
        if (this._classes) return this._classes;
        var mscorlib = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("mscorlib").image;
        this._classes = {
            env:  mscorlib.class("System.Environment"),
            dir:  mscorlib.class("System.IO.Directory"),
            path: mscorlib.class("System.IO.Path"),
            file: mscorlib.class("System.IO.File")
        };
        return this._classes;
    }
};

    function _setNotifTextInPlace(text) {
        try { if (_notifTMP && !_notifTMP.isNull()) { _notifTMP.method("set_text").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(String(text).replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ""))); return true; } } catch (_) { }
        return false;
    }
    function sendNotification(text = "", requiresReload = true, clearTime = 5) {
        if (lowercaseMods && text) text = text.toLowerCase();
        const isOld = (currentNotification == text);
        notifactionResetTime = time + clearTime;
        currentNotification = text;
        if (isOld) return;
        if (_setNotifTextInPlace(text)) return;
        if (requiresReload) reloadMenu();
    }
    let _objCount = 0;
    function createObject(pos = zeroVector, rot = identityQuaternion, scale = oneVector, primitiveType = 3, colorArr = [1, 1, 1, 1], parent = null, enableCollider = false) {
        _objCount++;
        const obj = GameObject.method("CreatePrimitive").invoke(primitiveType);
        const renderer = getComponent(obj, Renderer);
        if (colorArr[3] == 0) {
            renderer.method("set_enabled").invoke(false);
        }
        else {
            const material = renderer.method("get_material").invoke();
            if (UberShader) material.method("set_shader").invoke(UberShader);
            material.method("set_color").invoke(colorArr);
        }
        const col = getComponent(obj, Collider);
        if (col && !col.isNull()) {
            if (enableCollider) {
                col.method("set_enabled").invoke(true);
                col.method("set_isTrigger").invoke(true);
            }
            else {
                col.method("set_isTrigger").invoke(true);
            }
        }
        const transform = getTransform(obj);
        if (parent != null)
            transform.method("SetParent", 2).invoke(parent, false);
        transform.method("set_position").invoke(pos);
        transform.method("set_rotation").invoke(rot);
        transform.method("set_localScale").invoke(scale);
        return obj;
    }
    // Rounded-box renderer copied from the supplied template.  The face lies in local Y/Z and the
    // shallow X dimension remains the interaction depth, so the existing hand and PC raycasts work.
    function templateMixColor(color, multiplier, alpha = null) {
        return [
            Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (color?.[0] ?? 0) * multiplier)),
            Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (color?.[1] ?? 0) * multiplier)),
            Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (color?.[2] ?? 0) * multiplier)),
            alpha == null ? (color?.[3] ?? 1) : alpha
        ];
    }
    function templatePanelColor() {
        return templateMixColor(bgColor, 0.38, Math.max(0.94, bgColor?.[3] ?? 1));
    }
    function templateButtonColor(enabled = false) {
        const source = enabled ? buttonPressedColor : buttonColor;
        return templateMixColor(source, enabled ? 0.96 : 0.72, Math.max(0.94, source?.[3] ?? 1));
    }
    function templateOutlineColor(bright = false) {
        const source = themeAccent || bgColor;
        return templateMixColor(source, bright ? 1.08 : 0.72, 1);
    }
    function getTemplateRoundedBoxMesh(width, height, cornerRadius) {
        try {
            if (!templateRoundedMeshClass) templateRoundedMeshClass = UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.Mesh");
            if (!templateRoundedMeshFilterClass) templateRoundedMeshFilterClass = UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.MeshFilter");
            const normalizedY = Math.max(0.001, Math.min(0.46, cornerRadius / Math.max(width, 0.001)));
            const normalizedZ = Math.max(0.001, Math.min(0.46, cornerRadius / Math.max(height, 0.001)));
            const cacheKey = normalizedY.toFixed(4) + ":" + normalizedZ.toFixed(4);
            const cached = templateRoundedMeshCache.get(cacheKey);
            if (cached) {
                // Two-layer check: the == null operator, then a real call.
                // A destroyed mesh throws MissingReferenceException here,
                // which is catchable -- unlike set_sharedMesh, which would
                // dereference freed memory and take the process with it.
                let usable = false;
                if (unityAlive(cached)) {
                    try { cached.method("get_vertexCount").invoke(); usable = true; } catch (_) { }
                }
                if (usable) return cached;
                try { templateRoundedMeshCache.delete(cacheKey); } catch (_) { }
            }
            const perimeter = [];
            const cornerSegments = 10;
            const corners = [
                [0.5 - normalizedY, 0.5 - normalizedZ, 0, Math.PI * 0.5],
                [-0.5 + normalizedY, 0.5 - normalizedZ, Math.PI * 0.5, Math.PI],
                [-0.5 + normalizedY, -0.5 + normalizedZ, Math.PI, Math.PI * 1.5],
                [0.5 - normalizedY, -0.5 + normalizedZ, Math.PI * 1.5, Math.PI * 2]
            ];
            for (const [centerY, centerZ, startAngle, endAngle] of corners) {
                for (let segment = 0; segment <= cornerSegments; segment++) {
                    const t = segment / cornerSegments;
                    const angle = startAngle + (endAngle - startAngle) * t;
                    perimeter.push([
                        centerY + Math.cos(angle) * normalizedY,
                        centerZ + Math.sin(angle) * normalizedZ
                    ]);
                }
            }
            const vertices = [];
            for (const [y, z] of perimeter) vertices.push([0.5, y, z]);
            for (const [y, z] of perimeter) vertices.push([-0.5, y, z]);
            const ringCount = perimeter.length;
            const frontCenter = vertices.length; vertices.push([0.5, 0, 0]);
            const backCenter = vertices.length; vertices.push([-0.5, 0, 0]);
            const triangles = [];
            for (let index = 0; index < ringCount; index++) {
                const next = (index + 1) % ringCount;
                triangles.push(frontCenter, index, next);
                triangles.push(backCenter, next + ringCount, index + ringCount);
                triangles.push(index, index + ringCount, next + ringCount);
                triangles.push(index, next + ringCount, next);
            }
            // Allocation works; only per-element access is broken, so build
            // the arrays empty and blit the payload in one write each.
            ARC.step("mesh: build " + vertices.length + "v/" + triangles.length + "i key=" + cacheKey);
            const vertexArray = Il2Cpp.array(Vector3, vertices.length);
            const vertBuf = new Float32Array(vertices.length * 3);
            for (let index = 0; index < vertices.length; index++) {
                vertBuf[index * 3] = vertices[index][0];
                vertBuf[index * 3 + 1] = vertices[index][1];
                vertBuf[index * 3 + 2] = vertices[index][2];
            }
            arrData(vertexArray).writeByteArray(vertBuf.buffer);
            const triangleArray = Il2Cpp.array(Il2Cpp.corlib.class("System.Int32"), triangles.length);
            arrData(triangleArray).writeByteArray(new Int32Array(triangles).buffer);
            const mesh = templateRoundedMeshClass.alloc();
            mesh.method(".ctor", 0).invoke();
            mesh.method("set_vertices").invoke(vertexArray);
            mesh.method("set_triangles").invoke(triangleArray);
            mesh.method("RecalculateBounds", 0).invoke();
            mesh.method("RecalculateNormals", 0).invoke();
            // Keep Unity from unloading this procedural mesh when the menu is destroyed on a category
            // switch. UnloadUnusedAssets frees any asset no live GameObject references, so the cached
            // rounded mesh dies and every plate rebuilds with a dead mesh (invisible) while TextMeshPro
            // keeps its own font mesh -> "everything but the text disappears". HideAndDontSave (61)
            // includes DontUnloadUnusedAsset, so the mesh survives every rebuild.
            try { mesh.method("set_hideFlags", 1).invoke(61); } catch (_) { }
            templateRoundedMeshCache.set(cacheKey, mesh);
            return mesh;
        } catch (e) {
            ARC.err("rounded mesh (lastStep=" + ARC.lastStep + ")", e);
            return null;
        }
    }
    function createTemplateRoundedObject(pos, scale, fillColor, outlineColor, parent, interactive = false, outlineSize = 0.008, fillName = "") {
        const createLayer = (center, size, color, keepCollider, cornerRadius, objectName) => {
            const layer = createObject(center, identityQuaternion, size, 3, color, parent, keepCollider);
            try {
                const layerRenderer = getComponent(layer, Renderer);
                const layerMaterial = layerRenderer && !layerRenderer.isNull?.()
                    ? layerRenderer.method("get_sharedMaterial").invoke()
                    : null;
                if (layerMaterial && !layerMaterial.isNull?.()) templateMenuOwnedMaterials.push(layerMaterial);
            } catch (_) { }
            try {
                const layerTransform = getTransform(layer);
                layerTransform.method("set_localPosition").invoke(center);
                layerTransform.method("set_localRotation").invoke(identityQuaternion);
                layerTransform.method("set_localScale").invoke(size);
            } catch (_) { }
            try {
                const filter = getComponent(layer, templateRoundedMeshFilterClass || UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.MeshFilter"));
                const mesh = getTemplateRoundedBoxMesh(size[1], size[2], cornerRadius);
                if (filter && !filter.isNull?.() && mesh && !mesh.isNull?.()) filter.method("set_sharedMesh").invoke(mesh);
            } catch (_) { }
            if (!keepCollider) {
                try { const collider = getComponent(layer, Collider); if (collider && !collider.isNull?.()) Destroy(collider); } catch (_) { }
            }
            if (objectName) { try { layer.method("set_name").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(objectName)); } catch (_) { } }
            return layer;
        };
        const radius = Math.min(Math.min(scale[1], scale[2]) * 0.28, 0.06);
        // Draw the outline as a larger backing mesh with a real depth gap. The menu's visible
        // face is local +X, so moving the backing layer toward -X keeps the two front faces
        // non-coplanar while leaving a rounded rim visible around the fill.
        if (outlineSize > 0) {
            const faceGap = Math.max(0.004, Math.min(0.006, outlineSize * 0.75));
            createLayer(
                [pos[0] - faceGap, pos[1], pos[2]],
                [scale[0], scale[1] + outlineSize * 2, scale[2] + outlineSize * 2],
                outlineColor,
                false,
                radius + outlineSize,
                fillName ? (fillName.replace(/^@/, "") + "__outline") : "TemplateOutline"
            );
        }
        return createLayer(pos, scale, fillColor, interactive, radius, fillName);
    }
    function setRendererColorSafe(obj, color) {
        try {
            if (!obj || obj.isNull?.())
                return;
            const renderer = getComponent(obj, Renderer);
            if (!renderer || renderer.isNull?.())
                return;
            let material = null;
            try { material = renderer.method("get_sharedMaterial").invoke(); }
            catch (_) { material = renderer.method("get_material").invoke(); }
            if (material && !material.isNull?.()) material.method("set_color").invoke(color);
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }
    function setTextColorSafe(obj, color) {
        try {
            if (!obj || obj.isNull?.())
                return;
            try {
                const tmp = getComponent(obj, TextMeshPro3D);
                if (tmp && !tmp.isNull?.()) {
                    try {
                        tmp.method("set_color").invoke(color);
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                    return;
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                const tm = getComponent(obj, TextMesh);
                if (tm && !tm.isNull?.()) {
                    try {
                        tm.method("set_color").invoke(color);
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }
