    function resetTemplateMenuVisualCache() {
        templateMenuThemeFrame = -1;
        updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._menu = null;
        updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._mode = -1;
        updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._transforms = null;
    }
    function updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals() {
        try {
            if (!unityAlive(menu)) {
                resetTemplateMenuVisualCache();
                return;
            }
            const animatedTheme = themeMode >= 0 && themeMode <= 9;
            if (!animatedTheme && !_toggleDirty && updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._menu === menu &&
                updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._mode === themeMode) return;
            _toggleDirty = false;
            try { if (unityAlive(reference)) { const _rr = getComponent(reference, Renderer); if (unityAlive(_rr)) { const _rm = _rr.method("get_material").invoke(); if (_rm && !_rm.isNull()) _rm.method("set_color").invoke(bgColor); } } } catch (_) { }

            if (!updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._tf)
                updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._tf = UnityEngineCore.class("UnityEngine.Transform");
            let transforms = updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._transforms;
            if (!transforms || transforms.isNull?.() || updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._menu !== menu) {
                try {
                    transforms = menu.method("GetComponentsInChildren").overload("System.Type", "System.Boolean")
                        .invoke(updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._tf.type.object, true);
                } catch (_) {
                    transforms = menu.method("GetComponentsInChildren", 1)
                        .inflate(updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._tf).invoke(true);
                }
                updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._transforms = transforms;
            }
            if (!transforms || transforms.isNull?.()) return;
            for (let index = 0; index < transforms.length; index++) {
                try {
                    if (index === 0) ARC.step("theme: recolour " + transforms.length + " objects");
                    const tf = arrObj(transforms, index);
                    if (!tf || tf.isNull?.()) continue;
                    const go = tf.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
                    if (!go || go.isNull?.()) continue;
                    const name = (go.method("get_name").invoke()?.content ?? "").toString();
                    if (name === "MenuBackground") setRendererColorSafe(go, templatePanelColor());
                    else if (name === "TemplateHeader") setRendererColorSafe(go, templateMixColor(bgColor, 0.58, 1));
                    else if (name === "TemplateNotification") setRendererColorSafe(go, templateMixColor(buttonColor, 0.48, 0.98));
                    else if (name === "TemplateSearchBar") setRendererColorSafe(go, templateMixColor(bgColor, 0.28, 0.99));
                    else if (name.endsWith("__outline") || name === "TemplateOutline") {
                        const favoriteOutline = name.startsWith("FAV_") &&
                            favoritedNames.has(name.substring(4, name.length - "__outline".length));
                        // Regular toggle buttons show their ON state with a lit outline, not a darker fill.
                        let enabledOutline = false;
                        if (!favoriteOutline && !name.startsWith("FAV_")) {
                            try { const d = buttonMap.get(name.substring(0, name.length - "__outline".length)); enabledOutline = !!(d && d.enabled); } catch (_) { }
                        }
                        setRendererColorSafe(go, templateOutlineColor(
                            favoriteOutline || enabledOutline || name.startsWith("MenuBackground") || name.startsWith("TemplateHeader")
                        ));
                    }
                    else if (name.startsWith("@FAV_")) {
                        // Favorited state is shown by the outline only, not a darker fill (see __outline above).
                        setRendererColorSafe(go, templateButtonColor(false));
                    }
                    else if (name.startsWith("@")) {
                        const id = name.slice(1);
                        let data = null;
                        try { data = buttonMap.get(id) || null; } catch (_) { }
                        setRendererColorSafe(go, templateButtonColor(false));
                    }
                    else if (name === "MenuText") setTextColorSafe(go, textColor);
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            templateMenuThemeFrame = frameCount;
            updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._menu = menu;
            updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals._mode = themeMode;
        } catch (e) {
            pcLog("template theme update", e);
        }
    }
    function axisDeadzone(value, deadzone = 0.16) {
        return Math.abs(value) < deadzone ? 0 : value;
    }
    function readVec3Components(vec) {
        return [
            vec.field("x").value || 0,
            vec.field("y").value || 0,
            vec.field("z").value || 0
        ];
    }

    function createSolidPlatform(pos, scale = [0.35, 0.03, 0.35], color = [1.0, 0.55, 0.08, 0.9]) {
        const obj = createObject(pos, identityQuaternion, scale, 3, color, null, true);
        try {
            const col = getComponent(obj, Collider);
            if (col && !col.isNull()) {
                col.method("set_enabled").invoke(true);
                col.method("set_isTrigger").invoke(false);
            }
        }
        catch (_) { }
        return obj;
    }
    // TMP_Settings may expose no default font. Grab any loaded TMP_FontAsset
    // instead; element 0 is read raw because Array.get() is unusable here.
    const MENU_FONT_PREFER_OS = false;
    let _legacyMenuTextSupported = null;
    function _canUseLegacyMenuText() {
        // Prefer the exact pre-rasterised TMP face when the bundle is available.
        if (unityAlive(getEmbeddedSegoeTmpFont())) return false;
        if (_legacyMenuTextSupported !== null) return _legacyMenuTextSupported;
        if (!TextMesh) return (_legacyMenuTextSupported = false);
        let probeGo = null;
        try {
            // Validate actual invocation, not just metadata. Some stripped
            // builds retain method records but throw when a setter is called.
            TextMesh.method("set_font", 1);
            TextMesh.method("set_text", 1);
            TextMesh.method("set_fontStyle", 1);
            TextMesh.method("set_richText", 1);
            const font = getMenuSegoeFont();
            if (!unityAlive(font)) throw new Error("embedded/fallback menu Font was not created");
            probeGo = GameObject.alloc();
            probeGo.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string("ArcaneLegacyFontProbe"));
            const probe = addComponent(probeGo, TextMesh);
            probe.method("set_font").invoke(font);
            probe.method("set_richText").invoke(false);
            probe.method("set_text").invoke(Il2Cpp.string("A"));
            const applied = probe.method("get_font").invoke();
            if (!unityAlive(applied)) throw new Error("TextMesh rejected the system Font");
            _legacyMenuTextSupported = true;
            console.log("[menu] menu text -> Segoe UI Bold (legacy TextMesh fallback)");
        } catch (e) {
            _legacyMenuTextSupported = false;
            console.warn("[menu] legacy TextMesh unavailable; using the game's static TMP font: " + e);
        } finally {
            try { if (probeGo && !probeGo.isNull?.()) Object.method("Destroy", 1).invoke(probeGo); } catch (_) { }
        }
        return _legacyMenuTextSupported;
    }
    let _tmpFontCached = null;
    let _osFontTried = false;
    // Animal Company's menu drew with TMP_Settings.defaultFontAsset. Big Scary
    // has that NULL and ships only "Apple2_][ SDF", so the original asset
    // simply is not present to load. The original author's own written
    // fallback -- getMenuSegoeTmpFont(), which the AC build defined but never
    // actually called -- is reproduced here verbatim: getMenuSegoeFont()
    // already carries their exact families ("Segoe UI Black" -> "Segoe UI" ->
    // "Arial") at size 48, wrapped with the same explicit Font overload.
    function _makeOsTmpFont() {
        if (_osFontTried) return null;
        _osFontTried = true;
        try {
            const source = getMenuSegoeFont();
            if (source && !source.isNull?.() && TMPFontAssetClass) {
                const fa = TMPFontAssetClass.method("CreateFontAsset", 1)
                    .overload("UnityEngine.Font")
                    .invoke(source);
                if (fa && !fa.isNull?.()) {
                    // A font asset built this way is DYNAMIC: glyphs are
                    // rasterised into the atlas the first time each character
                    // is drawn. That is why "Themes" flickered, why the "<"
                    // ">" "X" corner labels never appeared, and why opening
                    // Search -- 44 keys, all new TMP objects in one frame --
                    // hard-crashed the game inside the Update hook.
                    // Pre-rasterise all printable ASCII once, up front.
                    let warmed = false;
                    try {
                        let chars = "";
                        for (let c = 32; c < 127; c++) chars += String.fromCharCode(c);
                        let add = null;
                        try {
                            add = fa.method("TryAddCharacters")
                                .overload("System.String", "System.Boolean");
                        } catch (_) { }
                        if (add) {
                            warmed = add.invoke(Il2Cpp.string(chars), false) === true;
                        } else {
                            // Never accept an unverified dynamic atlas. The old
                            // fallback marked this true even when ForceMeshUpdate
                            // threw, leaving TMP to allocate glyphs during rebuilds.
                            console.warn("[menu] TryAddCharacters(string,bool) is stripped; rejecting dynamic TMP font");
                        }
                    } catch (e) { console.warn("[menu] glyph pre-warm failed: " + e); }

                    if (warmed) {
                        console.log("[menu] TMP font built from OS font (original Segoe UI Black path), atlas pre-warmed");
                        return fa;
                    }
                    // Without pre-warming, on-demand rasterisation is what
                    // crashes. The game's own font is static with a fully
                    // populated atlas, so prefer reliability over the look.
                    // DESTROY it: a rejected asset left in the scene still
                    // shows up in FindObjectsOfTypeAll, and the fallback
                    // picker then hands the crashing font straight back.
                    try { Object.method("Destroy", 1).invoke(fa); } catch (_) { }
                    console.warn("[menu] could not pre-warm the OS font atlas; falling back to the game's static font");
                    return null;
                }
            }
            console.warn("[menu] OS font -> TMP conversion returned nothing; using the game's own font");
        } catch (e) { console.warn("[menu] Segoe TMP font creation failed: " + e); }
        return null;
    }
    function _anyTmpFontAsset() {
        const embeddedSegoe = getEmbeddedSegoeTmpFont();
        if (unityAlive(embeddedSegoe)) {
            _tmpFontCached = embeddedSegoe;
            return _tmpFontCached;
        }
        if (unityAlive(_tmpFontCached)) return _tmpFontCached;
        if (MENU_FONT_PREFER_OS) {
            const os = _makeOsTmpFont();
            if (os && !os.isNull?.()) { _tmpFontCached = os; return _tmpFontCached; }
        }
        try {
            if (!TMPFontAssetClass) return null;
            const found = Resources.method("FindObjectsOfTypeAll").overload("System.Type")
                .invoke(TMPFontAssetClass.type.object);
            if (!found || found.isNull?.() || found.length < 1) return null;

            // Grabbing index 0 gets whatever the game happened to load first,
            // which is not the font this menu was designed around. TMP ships
            // LiberationSans SDF as its default -- that is what the original
            // build rendered with -- so score the candidates and prefer it.
            const base = arrData(found);
            const entries = [];
            for (let i = 0; i < found.length; i++) {
                try {
                    const ptr = base.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
                    if (!ptr || ptr.isNull()) continue;
                    const obj = new Il2Cpp.Object(ptr);
                    let nm = "";
                    try { nm = obj.method("get_name").invoke().content || ""; } catch (_) { }
                    // Skip unnamed assets. A runtime-built dynamic font has no
                    // name, and picking one here is exactly what crashed the
                    // game: its atlas is empty and rasterises at draw time.
                    if (!nm || !nm.trim()) continue;
                    entries.push({ obj: obj, name: nm });
                } catch (_) { }
            }
            if (!entries.length) return null;
            console.log("[menu] TMP fonts loaded: " + entries.map(e => e.name).join(", "));

            const rank = (n) => {
                const s = (n || "").toLowerCase();
                if (s.indexOf("liberationsans") >= 0) return 0;   // TMP's own default
                if (s.indexOf("arial") >= 0) return 1;
                if (s.indexOf("segoe") >= 0) return 2;
                if (s.indexOf("roboto") >= 0) return 3;
                // A shipped SDF asset is static with a populated atlas, so it
                // is always safe -- rank it above anything unrecognised.
                if (s.indexOf("sdf") >= 0) return 5;
                return 9;
            };
            entries.sort((a, b) => rank(a.name) - rank(b.name));
            _tmpFontCached = entries[0].obj;
            console.log("[menu] menu font -> " + entries[0].name +
                        (rank(entries[0].name) === 9 ? "  (no standard font present; set MENU_FONT to override)" : ""));
            return _tmpFontCached;
        }
        catch (e) { console.error("[menu] TMP font fallback failed: " + e); return null; }
    }
    function renderMenuText(textRootObject, surfaceObject, text = "", color = [1, 1, 1, 1], pos = zeroVector, size = oneVector) {
        if (lowercaseMods && text) text = text.toLowerCase();
        if (!TextMesh && !TextMeshPro3D) {
            if (!menuFontWarned) {
                menuFontWarned = true;
                console.error("[menu] No TextMesh/TextMeshPro class on this build; skipping menu text");
            }
            return;
        }
        ARC.step("text: \"" + String(text).slice(0, 24) + "\"");
        const textObj = createEmptyObject("MenuText", getTransform(textRootObject));
        const widthFactor = Math.max(size?.[0] ?? 1.0, 0.2);
        const heightFactor = Math.max((size?.[1] ?? 0.1) / 0.1, 0.6);
        const textLen = Math.max((text ?? "").trim().length, 1);
        const isButtonLabel = widthFactor <= 0.9;
        const lengthFactor = isButtonLabel
            ? Math.max(0.55, Math.min(1.0, 10.5 / textLen))
            : Math.max(0.55, Math.min(1.0, 20.0 / textLen));
        const finalScale = (isButtonLabel ? 0.028 : 0.018) * heightFactor * lengthFactor;
        // This build strips UnityEngine.TextMesh.set_font. Prefer the game's bundled TMP
        // font whenever TMP is available; it does not require runtime OS-font conversion.
        let _probeTitle = null;
        const useLegacyMenuText = _canUseLegacyMenuText();
        const legacyMenuFont = useLegacyMenuText ? getMenuSegoeFont() : null;
        if (!useLegacyMenuText && !TextMeshPro3D) {
            if (!menuFontWarned) {
                menuFontWarned = true;
                console.error("[menu] neither usable TextMesh nor TMP is available; skipping menu text");
            }
            try { Destroy(textObj); } catch (_) { }
            return;
        }
        if (!useLegacyMenuText && TextMeshPro3D) {
            const title = addComponent(textObj, TextMeshPro3D);
            _probeTitle = title;
            // "<" and ">" are tag delimiters to TMP's parser; turn rich text
            // off so single-character nav labels render literally.
            try { title.method("set_richText", 1).invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
            let tmpFont = getEmbeddedSegoeTmpFont();
            if (!tmpFont || tmpFont.isNull?.()) tmpFont = gettmpfontnocrash();
            if (!tmpFont || tmpFont.isNull?.()) tmpFont = _anyTmpFontAsset();
            if ((!tmpFont || tmpFont.isNull?.()) && !renderMenuText._fontWarned) {
                renderMenuText._fontWarned = true;
                console.error("[menu] no TMP font asset found - menu text will be invisible");
            }
            if (tmpFont && !tmpFont.isNull()) {
                try {
                    title.method("set_font").invoke(tmpFont);
                }
                catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("set_font", "set_font failed: " + e); }
                if (_isEmbeddedSegoeTmpFont(tmpFont)) {
                    try {
                        const materialField = _tmpBoundField(tmpFont, "material");
                        const segMat = materialField ? materialField.value : null;
                        if (!unityAlive(segMat)) throw new Error("embedded Segoe material was null");

                        let actualMat = null;
                        try { actualMat = _tmpBoundField(title, "m_sharedMaterial")?.value || null; } catch (_) { }
                        if (!unityAlive(actualMat) || normalizeSceneObjectHandle(actualMat) !== normalizeSceneObjectHandle(segMat)) {
                            let rebound = false;
                            try {
                                title.method("set_fontSharedMaterial", 1).invoke(segMat);
                                rebound = true;
                            } catch (_) { }
                            if (!rebound) {
                                // Prefer TMP's own protected reload routine. A
                                // direct field/Renderer write is the final
                                // fallback for heavily stripped builds only.
                                try {
                                    title.method("LoadFontAsset", 0).invoke();
                                    rebound = true;
                                } catch (_) { }
                            }
                            if (!rebound) {
                                const sharedField = _tmpBoundField(title, "m_sharedMaterial");
                                if (!sharedField) throw new Error("TMP m_sharedMaterial field unavailable");
                                sharedField.value = segMat;
                                const segRenderer = getComponent(textObj, Renderer);
                                if (unityAlive(segRenderer))
                                    segRenderer.method("set_sharedMaterial", 1).invoke(segMat);
                            }
                        }

                        if (!renderMenuText._segoeBindingLogged) {
                            renderMenuText._segoeBindingLogged = true;
                            let actualFont = null, actualMat = null, atlas = null;
                            try { actualFont = _tmpBoundField(title, "m_fontAsset")?.value || null; } catch (_) { }
                            try { actualMat = _tmpBoundField(title, "m_sharedMaterial")?.value || null; } catch (_) { }
                            try { atlas = segMat.method("get_mainTexture").invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                            const objName = (obj) => {
                                try { return unityAlive(obj) ? (obj.method("get_name").invoke().content || "<unnamed>") : "<null>"; }
                                catch (_) { return "<unreadable>"; }
                            };
                            const exactMaterial = unityAlive(actualMat) &&
                                normalizeSceneObjectHandle(actualMat) === normalizeSceneObjectHandle(segMat);
                            console.log("[menu] Segoe binding " + (exactMaterial ? "verified" : "MISMATCH") +
                                ": font=" + objName(actualFont) +
                                " material=" + objName(actualMat) +
                                " expectedMaterial=" + objName(segMat) +
                                " atlas=" + objName(atlas));
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        ARC.warnOnce("segoe-material", "Segoe TMP material verification failed: " + e);
                    }
                }
                try {
                    const textRenderer = getComponent(textObj, Renderer);
                    if (textRenderer && !textRenderer.isNull()) {
                        textRenderer.method("set_enabled").invoke(true);
                        // Do NOT pin the renderer to the font's material --
                        // TMP swaps its own material when the dynamic atlas
                        // grows, and a pinned one goes stale and draws blank.
                    }
                }
                catch (_) { }
            }
            try {
                // Use the property setter first. SetText has string, char[] and
                // StringBuilder one-argument overloads; arity-only binding can
                // silently select char[] and store an empty label.
                title.method("set_text").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(text));
            }
            catch (_) {
                try {
                    title.method("SetText", 1).overload("System.String").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(text));
                }
                catch (e2) { ARC.warnOnce("settext", "both set_text and SetText(string) failed: " + e2); }
            }
            if (_captureNextText) { _notifTMP = title; _captureNextText = false; }
            try {
                title.method("set_fontSize").invoke((isButtonLabel ? 4.5 : 3.0) * heightFactor);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try { title.method("set_fontStyle").invoke(_isEmbeddedSegoeTmpFont(tmpFont) ? 0 : 1); } catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_color").invoke(color);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_alignment").invoke(514);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_enableWordWrapping").invoke(false);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("ForceMeshUpdate", 2).invoke(true, true);
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        else {
            const font = legacyMenuFont || getarialnocrash2();
            if (!font || font.isNull()) {
                if (!menuFontWarned) {
                    menuFontWarned = true;
                    console.error("[menu] Builtin font load failed; skipping menu text to avoid freeze");
                }
                return;
            }
            const title = addComponent(textObj, TextMesh);
            try { title.method("set_font").invoke(font); } catch (_) { }
            try { title.method("set_richText").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
            try { title.method("set_text").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(text)); } catch (_) { }
            try { title.method("set_fontStyle").invoke(_isEmbeddedSegoeFont(font) ? 0 : 1); } catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_fontSize").invoke(isButtonLabel ? 120 : 100);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_characterSize").invoke((isButtonLabel ? 0.03 : 0.022) * heightFactor);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_anchor").invoke(4);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_alignment").invoke(1);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                title.method("set_color").invoke(color);
            }
            catch (_) { }
            try {
                const textRenderer = getComponent(textObj, Renderer);
                if (textRenderer && !textRenderer.isNull()) {
                    textRenderer.method("set_enabled").invoke(true);
                    try {
                        textRenderer.method("set_sharedMaterial").invoke(font.method("get_material").invoke());
                    }
                    catch (_) {
                        try {
                            textRenderer.method("set_material").invoke(font.method("get_material").invoke());
                        }
                        catch (_) { }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        const textTransform = getTransform(textObj);
        try {
            // Convert a fixed 4 mm world-space face gap to the surface's local
            // X axis. A raw +0.035 local offset shrank to ~1.4 mm on buttons
            // and let glyphs z-fight with their backing panels.
            const surfaceTransform = getTransform(surfaceObject);
            let faceScale = 1.0;
            try { faceScale = Math.abs(surfaceTransform.method("get_lossyScale").invoke().field("x").value) || 1.0; } catch (_) { }
            const anchorPos = [(pos?.[0] ?? 0) + (0.004 / faceScale), pos?.[1] ?? 0, pos?.[2] ?? 0];
            const worldAnchor = surfaceTransform.method("TransformPoint", 1).invoke(anchorPos);
            textTransform.method("set_position").invoke(worldAnchor);
        }
        catch (_) {
            textTransform.method("set_localPosition").invoke(pos);
        }
        try {
            const surfaceRotation = getTransform(surfaceObject).method("get_rotation").invoke();
            const faceRotation = Quaternion.method("op_Multiply").invoke(surfaceRotation, Quaternion.method("Euler").invoke(0.0, 90.0, 90.0));
            textTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(faceRotation);
        }
        catch (_) {
            textTransform.method("set_localRotation").invoke(Quaternion.method("Euler").invoke(0.0, 90.0, 90.0));
        }
        setMenuTextScale(textTransform, menu, finalScale);
        // One sample per interesting label: blanks vs working, side by side.
        try {
            const _k = String(text);
            if (_probeTitle && ["<", ">", "X", "Q", "Back", "Settings", "Themes", "Exit movement mods"].indexOf(_k) >= 0
                && !ARC._seen.has("txt:" + _k)) {
                ARC._seen.add("txt:" + _k);
                let cc = "?", fs = "?", en = "?", ls = "?", wp = "?";
                // characterCount is not populated until mesh generation runs, so
                // reading it straight after set_text always reports 0 whether the
                // font works or not. Force the update first or the number is noise.
                // Report ForceMeshUpdate failures instead of silently treating them
                // as a successful mesh that happened to contain no glyphs.
                let fmu = "ok";
                try { _probeTitle.method("ForceMeshUpdate", 2).invoke(true, true); }
                catch (e) { fmu = "THREW(" + e + ")"; }
                try { cc = _probeTitle.method("get_textInfo").invoke().field("characterCount").value; }
                catch (e) { cc = "ERR(" + e + ")"; }
                // Renderer.enabled remains true on an inactive GameObject, so also
                // measure the object and TMP component state directly.
                let act = "?", tmpEn = "?", verts = "?", fnt = "?";
                try { act = textObj.method("get_activeInHierarchy").invoke(); }
                catch (e) { act = "ERR(" + e + ")"; }
                try { tmpEn = _probeTitle.method("get_enabled").invoke(); }
                catch (e) { tmpEn = "ERR(" + e + ")"; }
                try { verts = _probeTitle.method("get_mesh").invoke().method("get_vertexCount").invoke(); }
                catch (e) { verts = "ERR(" + e + ")"; }
                try { const _f = _probeTitle.method("get_font").invoke(); fnt = (_f && !_f.isNull?.()) ? "set" : "NULL"; }
                catch (e) { fnt = "ERR(" + e + ")"; }
                // Read the string back from the component so a wrong setter overload
                // cannot masquerade as a font or renderer failure.
                let stored = "?";
                try {
                    const _s = _probeTitle.method("get_text").invoke();
                    stored = (_s && _s.content != null) ? JSON.stringify(_s.content) : String(_s);
                }
                catch (e) { stored = "ERR:" + e; }
                try { fs = _probeTitle.method("get_fontSize").invoke().toFixed(2); } catch (_) { }
                try {
                    const r = getComponent(textObj, Renderer);
                    en = (r && !r.isNull?.()) ? r.method("get_enabled").invoke() : "NO-RENDERER";
                } catch (_) { }
                try {
                    const s = textTransform.method("get_localScale").invoke();
                    ls = "(" + ["x", "y", "z"].map(a => s.field(a).value.toFixed(3)).join(",") + ")";
                } catch (_) { }
                try {
                    const p = textTransform.method("get_position").invoke();
                    // 4dp: the glyph-vs-panel gap is millimetre scale, and 2dp
                    // rounds it away entirely.
                    wp = "(" + ["x", "y", "z"].map(a => p.field(a).value.toFixed(4)).join(",") + ")";
                } catch (_) { }
                console.log("[txt] " + JSON.stringify(_k) + "  stored=" + stored + "  chars=" + cc +
                            "  active=" + act + "  tmpEnabled=" + tmpEn + "  font=" + fnt +
                            "  verts=" + verts + "  forceMesh=" + fmu +
                            "  fontSize=" + fs +
                            "  renderer=" + en + "  localScale=" + ls + "  worldPos=" + wp +
                            "  base=" + finalScale.toFixed(4));
            }
        } catch (e) { ARC.err("text probe", e); }
    }
    function templateUnityFrame() {
        try { return Time.method("get_frameCount").invoke(); }
        catch (_) { return frameCount; }
    }
    function retireTemplateMenuMaterials(materials, delayFrames = 4) {
        const frame = templateUnityFrame();
        const queuedMaterials = [];
        for (const material of (materials || [])) {
            // These are materials allocated and owned by this menu build. Queue
            // each wrapper exactly once while it is known-good; never probe a
            // wrapper again after issuing UnityEngine.Object.Destroy on it.
            try { if (material && !material.isNull?.()) queuedMaterials.push(material); } catch (_) { }
        }
        if (!queuedMaterials.length) return;
        templateMenuRetiredMaterials.push({
            materials: queuedMaterials,
            cursor: 0,
            releaseAfter: frame + Math.max(4, delayFrames | 0)
        });
        console.log("[menu] teardown queued " + queuedMaterials.length +
            " materials; batches=" + templateMenuRetiredMaterials.length);
    }
    function flushTemplateMenuRetiredMaterials() {
        if (!templateMenuRetiredMaterials.length) return;
        const frame = templateUnityFrame();
        const keep = [];
        // Spread releases across frames. This prevents a page change from
        // producing a large JNI/Object.Destroy burst on UnityMain.
        let destroyBudget = 4;
        for (const batch of templateMenuRetiredMaterials) {
            if (frame < batch.releaseAfter || destroyBudget <= 0) {
                keep.push(batch);
                continue;
            }
            while (batch.cursor < batch.materials.length && destroyBudget > 0) {
                const material = batch.materials[batch.cursor++];
                destroyBudget--;
                try {
                    if (material && !material.isNull?.())
                        Object.method("Destroy", 1).invoke(material);
                } catch (e) {
                    // Drop the wrapper even on failure. Reusing it after a
                    // Destroy attempt is less safe than leaking one material.
                    ARC.warnOnce("menu-material-destroy", "menu material destroy failed once: " + e);
                }
            }
            if (batch.cursor < batch.materials.length) keep.push(batch);
        }
        templateMenuRetiredMaterials = keep;
    }
    function destroyTemplateMenu() {
        ARC.step("teardown: retire menu");
        const oldMenu = menu;
        const ownedMaterials = templateMenuOwnedMaterials;
        menu = null;
        templateMenuOwnedMaterials = [];

        // Actual content rebuilds retire the hierarchy once, from this deferred
        // update tick. Never retain/re-probe/re-Destroy its stale wrapper.
        try {
            if (unityAlive(oldMenu)) {
                try { oldMenu.method("SetActive").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
                Object.method("Destroy", 1).invoke(oldMenu);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            ARC.warnOnce("menu-root-destroy", "menu root destroy failed once: " + e);
        }
        // Four frames gives Unity ample time to process the hierarchy before
        // its renderer materials are released, four at a time.
        retireTemplateMenuMaterials(ownedMaterials, 4);
    }
    function reloadMenu() {
        // Trigger callbacks only request a rebuild; tickTemplateMenu owns all
        // destruction after Unity finishes the current traversal.
        templateMenuRebuildRequested = true;
        menuSnapNextFrame = true;
        captureTemplateMenuInput(0.35);
    }
    let gunLocked = false;
    let lockTarget = null;
    let lockOnEnabled = false, _lockRescanAt = 0;
    let infHealthEnabled = false, infDamageEnabled = false, maxFireEnabled = false, fullAutoEnabled = false, unlockAllEnabled = false, infRangeEnabled = false;
    let _killSpawner = null;
    let _heldGun = null, _heldGunAt = 0, _ammoNext = 0, _fastNext = 0, _rangeNext = 0;
    let _vrMe = null, invisOn = false, washerOn = false, ghostOn = false, upsideOn = false, antiDestroyOn = false, _antiDestroyHooked = false, _ghostFrozen = false, _ghostSnap = null, _ghostMarker = null, _prevA = false, _washAng = 0;
    let _unlockNext = 0;
    let GunPointer = null;
    let GunLine = null;
    let _gunRenderedThisFrame = false;
    // Extraction combat patches. Each installs once, cold path only (no per-frame heap walks).
    let _healthHookOn = false, _damageHookOn = false, _unlockHookOn = false, _fullAutoHookOn = false;
    let _hpNoopCb = null, _hpReplaced = [];
    // Fully skip the player damage + blood-vfx methods while on (revert on off) so there is no
    // health loss and no "lost health" splat / sound at all.
    function installHealthHook() {
        try {
            const EC = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("Extraction.ExtractionComponent");
            if (!EC) return false;
            if (!_hpNoopCb) _hpNoopCb = new NativeCallback(function () { }, "void", ["pointer", "pointer", "pointer", "pointer", "pointer"]);
            _hpDisable();
            for (const spec of [["TakeDamage", 1], ["Hit", 2], ["PlayDamageVfxRPC", 2]]) {
                try { const m = EC.method(spec[0], spec[1]); if (m) { Interceptor.replace(m.virtualAddress, _hpNoopCb); _hpReplaced.push(m.virtualAddress); } } catch (_) { }
            }
            return _hpReplaced.length > 0;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("hpHook", "health hook: " + e); return false; }
    }
    function _hpDisable() { for (const a of _hpReplaced) { try { Interceptor.revert(a); } catch (_) { } } _hpReplaced = []; }
    function installDamageHook() {
        if (_damageHookOn) return true;
        try {
            const ZH = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("Extraction.GamemodeExtraction_ZombieHealth");
            if (!ZH) return false;
            const BIG = 999999;
            const bigDmg = { onEnter(a) { if (infDamageEnabled) { try { a[1] = ptr(BIG); } catch (_) { } } } };
            try { const m = ZH.method("Hit", 2); if (m) Interceptor.attach(m.virtualAddress, bigDmg); } catch (_) { }
            try { const m = ZH.method("Hit", 3); if (m) Interceptor.attach(m.virtualAddress, bigDmg); } catch (_) { }
            try { const m = ZH.method("TakeDamageRPC", 2); if (m) Interceptor.attach(m.virtualAddress, bigDmg); } catch (_) { }
            _damageHookOn = true; return true;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("dmgHook", "damage hook: " + e); return false; }
    }
    function unlockManager() {
        // 1380 had a separate static-self "inventory owner" class (`DNFFFAHMJPL`)
        // that held a HashSet<CosmeticSO> of owned items. 1384 refactored that
        // out: UpgradeManager now owns loadout structs (PIPLFHBIPEB /
        // HINBKPIGHEM), not a flat owned-set. We try the old class first for
        // older builds, then fall back to UpgradeManager so applyUnlockOwned's
        // `_isOwned = true` + event-fire path still runs. The HashSet.Add step
        // becomes a no-op on 1384 (caught by the try/catch there), which is
        // fine because the loadout selector reads `_isOwned` directly.
        try {
            const cls = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("DNFFFAHMJPL");
            if (cls) { const s = _staticSelfInstance(cls); if (s) return s; }
        } catch (_) { }
        try {
            const um = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("UpgradeManager");
            if (um) return _staticSelfInstance(um);
        } catch (_) { }
        return null;
    }
    function collectUpgradeItems() {
        const out = [];
        try {
            const UM = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("UpgradeManager");
            if (!UM) return out;
            let mgr = null; try { mgr = UM.field("BHHDPBKCEFH").value; } catch (_) { }
            if (!mgr || (mgr.isNull && mgr.isNull())) { try { mgr = _staticSelfInstance(UM); } catch (_) { } }
            if (!mgr || (mgr.isNull && mgr.isNull())) return out;
            // All seven upgrade-catalog List<T> fields on UpgradeManager (build 1386):
            //   ALPMLCEJMGD = List<WeaponUnlockUpgrade>       (guns)
            //   HNPOAMHCIBB = List<WeaponStatUpgrade>
            //   HAGMMBKCIMD = List<WeaponSpecialUpgrade>
            //   NIGNNPEGJON = List<InfectedUpgrade>
            //   FIBKBAIJMAI = List<LMSUpgrade>
            //   CMIAPANNDPO = List<ClassSO>                   (classes)
            //   PBAGPALAHHH = List<ExtractionClassUpgrade>    (extraction roles)
            // Older revisions of this fn only hit 2 of these which left most items locked.
            const listFields = ["ALPMLCEJMGD", "HNPOAMHCIBB", "HAGMMBKCIMD", "NIGNNPEGJON", "FIBKBAIJMAI", "CMIAPANNDPO", "PBAGPALAHHH"];
            for (let f = 0; f < listFields.length; f++) {
                try {
                    const list = mgr.field(listFields[f]).value;
                    if (!list || (list.isNull && list.isNull())) continue;
                    const backing = list.field("_items").value;
                    const sz = list.field("_size").value;
                    for (let i = 0; i < sz; i++) { const it = arrObj(backing, i); if (it) out.push(it); }
                } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        return out;
    }

    function installAntiDestroy() {
        if (_antiDestroyHooked) return true;
        try {
            const PN = PUN(); if (!PN) return false;
            const m = PN.method("RemoveInstantiatedGO", 2); if (!m) return false;
            Interceptor.attach(m.virtualAddress, { onEnter(a) { if (antiDestroyOn) { try { a[0] = ptr(0); } catch (_) { } } } });
            _antiDestroyHooked = true; return true;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("antidestroy", "anti destroy: " + e); return false; }
    }
    // Force the _isOwned field true on every catalog upgrade (guns, extraction roles, classes).
    // The loadout selector reads this field, so hooking the getter alone was not enough.
    // Grant ownership the way cosmetics.js does: force _isOwned on each item AND add to the
    // inventory manager's owned HashSet, then fire the owned-changed event to refresh UI.
    function applyUnlockOwned() {
        // Upgrades (guns/roles/classes/...) live on UpgradeManager's seven lists.
        const items = collectUpgradeItems();
        if (items.length === 0) return 0;
        // The owned HashSet<CloudGameItemSO> and its change event live on DNFFFAHMJPL
        // (inventory manager), NOT on UpgradeManager. Earlier code read the HashSet off
        // whatever unlockManager() returned - that was UpgradeManager on recent builds, so
        // soSet came back null, the early-return fired, and even _isOwned never got set.
        let soSet = null, evt = null;
        try {
            const invCls = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("DNFFFAHMJPL");
            if (invCls) {
                const inv = _staticSelfInstance(invCls);
                if (inv) {
                    try { soSet = inv.field("BAJEFGFAKNJ").value; } catch (_) { }
                    try { evt = inv.field("PONAJIKDNDL").value; } catch (_) { }
                }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        const soLive = soSet && !(soSet.isNull && soSet.isNull());
        let n = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
            const it = items[i];
            try { it.field("_isOwned").value = true; n++; } catch (_) { }
            if (soLive) { try { soSet.method("Add", 1).invoke(it); } catch (_) { } }
        }
        if (soLive && evt && !(evt.isNull && evt.isNull())) {
            try { evt.method("Invoke", 1).invoke(soSet); } catch (_) { }
        }
        return n;
    }
    function installFullAutoHook() {
        if (_fullAutoHookOn) return true;
        try {
            const GunCls = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("Gun");
            if (!GunCls) return false;
            const setAuto = { onEnter(a) { this.self = a[0]; }, onLeave() { if (fullAutoEnabled && this.self && !this.self.isNull()) { try { new Il2Cpp.Object(this.self).field("isAutomatic").value = true; } catch (_) { } } } };
            try { const m = GunCls.method("OnEnable", 0); if (m) Interceptor.attach(m.virtualAddress, setAuto); } catch (_) { }
            _fullAutoHookOn = true; return true;
        } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("faHook", "full auto hook: " + e); return false; }
    }
    function patchAllGuns() {
        try {
            const GunCls = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("Gun");
            if (!GunCls) return 0;
            const guns = Il2Cpp.gc.choose(GunCls);
            for (let i = 0; i < guns.length; i++) { try { guns[i].field("isAutomatic").value = true; } catch (_) { } }
            return guns.length;
        } catch (_) { return 0; }
    }
    // One-time: rewrite gun stat tables so the real fire path is fast / huge-mag /
    // no-reload / huge-range. ApplyStats re-reads these per shot via the held gun.
    function patchGunLevels(fast, mag, rng) {
        try {
            const GC = AssemblyCSharp.tryClass("GunConfig");
            if (!GC) return;
            const cfgs = Il2Cpp.gc.choose(GC);
            for (let i = 0; i < cfgs.length; i++) {
                const c = cfgs[i];
                function setList(nm, val) { try { const l = c.field(nm).value; if (!l || (l.isNull && l.isNull())) return; const z = l.field("_size").value; for (let k = 0; k < z; k++) l.method("set_Item", 2).invoke(k, val); } catch (_) { } }
                if (fast) setList("fireRateLevels", 0.01);
                if (mag) { setList("magazineLevels", 999999999); setList("reloadLevels", 0.0); }
                if (rng) {
                    // rangeLevels is List<Vector2>: x = range bonus, y = range increments bonus.
                    // Vector2 is 8 bytes (float x, float y) stored inline in _items. Direct
                    // memory write beats set_Item because the bridge's value-type boxing path
                    // is a crash risk here (set_Item on List<Vector2> wants a Vector2 ref).
                    try {
                        const l = c.field("rangeLevels").value;
                        if (l && !(l.isNull && l.isNull())) {
                            const backing = l.field("_items").value;
                            const z = l.field("_size").value;
                            const base = arrData(backing);
                            for (let k = 0; k < z; k++) {
                                try {
                                    const addr = base.add(k * 8);
                                    addr.writeFloat(9999.0);
                                    addr.add(4).writeFloat(0.0);
                                } catch (_) { }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (_) { }
                }
            }
        } catch (_) { }
    }

    function isColliderInvisible(collider) {
        try {
            if (!collider || collider.isNull?.())
                return false;
            const gameObject = collider.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
            if (!gameObject || gameObject.isNull?.())
                return false;
            // Never skip trigger colliders - these are player/hitbox colliders
            try {
                const isTrigger = collider.method("get_isTrigger").invoke();
                if (isTrigger)
                    return false;
            }
            catch (_) { }
            // Never skip common player/world layers
            try {
                const layer = gameObject.method("get_layer").invoke();
                if (layer === 0 || layer === 9 || layer === 10 || layer === 11)
                    return false;
            }
            catch (_) { }
            // Check for renderer anywhere in hierarchy via GetComponentInParent
            try {
                let r = null;
                try { r = gameObject.method("GetComponentInParent", 0).inflate(Renderer).invoke(); }
                catch (_) {
                    // No (System.Type) overload of GetComponentInParent on this
                    // build, and the generic form AVs -- walk the parents.
                    let node = gameObject;
                    for (let hop = 0; hop < 12 && node && !node.isNull?.(); hop++) {
                        const hit = getComponent(node, Renderer);
                        if (hit && !hit.isNull?.()) { r = hit; break; }
                        try {
                            const pt = getTransform(node).method("get_parent").invoke();
                            node = (pt && !pt.isNull?.()) ? pt.method("get_gameObject").invoke() : null;
                        } catch (_) { node = null; }
                    }
                }
                if (r && !r.isNull?.()) {
                    const enabled = r.method("get_enabled").invoke();
                    if (enabled)
                        return false;
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
            // Direct renderer on this object
            try {
                const renderer = getComponent(gameObject, Renderer);
                if (renderer && !renderer.isNull?.()) {
                    const isEnabled = renderer.method("get_enabled").invoke();
                    return !isEnabled;
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
            return true;
        }
        catch (_) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    function updateLockTarget(startPos, aimDir) {
        // Keep a live lock; re-scan only a few times a second (gc.choose is heavy).
        if (lockTarget && isLiveObject(lockTarget) && time < _lockRescanAt) { gunLocked = true; return; }
        _lockRescanAt = time + 0.25;
        const sx = startPos.field("x").value, sy = startPos.field("y").value, sz = startPos.field("z").value;
        let ax = aimDir.field("x").value, ay = aimDir.field("y").value, az = aimDir.field("z").value;
        const al = Math.sqrt(ax*ax + ay*ay + az*az) || 1; ax/=al; ay/=al; az/=al;
        let best = null, bestScore = 0.5;   // target must be within ~60deg of aim, in front
        try {
            const bodies = Il2Cpp.gc.choose(NetPlayer);   // PhotonVRPlayerBody instances
            for (let i = 0; i < bodies.length; i++) {
                let head; try { head = bodies[i].field("Head").value; } catch (_) { continue; }
                if (!head || (head.isNull && head.isNull())) continue;
                let pos; try { pos = getTransform(head).method("get_position").invoke(); } catch (_) { continue; }
                const dx = pos.field("x").value - sx, dy = pos.field("y").value - sy, dz = pos.field("z").value - sz;
                const d = Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);
                if (d < 1.2) continue;   // skip our own body / anything right on top of us
                const dot = (dx*ax + dy*ay + dz*az) / d;   // cos(angle between aim and target)
                if (dot > bestScore) { bestScore = dot; best = head; }
            }
        } catch (_) {}
        if (best) { lockTarget = best; gunLocked = true; } else { gunLocked = false; lockTarget = null; }
    }
    function renderGun(overrideLayerMask = null) {
        let StartPosition, Direction;
        // Flatscreen: aim from the camera through the mouse cursor instead of the VR hand. VR uses the
        // hand transform below.
        if (pcModeEnabled && flatscreenActive) {
            const r = pcCameraRay();
            if (r) {
                StartPosition = r.camPos;
                Direction = Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(r.dir, 1.0); // [x,y,z] -> real Vector3
            }
        }
        if (!StartPosition) {
            if (rightHandTransform && !rightHandTransform.isNull?.()) {
                StartPosition = rightHandTransform.method("get_position").invoke();
                Direction = getGunAimDirection();
            } else {
                // No hands and no camera ray â€” nothing to aim with this frame.
                return { ray: NullObject, hitCollider: null, gunPointer: GunPointer, endPosition: zeroVector };
            }
        }
        const rayStartPosition = Vector3.method("op_Addition").invoke(StartPosition, Vector3.method("op_Multiply").invoke(Direction, 0.08));
        const layerMask = overrideLayerMask ?? -1;
        // Ensure trigger colliders (player bodies) are included in raycasts
        try {
            Physics.field("queriesHitTriggers").value = true;
        }
        catch (_) { }
        let finalRay = null, finalHitCollider = null;
        try {
            if (!physicsRaycastAllVec4) {
                physicsRaycastAllVec4 = Physics.method("RaycastAll").overload("UnityEngine.Vector3", "UnityEngine.Vector3", "System.Single", "System.Int32");
            }
            const hits = physicsRaycastAllVec4.invoke(rayStartPosition, Direction, 512.0, layerMask);
            if (hits && !hits.isNull() && hits.length > 0) {
                let bestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
                for (let i = 0; i < hits.length; i++) {
                    try {
                        const hit = arrStruct(hits, i, RaycastHitClass);
                        if (!hit || hit.isNull?.())
                            continue;
                        const hitCollider = hit.method("get_collider").invoke();
                        if (!hitCollider || hitCollider.isNull())
                            continue;
                        // Only accept visible collisions (pass through invisible ones)
                        if (isColliderInvisible(hitCollider))
                            continue;
                        const hitPoint = hit.method("get_point").invoke();
                        const distance = Vector3.method("Distance").invoke(hitPoint, StartPosition);
                        if (distance < 0.08 || distance >= bestDistance)
                            continue;
                        bestDistance = distance;
                        finalRay = hit;
                        finalHitCollider = hitCollider;
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                }
            }
        }
        catch (_) { }
        if (!finalRay) {
            try {
                if (!physicsRaycastHitBuffer) physicsRaycastHitBuffer = Memory.alloc(128);
                const hitBuf = physicsRaycastHitBuffer;
                if (!physicsRaycastOutVec4) {
                    physicsRaycastOutVec4 = Physics.method("Raycast").overload("UnityEngine.Vector3", "UnityEngine.Vector3", "UnityEngine.RaycastHit&", "System.Single");
                }
                if (!physicsRaycastOutVec5) {
                    physicsRaycastOutVec5 = Physics.method("Raycast").overload("UnityEngine.Vector3", "UnityEngine.Vector3", "UnityEngine.RaycastHit&", "System.Single", "System.Int32");
                }
                const didHit = overrideLayerMask == null
                    ? physicsRaycastOutVec4.invoke(rayStartPosition, Direction, hitBuf, 512.0)
                    : physicsRaycastOutVec5.invoke(rayStartPosition, Direction, hitBuf, 512.0, layerMask);
                if (didHit) {
                    const hitRef = new Il2Cpp.ValueType(hitBuf, RaycastHitClass.type);
                    const hitCollider = hitRef.method("get_collider").invoke();
                    // Only accept visible collisions (pass through invisible ones)
                    if (hitCollider && !hitCollider.isNull?.() && !isColliderInvisible(hitCollider)) {
                        const hitPoint = hitRef.method("get_point").invoke();
                        const distance = Vector3.method("Distance").invoke(hitPoint, StartPosition);
                        if (distance >= 0.08) {
                            finalRay = hitRef;
                            finalHitCollider = hitCollider;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        if (finalRay) {
            try {
                finalRay.method("get_point").invoke();
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        if (lockOnEnabled) { try { updateLockTarget(StartPosition, Direction); } catch (_) { gunLocked = false; lockTarget = null; } }
        else { gunLocked = false; lockTarget = null; }
        let EndPosition;
        if (gunLocked && lockTarget && isLiveObject(lockTarget)) {
            EndPosition = getTransform(lockTarget).method("get_position").invoke();
        }
        else {
            if (finalRay && !(finalRay.isNull?.() ?? false)) {
                EndPosition = finalRay.method("get_point").invoke();
            }
            else {
                const farDirection = Vector3.method("op_Multiply").invoke(Direction, 512);
                EndPosition = Vector3.method("op_Addition").invoke(StartPosition, farDirection);
            }
        }
        if (Vector3.method("op_Equality").invoke(EndPosition, zeroVector)) {
            const farDirection = Vector3.method("op_Multiply").invoke(Direction, 512);
            EndPosition = Vector3.method("op_Addition").invoke(StartPosition, farDirection);
        }
        // Sphere darkens while the gun is actually firing (trigger held) â€” visual "active" feedback in
        // both VR and PC. Every theme uses its bright themeAccent (not the dark menu bg) so the gunlib
        // relationship is consistent across ALL themes like periwinkle: bright sphere, slightly darker
        // line, EVEN darker sphere while firing.
        const _gunActive = (rightTrigger || leftTrigger);
        const _sphereColor = _gunActive ? [themeAccent[0] * 0.35, themeAccent[1] * 0.35, themeAccent[2] * 0.35, themeAccent[3]] : themeAccent;
        // Line sits a touch darker than the sphere (idle), and darker still while firing.
        const _lineBase = [themeAccent[0] * 0.72, themeAccent[1] * 0.72, themeAccent[2] * 0.72, themeAccent[3]];
        const _lineColorActive = _gunActive ? [themeAccent[0] * 0.45, themeAccent[1] * 0.45, themeAccent[2] * 0.45, themeAccent[3]] : _lineBase;
        if (GunPointer == null || GunPointer.isNull?.()) {
            GunPointer = createObject(EndPosition, identityQuaternion, [0.15, 0.15, 0.15], 0, _sphereColor);
        }
        GunPointer.method("SetActive").invoke(true);
        _gunRenderedThisFrame = true;
        const pointerTransform = getTransform(GunPointer);
        pointerTransform.method("set_position").invoke(EndPosition);
        try {
            const PointerRenderer = getComponent(GunPointer, Renderer);
            const material = PointerRenderer.method("get_material").invoke();
            if (UberShader) material.method("set_shader").invoke(UberShader);
            material.method("set_color").invoke(_sphereColor);
        } catch(_) {}
        try {
            const collider = getComponent(GunPointer, Collider);
            if (collider != null) Destroy(collider);
        } catch(_) {}
        if (GunLine == null || GunLine.isNull?.()) {
            try {
                const lineObj = createObject(StartPosition, identityQuaternion, oneVector, 0, [0, 0, 0, 0]);
                lineObj.method("set_name").invoke(Il2Cpp.string("GunLine"));
                GunLine = addComponent(lineObj, LineRenderer);
                if (GunLine && !GunLine.isNull?.()) {
                    GunLine.method("set_useWorldSpace").invoke(true);
                    GunLine.method("set_startWidth").invoke(0.025);
                    GunLine.method("set_endWidth").invoke(0.008);
                    GunLine.method("set_startColor").invoke(_lineBase);
                    GunLine.method("set_endColor").invoke(_lineBase);
                    try {
                        const lineMat = GunLine.method("get_material").invoke();
                        if (UberShader) lineMat.method("set_shader").invoke(UberShader);
                        lineMat.method("set_color").invoke(_lineBase);
                    } catch(_) {}
                }
            }
            catch (e) {
                console.error("[GUNLINE] Failed to create line renderer:", e);
            }
        }
        if (GunLine && !GunLine.isNull?.()) {
            try {
                const lineGO = GunLine.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
                if (gunLineStyle === 3) {
                    // "None" â€” sphere only, hide the line entirely.
                    try { GunLine.method("set_positionCount").invoke(0); } catch (_) { }
                    try { lineGO.method("SetActive").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
                } else {
                    lineGO.method("SetActive").invoke(true);
                    const _lineColor = _lineColorActive;
                    GunLine.method("set_startColor").invoke(_lineColor);
                    GunLine.method("set_endColor").invoke(_lineColor);
                    try { const lineMat = GunLine.method("get_material").invoke(); lineMat.method("set_color").invoke(_lineColor); } catch (_) { }
                    const sx = StartPosition.field("x").value, sy = StartPosition.field("y").value, sz = StartPosition.field("z").value;
                    const ex = EndPosition.field("x").value, ey = EndPosition.field("y").value, ez = EndPosition.field("z").value;
                    const dx = ex - sx, dy = ey - sy, dz = ez - sz;
                    const dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) || 0.0001;
                    const nx = dx / dist, ny = dy / dist, nz = dz / dist;
                    // Perpendicular basis (p, q) to the aim direction.
                    let px, py, pz;
                    if (Math.abs(ny) < 0.9) { px = -nz; py = 0; pz = nx; } else { px = 1; py = 0; pz = 0; }
                    const pLen = Math.sqrt(px * px + py * py + pz * pz) || 1;
                    px /= pLen; py /= pLen; pz /= pLen;
                    const qx = ny * pz - nz * py, qy = nz * px - nx * pz, qz = nx * py - ny * px;
                    const up = Vector3.method("get_up").invoke();
                    const setPt = (i, ox, oy, oz) => {
                        const pt = Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(up, 0);
                        pt.field("x").value = ox; pt.field("y").value = oy; pt.field("z").value = oz;
                        GunLine.method("SetPosition").invoke(i, pt);
                    };
                    const width = 0.012;
                    let numPoints;
                    if (gunLineStyle === 2) {
                        // Straight â€” just start to end.
                        numPoints = 2;
                        GunLine.method("set_positionCount").invoke(numPoints);
                        GunLine.method("set_startWidth").invoke(width);
                        GunLine.method("set_endWidth").invoke(width);
                        setPt(0, sx, sy, sz);
                        setPt(1, ex, ey, ez);
                    } else if (gunLineStyle === 1) {
                        // Lightning â€” FEW vertices so the segments are long and sharp (jagged), with a
                        // random perpendicular kick at each interior vertex.
                        numPoints = Math.min(12, Math.max(4, Math.floor(dist * 0.9)));
                        const amp = 0.06 + Math.min(0.2, dist * 0.012);
                        GunLine.method("set_positionCount").invoke(numPoints);
                        GunLine.method("set_startWidth").invoke(0.022);
                        GunLine.method("set_endWidth").invoke(0.006);
                        for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) {
                            const t = i / (numPoints - 1);
                            const bx = sx + dx * t, by = sy + dy * t, bz = sz + dz * t;
                            let jp = 0, jq = 0;
                            if (i > 0 && i < numPoints - 1) { jp = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp; jq = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * amp; }
                            setPt(i, bx + px * jp + qx * jq, by + py * jp + qy * jq, bz + pz * jp + qz * jq);
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Style 0 â€” curly spiral (default).
                        numPoints = Math.min(200, Math.max(40, Math.floor(dist * 20)));
                        const turns = Math.max(3, dist * 1.5);
                        const spiralRadius = 0.06 * Math.max(0, 1 - dist / 40);
                        GunLine.method("set_positionCount").invoke(numPoints);
                        GunLine.method("set_startWidth").invoke(width);
                        GunLine.method("set_endWidth").invoke(width);
                        for (let i = 0; i < numPoints; i++) {
                            const t = i / (numPoints - 1);
                            const angle = t * turns * Math.PI * 2;
                            const bx = sx + dx * t, by = sy + dy * t, bz = sz + dz * t;
                            const ox = bx + (Math.cos(angle) * px + Math.sin(angle) * qx) * spiralRadius;
                            const oy = by + (Math.cos(angle) * py + Math.sin(angle) * qy) * spiralRadius;
                            const oz = bz + (Math.cos(angle) * pz + Math.sin(angle) * qz) * spiralRadius;
                            setPt(i, ox, oy, oz);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (e) {
                console.error("[GUNLINE] Error updating line:", e);
            }
        }
        return { ray: finalRay ?? NullObject, hitCollider: finalHitCollider, gunPointer: GunPointer, endPosition: EndPosition };
    }
    function hideGunVisuals() {
        try {
            if (GunPointer && !GunPointer.isNull?.()) GunPointer.method("SetActive", 1).invoke(false);
        } catch (_) { }
        try {
            if (GunLine && !GunLine.isNull?.()) {
                try { GunLine.method("set_positionCount").invoke(0); } catch (_) { }
                const lineObject = GunLine.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
                if (lineObject && !lineObject.isNull?.()) lineObject.method("SetActive", 1).invoke(false);
            }
        } catch (_) { }
    }
    function offsetMenuTowardViewer(anchorPosition, distance = 0.065) {
        try {
            if (!headCollider || headCollider.isNull?.()) return anchorPosition;
            const anchor = readVec3Components(anchorPosition);
            const viewer = readVec3Components(getTransform(headCollider).method("get_position").invoke());
            const dx = viewer[0] - anchor[0];
            const dy = viewer[1] - anchor[1];
            const dz = viewer[2] - anchor[2];
            const magnitude = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
            if (!Number.isFinite(magnitude) || magnitude < 0.001) return anchorPosition;
            const amount = Math.min(Math.max(distance, 0), magnitude * 0.35);
            return [
                anchor[0] + (dx / magnitude) * amount,
                anchor[1] + (dy / magnitude) * amount,
                anchor[2] + (dz / magnitude) * amount
            ];
        } catch (_) { return anchorPosition; }
    }
    function recenterMenu() {
        const menuTransform = getTransform(menu);
        let targetPos, targetRot;
        // Flatscreen: anchor the menu in front of the camera. Its interactive face is local +X, so
        // LookRotation(cameraRight, cameraUp) makes +X point back at the camera (buttons face you) with
        // the button grid spread across screen-right (local Z) and screen-up (local Y). VR falls through
        // to the hand-follow anchor below.
        if (pcModeEnabled && flatscreenActive) {
            try {
                const cam = pcMainCamera();
                if (cam) {
                    const ct = cam.method("get_transform").invoke();
                    const cp = ct.method("get_position").invoke();
                    const cf = ct.method("get_forward").invoke();
                    const cr = ct.method("get_right").invoke();
                    const cu = ct.method("get_up").invoke();
                    targetPos = [
                        cp.field("x").value + cf.field("x").value * pcMenuDistance,
                        cp.field("y").value + cf.field("y").value * pcMenuDistance,
                        cp.field("z").value + cf.field("z").value * pcMenuDistance
                    ];
                    // The button list runs down the menu's local +Z and the face normal is local +X. To
                    // stand it upright and facing you: local +Z must map to world up (list vertical) and
                    // local +X to -cameraForward (face toward camera). LookRotation(forward=camUp,
                    // upHint=-cameraRight) yields exactly that. (The old LookRotation(camRight,camUp) put
                    // the list along camera-right, which is why it looked sideways.)
                    const negRight = Vector3.method("op_Multiply", 2).invoke(cr, -1.0);
                    targetRot = Quaternion.method("LookRotation", 2).invoke(cu, negRight);
                    if (menuSnapNextFrame) {
                        menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(targetPos);
                        menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(targetRot);
                        menuSnapNextFrame = false;
                    } else {
                        const menuPos = menuTransform.method("get_position").invoke();
                        menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(Vector3.method("Lerp").invoke(menuPos, targetPos, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 18)));
                        menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(Quaternion.method("Slerp").invoke(menuTransform.method("get_rotation").invoke(), targetRot, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 18)));
                    }
                    return;
                }
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        // When search keyboard is open, float menu in front of the player's face like Seralyth
        if (currentCategory === 20 && headCollider && !headCollider.isNull?.()) {
            try {
                const headTf = getTransform(headCollider);
                const headPos = headTf.method("get_position").invoke();
                const headFwd = headTf.method("get_forward").invoke();
                const headRot = headTf.method("get_rotation").invoke();
                // Position 0.65 units in front of head, slightly below eye level
                const tx = headPos.field("x").value + headFwd.field("x").value * 0.65;
                const ty = headPos.field("y").value - 0.08;
                const tz = headPos.field("z").value + headFwd.field("z").value * 0.65;
                const floatPos = Vector3.alloc();
                floatPos.method(".ctor").overload("System.Single", "System.Single", "System.Single").invoke(tx, ty, tz);
                // Face the player â€” yaw only so it stays upright
                const fwdX = headFwd.field("x").value;
                const fwdZ = headFwd.field("z").value;
                const yaw = Math.atan2(fwdX, fwdZ) * (180 / Math.PI);
                const facingRot = Quaternion.method("Euler").invoke(0, yaw + 180, 0);
                if (menuSnapNextFrame) {
                    menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(floatPos);
                    menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(facingRot);
                    menuSnapNextFrame = false;
                }
                else {
                    const menuPos = menuTransform.method("get_position").invoke();
                    menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(Vector3.method("Lerp").invoke(menuPos, floatPos, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 8)));
                    menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(Quaternion.method("Slerp").invoke(menuTransform.method("get_rotation").invoke(), facingRot, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 8)));
                }
                return;
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        // Default â€” follow hand
        if (righthand) {
            targetPos = offsetMenuTowardViewer(rightHandTransform.method("get_position").invoke());
            targetRot = rightHandTransform.method("get_rotation").invoke();
            targetRot = Quaternion.method("op_Multiply").invoke(targetRot, Quaternion.method("Euler").invoke(0, 0, 180));
        }
        else {
            targetPos = offsetMenuTowardViewer(leftHandTransform.method("get_position").invoke());
            targetRot = leftHandTransform.method("get_rotation").invoke();
        }
        if (menuSnapNextFrame) {
            menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(targetPos);
            menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(targetRot);
            menuSnapNextFrame = false;
        }
        else if (LerpMenu || true) {
            const menuPos = menuTransform.method("get_position").invoke();
            menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(Vector3.method("Lerp").invoke(menuPos, targetPos, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 22)));
            menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(Quaternion.method("Slerp").invoke(menuTransform.method("get_rotation").invoke(), targetRot, Math.min(1.0, deltaTime * 20)));
        }
        else {
            menuTransform.method("set_position").invoke(targetPos);
            menuTransform.method("set_rotation").invoke(targetRot);
        }
    }
    class ButtonInfo {
        constructor(config) {
            this.buttonText = config.buttonText;
            this.method = config.method;
            this.enableMethod = config.enableMethod;
            this.disableMethod = config.disableMethod;
            this.isTogglable = config.isTogglable ?? true;
            this.toolTip = config.toolTip ?? null;
            this.enabled = config.enabled ?? false;
        }
    }
    // --- Favorites system ---
    const favoritedNames = new Set();
    function getFavoriteButtons() {
        return buttons.flat().filter(b => favoritedNames.has(b.buttonText) &&
            !["PreviousPage", "NextPage", "GlobalReturn", "Search Mods", "Favorites"].includes(b.buttonText));
    }
    function rebuildFavoritesCategory() {
        buttons[21] = getFavoriteButtons();
    }

    // still needs to do is build the button map once.
    function applyMenuStructurePatches() {
        if (menuStructurePatched)
            return;
        menuStructurePatched = true;
        try {
            rebuildButtonMap();
        }
        catch (_) { }
    }

                method: () => { currentCategory = 13; currentPage = 0; },
                isTogglable: false,
                toolTip: "Opens the Soundboard. Put MP3 or WAV files in the soundboard folder."
            })
        ],
        [
            new ButtonInfo({
                buttonText: "Disconnect",
                method: () => {
                    let done = false;
                    for (const spec of [
                        ["PhotonUnityNetworking", "Photon.Pun.PhotonNetwork", "Disconnect"],
                        ["PhotonRealtime", "Photon.Realtime.LoadBalancingClient", "Disconnect"]
                    ]) {
                        try {
                            Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(spec[0]).image.class(spec[1]).method(spec[2]).invoke();
                            done = true;
                            break;
                        }
                        catch (_) { }
