    // ---- Soundboard (category 13) — ported from the working quan.ts ------
    // Drop MP3/WAV files into <arcane_menu>/soundboard, open the category and
    // press "Refresh sounds". Playback is fed into the local Photon Voice
    // Recorder (SourceType = AudioClip) so everyone in the room hears it, and
    // mirrored on a local 2D AudioSource so you hear it too.
    let soundboardFiles = [];
    let currentAudioSource = null;
    let currentRecorder = null;
    let activeWebRequest = null;
    let isSoundboardStopping = false;
    let soundboardPlaybackId = 0;
    let sbPlayTimer = null;   // playback-finished watcher (setTimeout handle)
    let sbReqTimer = null;    // UnityWebRequest poll (setTimeout handle)

    buttons[13] = [
        new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "Exit Soundboard",
            method: () => { currentCategory = 0; currentPage = 0; reloadMenu(); },
            isTogglable: false,
            toolTip: "Return to the main menu."
        }),
        new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "Refresh sounds",
            method: () => { LoadSoundboardFiles(); },
            isTogglable: false,
            toolTip: "Reload sound files from the Soundboard folder."
        }),
        new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "Stop sounds",
            method: () => { StopSoundboardAudio(); },
            isTogglable: false,
            toolTip: "Stop playback and restore microphone recording."
        })
    ];

    // List <root>/soundboard (created on first call) for .mp3/.wav files.
    function LoadSoundboardFiles() {
        let dir = "(unresolved)";
        try {
            dir = _arcaneDir("soundboard");
            const FS = ArcaneFS.getClasses();
            // Verify/create BEFORE GetFiles: a missing dir makes Directory.GetFiles
            // throw a C# DirectoryNotFoundException that surfaces as "abort was called".
            let exists = false;
            try { exists = !!FS.dir.method("Exists", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir)); }
            catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] Exists threw: " + e); }
            if (!exists) {
                try { FS.dir.method("CreateDirectory", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir)); }
                catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] CreateDirectory threw: " + e); }
                try { exists = !!FS.dir.method("Exists", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir)); } catch (_) { }
            }
            if (!exists) {
                // Fallback: the resolved root can point at another package's
                // scoped-storage dir (unwritable); rebuild from this game's own
                // persistentDataPath instead.
                try {
                    const App = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.CoreModule").image.class("UnityEngine.Application");
                    const p = App.method("get_persistentDataPath").invoke();
                    const base = (p && !p.isNull?.() ? (p.content || "") : "").replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/\/+$/, "");
                    if (base) {
                        const alt = base + "/arcane_menu/soundboard";
                        FS.dir.method("CreateDirectory", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(alt));
                        if (!!FS.dir.method("Exists", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(alt))) {
                            dir = alt;
                            exists = true;
                            console.log("[Soundboard] using persistentDataPath root: " + alt);
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] fallback root failed: " + e); }
            }
            if (!exists) {
                console.log("[Soundboard] cannot create folder: " + dir);
                sendNotification("Soundboard: cannot create " + dir, false);
                return;
            }
            let files = null;
            try { files = FS.dir.method("GetFiles", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(dir)); }
            catch (e) {
                console.log("[Soundboard] GetFiles failed for " + dir + ": " + e);
                sendNotification("Soundboard: GetFiles failed: " + e, false);
                return;
            }
            soundboardFiles = [];
            if (files && !files.isNull?.()) {
                for (let i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
                    const el = arrObj(files, i);   // bridge Array.get() is broken on this build
                    if (!el) continue;
                    let p = null;
                    try { p = new Il2Cpp.String(el.handle).content; } catch (_) { p = null; }
                    if (!p) continue;
                    const low = p.toLowerCase();
                    if (low.endsWith(".mp3") || low.endsWith(".wav")) soundboardFiles.push(p);
                }
            }
            soundboardFiles.sort();
            UpdateSoundboardCategory();
            console.log("[Soundboard] " + soundboardFiles.length + " sound(s) in " + dir);
            sendNotification("Soundboard: " + soundboardFiles.length + " sound(s) found", false);
            try { reloadMenu(); } catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] reload failed: " + e); }
        } catch (e) {
            console.log("[Soundboard] Load error @ " + dir + ": " + e);
            sendNotification("Soundboard load failed: " + e, false);
        }
    }

    // Keep the 3 fixed buttons (Exit / Refresh / Stop), rebuild the file list.
    function UpdateSoundboardCategory() {
        try {
            buttons[13].splice(3);
            for (let i = 0; i < soundboardFiles.length; i++) {
                const filePath = soundboardFiles[i];
                const fileName = filePath.substring(filePath.lastIndexOf("/") + 1);
                const newBtn = new ButtonInfo({
                    buttonText: fileName.substring(0, Math.min(fileName.length, 14)), // truncate to fit
                    method: () => { PlaySoundboardAudio(filePath); },
                    isTogglable: false,
                    toolTip: fileName
                });
                buttons[13].push(newBtn);
            }
        } catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] Category update error: " + e); }
    }

    // The Recorder lives in the Photon Voice DLL (referenced FROM Assembly-CSharp,
    // not defined there), so try the usual assembly names then scan every image.
    function _sbFindRecorderClass() {
        const full = "Photon.Voice.Unity.Recorder";
        try { const c = AssemblyCSharp.class(full); if (c) return c; } catch (_) { }
        for (const name of ["PhotonVoice", "PhotonVoice.API", "PhotonVoiceAssembly", "Photon.Voice"]) {
            try {
                const c = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(name).image.tryClass(full);
                if (c) return c;
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        try {
            for (const asm of Il2Cpp.domain.assemblies) {
                try {
                    const c = asm.image.tryClass(full);
                    if (c) return c;
                } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] assembly scan failed: " + e); }
        return null;
    }

    function StopSoundboardAudio() {
        // Stop both sides of soundboard playback: the local Unity AudioSource and
        // the Photon Voice Recorder (which can keep transmitting its AudioClip
        // even after the local AudioSource is gone).
        isSoundboardStopping = true;
        soundboardPlaybackId++; // invalidate any sound file that is still loading

        if (sbPlayTimer !== null) { try { clearTimeout(sbPlayTimer); } catch (_) { } sbPlayTimer = null; }
        if (sbReqTimer !== null) { try { clearTimeout(sbReqTimer); } catch (_) { } sbReqTimer = null; }

        try {
            if (activeWebRequest != null) {
                try { activeWebRequest.method("Abort", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                activeWebRequest = null;
            }
        } catch (_) { }

        try {
            const src = currentAudioSource;
            currentAudioSource = null;
            if (src != null && !src.isNull?.()) {
                try { src.method("Stop", 0).invoke(); } catch (_) { }
                try { Destroy(src.method("get_gameObject").invoke()); } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (_) { }

        try {
            const recorder = currentRecorder;
            currentRecorder = null;
            if (recorder != null && !recorder.isNull?.()) {
                // Disable transmission first so the old clip cannot keep being sent
                // while the recorder switches back to microphone input.
                try { recorder.method("set_TransmitEnabled", 1).invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
                try { recorder.method("set_AudioClip", 1).invoke(NULL); } catch (_) { }
                try { recorder.method("set_SourceType", 1).invoke(0); } catch (_) { }
                try { recorder.method("set_TransmitEnabled", 1).invoke(true); } catch (_) { }
            }
        } catch (_) { }

        console.log("[Soundboard] Stop requested; local audio stopped and recorder reset to microphone.");
        setTimeout(() => { isSoundboardStopping = false; }, 150);
    }

    function PlayClipOnNetwork(clip) {
        try {
            if (isSoundboardStopping) return; // Prevent play if stop was just pressed

            console.log("[Soundboard] Stopping previous audio...");
            StopSoundboardAudio(); // stop previous

            console.log("[Soundboard] Finding Recorder class...");
            const RecorderClass = _sbFindRecorderClass();

            let recorder = null;
            if (RecorderClass) {
                console.log("[Soundboard] Finding Recorder objects...");
                const recorders = Object.method("FindObjectsOfType", 0).inflate(RecorderClass).invoke();
                if (recorders != null && !recorders.isNull?.() && recorders.length > 0) {
                    // Prefer the recorder that is actually transmitting for this client;
                    // extra Recorders (walkie-talkie props etc.) can exist in the scene.
                    let fallback = null;
                    for (let i = 0; i < recorders.length; i++) {
                        const r = arrObj(recorders, i);
                        if (!r || r.isNull?.()) continue;
                        if (fallback == null) fallback = r;
                        try {
                            if (r.method("get_TransmitEnabled", 0).invoke() === true) { recorder = r; break; }
                        } catch (_) { }
                    }
                    recorder = recorder || fallback;
                    console.log("[Soundboard] Recorder found: " + (recorder != null));
                }
            }

            if (recorder != null && !recorder.isNull?.()) {
                console.log("[Soundboard] Modifying recorder properties...");
                currentRecorder = recorder; // register first so Stop can always reset it
                try {
                    recorder.method("set_SourceType", 1).invoke(1); // 1 = AudioClip
                    recorder.method("set_AudioClip", 1).invoke(clip);
                    recorder.method("set_LoopAudioClip", 1).invoke(false);
                    recorder.method("set_TransmitEnabled", 1).invoke(true);
                } catch (e) { console.log("[Soundboard] Recorder config failed: " + e); }
            } else {
                console.log("[Soundboard] No Photon Voice Recorder found on this client!");
            }

            console.log("[Soundboard] Creating local AudioSource...");
            const go = GameObject.alloc();
            go.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string("ArcaneSoundboardSource"));
            try { Object.method("DontDestroyOnLoad", 1).invoke(go); } catch (_) { }
            const AudioSourceClass = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.AudioModule").image.class("UnityEngine.AudioSource");
            const src = addComponent(go, AudioSourceClass);

            console.log("[Soundboard] Playing local clip...");
            src.method("set_clip", 1).invoke(clip);

            // Force 2D sound so you can hear it regardless of where the object spawned
            try { src.method("set_spatialBlend", 1).invoke(0.0); } catch (_) { }
            try { src.method("set_playOnAwake", 1).invoke(false); } catch (_) { }

            // 0-parameter overload of Play()
            src.method("Play", 0).invoke();
            currentAudioSource = src;

            // Watch for playback finishing (setTimeout chain — no setInterval here).
            const tick = () => {
                try {
                    if (isSoundboardStopping || currentAudioSource == null || currentAudioSource !== src) {
                        sbPlayTimer = null;
                        return;
                    }
                    if (!src.method("get_isPlaying", 0).invoke()) {
                        sbPlayTimer = null;
                        console.log("[Soundboard] Audio finished naturally.");
                        StopSoundboardAudio();
                        return;
                    }
                } catch (_) {
                    sbPlayTimer = null;
                    return;
                }
                sbPlayTimer = setTimeout(tick, 1000);
            };
            sbPlayTimer = setTimeout(tick, 1000);

            console.log("[Soundboard] Playing audio locally and over network...");
        } catch (e) {
            console.log("[Soundboard] Network play error: " + e);
        }
    }

    function PlaySoundboardAudio(filePath) {
        try {
            const thisPlaybackId = ++soundboardPlaybackId;
            console.log("[Soundboard] Loading file://" + filePath);
            const uriStr = Il2Cpp.string("file://" + filePath);

            const UnityWebRequest = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.UnityWebRequestModule").image.class("UnityEngine.Networking.UnityWebRequest");
            const request = UnityWebRequest.method("Get", 1).invoke(uriStr);

            // Keep a global handle so the request survives until it is done.
            activeWebRequest = request;

            const SystemUri = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("System").image.class("System.Uri");
            const uriObj = SystemUri.alloc();
            uriObj.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(uriStr);

            const AudioType_UNKNOWN = 0;
            const DownloadHandlerAudioClip = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.UnityWebRequestAudioModule").image.class("UnityEngine.Networking.DownloadHandlerAudioClip");
            const handler = DownloadHandlerAudioClip.alloc();
            handler.method(".ctor", 2).invoke(uriObj, AudioType_UNKNOWN);

            // Fully load into memory instead of streaming so decode/length is accurate
            try { handler.method("set_streamAudio", 1).invoke(false); } catch (_) { }

            request.method("set_downloadHandler", 1).invoke(handler);
            request.method("SendWebRequest", 0).invoke();

            let checkCount = 0;
            const tick = () => {
                if (thisPlaybackId !== soundboardPlaybackId) { sbReqTimer = null; return; }
                try {
                    checkCount++;
                    const isDone = request.method("get_isDone", 0).invoke();
                    if (isDone || checkCount > 50) { // max ~5 seconds
                        sbReqTimer = null;
                        if (isDone) {
                            const clip = handler.method("get_audioClip", 0).invoke();
                            if (clip != null && !clip.isNull?.()) {
                                PlayClipOnNetwork(clip);
                            } else {
                                console.log("[Soundboard] Failed to decode AudioClip.");
                            }
                        } else {
                            console.log("[Soundboard] Request timed out for " + filePath);
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    sbReqTimer = null;
                    console.log("[Soundboard] Poll error: " + e);
                    return;
                }
                sbReqTimer = setTimeout(tick, 100);
            };
            sbReqTimer = setTimeout(tick, 100);
        } catch (e) {
            console.log("[Soundboard] Error playing audio: " + e);
        }
    }
    let buttonMap = new Map();
    // All keyboard keys for the VR search keyboard
    const KB_ROWS = ["qwertyuiop", "asdfghjkl", "zxcvbnm"];
    function getSearchResults() {
        if (!searchQuery)
            return buttons.flat().filter(b => !["PreviousPage", "NextPage", "GlobalReturn"].includes(b.buttonText));
        const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
        return buttons.flat().filter(b => !["PreviousPage", "NextPage", "GlobalReturn"].includes(b.buttonText) &&
            b.buttonText.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    }
    function rebuildButtonMap() {
        buttonMap = new Map();
        buttons.flat().forEach(button => { buttonMap.set(button.buttonText, button); });
        // Register keyboard key buttons dynamically
        KB_ROWS.forEach(row => {
            for (const ch of row) {
                const key = "SK_" + ch;
                buttonMap.set(key, new ButtonInfo({
                    buttonText: key,
                    isTogglable: false,
                    method: () => {
                        searchQuery += (kbMode === "name" ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch);
                        if (kbMode !== "name") buttons[20] = getSearchResults();
                        currentPage = 0;
                        reloadMenu();
                        sendNotification((kbMode === "name" ? "Name: " : "Search: ") + (searchQuery || "(empty)"), false);
                    },
                    toolTip: ch
                }));
            }
        });
        // Numbers row
        for (let n = 0; n <= 9; n++) {
            const ch = String(n);
            const key = "SK_" + ch;
            buttonMap.set(key, new ButtonInfo({
                buttonText: key,
                isTogglable: false,
                method: () => {
                    searchQuery += ch;
                    buttons[20] = getSearchResults();
                    currentPage = 0;
                    reloadMenu();
                    sendNotification("Search: " + searchQuery, false);
                },
                toolTip: ch
            }));
        }
        buttonMap.set("SK_back", new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "SK_back",
            isTogglable: false,
            method: () => {
                if (searchQuery.length > 0)
                    searchQuery = searchQuery.slice(0, -1);
                buttons[20] = getSearchResults();
                currentPage = 0;
                reloadMenu();
                sendNotification("Search: " + (searchQuery || "(empty)"), false);
            },
            toolTip: "Backspace"
        }));
        buttonMap.set("SK_clear", new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "SK_clear",
            isTogglable: false,
            method: () => {
                searchQuery = "";
                buttons[20] = getSearchResults();
                currentPage = 0;
                reloadMenu();
                sendNotification("Search cleared", false);
            },
            toolTip: "Clear search"
        }));
        buttonMap.set("SK_space", new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "SK_space",
            isTogglable: false,
            method: () => {
                searchQuery += " ";
                buttons[20] = getSearchResults();
                currentPage = 0;
                reloadMenu();
                sendNotification("Search: " + searchQuery, false);
            },
            toolTip: "Space"
        }));
        buttonMap.set("SK_exit", new ButtonInfo({
            buttonText: "SK_exit",
            isTogglable: false,
            method: () => {
                if (kbMode === "name") {
                    const wanted = String(searchQuery || "").toUpperCase();
                    const ok = setNickName(wanted);
                    sendAllOutgoing();
                    console.log("[kb] apply wanted=" + JSON.stringify(wanted) +
                                " setOk=" + ok + " readback=" + JSON.stringify(getNickName()));
                    sendNotification(ok ? (wanted ? ("Name set: " + wanted) : "Name cleared (no name)")
                                        : "Could not set name on this build", false);
                    kbMode = "search";
                }
                if (kbMode === "roomcount") {
                    let num = parseInt(String(searchQuery || "").replace(/[^0-9]/g, ""), 10);
                    if (isNaN(num)) num = 0;
                    num = Math.max(1, Math.min(255, num));
                    try {
                        const pun = PUN();
                        let inRoom = true;
                        try { inRoom = !!pun.method("get_InRoom").invoke(); } catch (_) {}
                        if (!inRoom) { sendNotification("Not in a room", false); }
                        else {
                            try { pun.method("SetMasterClient").invoke(localPlayer()); } catch (_) {}
                            const room = pun.method("get_CurrentRoom").invoke();
                            if (room && !(room.isNull && room.isNull())) {
                                room.method("set_MaxPlayers").invoke(num);
                                sendNotification("Room max players set to " + num, false);
                            } else { sendNotification("No current room", false); }
                        }
                    } catch (e) { sendNotification("Set max players failed: " + e, false); }
                    kbMode = "search";
                }
                searchActive = false;
                searchQuery = "";
                currentCategory = 0;
                currentPage = 0;
                reloadMenu();
            },
            toolTip: "Exit search"
        }));
        // Register FAV_ star toggle buttons for every real mod button
        buttons.flat().forEach(btn => {
            if (["PreviousPage", "NextPage", "GlobalReturn", "Search Mods", "Favorites"].includes(btn.buttonText))
                return;
            if (btn.buttonText.startsWith("SK_") || btn.buttonText.startsWith("FAV_"))
                return;
            const favKey = "FAV_" + btn.buttonText;
            buttonMap.set(favKey, new ButtonInfo({
                buttonText: favKey,
                isTogglable: false,
                method: () => {
                    if (favoritedNames.has(btn.buttonText)) {
                        favoritedNames.delete(btn.buttonText);
                        sendNotification("Unfavorited: " + btn.buttonText, false);
                    }
                    else {
                        favoritedNames.add(btn.buttonText);
                        sendNotification("Favorited: " + btn.buttonText, false);
                    }
                    rebuildFavoritesCategory();

			new ButtonInfo({
                buttonText: "Clear All Location",
                isTogglable: true,
                enableMethod: () => {
                    const tagged = "";
                    try {
                        // Order matters: discover the Photon key FIRST (while our
                        // props still hold the current location), THEN push.
                        // 1) Read the reactive wrapper's readonly key field
                        //    (MOICFOAMBCA) off our tracker.
                        // 2) Fallback: enumerate our own CustomProperties and find
                        //    the key whose value equals our current location string.
                        // 3) Store state, then _trollLocPush writes serverside:
                        //    own SetLocation, remote trackers in Everyone mode,
                        //    and actor-targeted OpSetProperties for every player
                        //    (no ownership guard on that path — verified in the
                        //    binary). The per-frame method re-pushes and verifies
                        //    the server echo.
                        let key = null;
                        let tracker = null;
                        try {
                            const pvrCls = AssemblyCSharp.class("Photon.VR.Player.PhotonVRPlayer");
                            const me = localPlayer();
                            const pvr = pvrCls && me ? pvrCls.method("FromPlayer", 1).invoke(me) : null;
                            if (pvr && !pvr.isNull?.()) {
                                tracker = pvr.method("get_PlayerTrackerComponent").invoke();
                                if (tracker && !tracker.isNull?.()) {
                                    try {
                                        const wrap = tracker.field("DDAGDLIOEAE").value;
                                        if (wrap && !wrap.isNull?.()) {
                                            const k = wrap.field("GEHNCAALPGK").value;
                                            if (k && !k.isNull?.()) {
                                                key = k.content ?? null;
                                                if (!key) { try { key = new Il2Cpp.String(k.handle ? k.handle : k).content; } catch (_) { } }
                                            }
                                        }
                                    } catch (_) { }
                                }
                            }
                        } catch (e) { console.warn("[trollLoc] tracker/key read: " + e); }
                        // Fallback: match our current location value against our props.
                        if (!key) {
                            try {
                                let curLoc = null;
                                try { curLoc = tracker ? tracker.method("get_LocationValue").invoke() : null; } catch (_) { }
                                const cur = curLoc && !curLoc.isNull?.() ? (curLoc.content ?? null) : null;
                                const me2 = localPlayer();
                                const cp = me2.method("get_CustomProperties").invoke();
                                if (cp && !cp.isNull?.()) {
                                    let count = null;
                                    try { count = cp.field("count").value; } catch (_) { }
                                    if (count === null) { try { count = cp.field("_count").value; } catch (_) { } }
                                    let entries = null;
                                    try { entries = cp.field("entries").value; } catch (_) { try { entries = cp.field("_entries").value; } catch (_) { } }
                                    const cn = count?.valueOf ? count.valueOf() : count;
                                    if (entries && !entries.isNull?.()) {
                                        for (let i = 0; i < cn && i < 64; i++) {
                                            let e = null;
                                            try { e = entries.get(i); } catch (_) { continue; }
                                            if (!e) continue;
                                            let kk = null, vv = null;
                                            try { kk = e.field("key").value; } catch (_) { }
                                            try { vv = e.field("value").value; } catch (_) { }
                                            // Keys are typed object too — same
                                            // System.String check as the value.
                                            let ks = null;
                                            if (kk && !kk.isNull?.()) {
                                                ks = kk.content ?? null;
                                                if (typeof ks !== "string") {
                                                    try {
                                                        if (kk.class.name === "System.String") ks = new Il2Cpp.String(kk.handle).content;
                                                        else ks = null;
                                                    } catch (_) { ks = null; }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            if (typeof ks !== "string") continue;
                                            // Values are typed object — check it really is
                                            // a System.String before reading .content.
                                            let vs = null;
                                            if (vv && !vv.isNull?.()) {
                                                vs = vv.content ?? null;
                                                if (typeof vs !== "string") {
                                                    try {
                                                        const tname = vv.class.name;
                                                        if (tname === "System.String") vs = new Il2Cpp.String(vv.handle).content;
                                                        else vs = null;
                                                    } catch (_) { vs = null; }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            if (typeof vs === "string" && cur && vs === cur) { key = ks; break; }
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                            } catch (e2) { console.warn("[trollLoc] key discovery: " + e2); }
                        }
                        if (!key) key = "Location";
                        _trollLocState = {
                            key, tagged,
                            nextVerify: time + 1.5,
                            tries: 0, confirmed: -1, total: 0, pushes: 0
                        };
                        const r = _trollLocPush(_trollLocState);
                        // Event-driven: no per-frame or 4s re-push. Only re-push
                        // when a new actor joins — their fresh prop needs the
                        // tagged value forced in.
                        if (!_trollLocUnsubJoin) {
                            _trollLocUnsubJoin = _addJoinedCallback((actorNr) => {
                                try {
                                    if (!_trollLocState) return;
                                    _trollLocPush(_trollLocState);
                                    _trollLocState.tries = 0;
                                    _trollLocState.nextVerify = time + 1.5;
                                } catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("trollLoc-join", "join push: " + e); }
                            });
                        }
                        
                    } catch (e) { _trollLocState = null; }
                },
                method: () => {
                    // Serverside half is now event-driven (enable + on-join
                    // only). We still run the short verify cycle here (up to 5
                    // reads at 1.5s) to confirm the server echoed the push, and
                    // the local leaderboard rewrite below to override the game's
                    // own per-frame line refresh.
                    try {
                        const st = _trollLocState;
                        if (st) {
                            if (time >= st.nextVerify && st.tries < 5) {
                                st.nextVerify = time + 1.5;
                                st.tries++;
                                let ok = 0, tot = 0;
                                for (const p of allPlayers()) {
                                    if (!p || p.isNull?.()) continue;
                                    tot++;
                                    if (_getPlayerProp(p, st.key) === st.tagged) ok++;
                                }
                                st.confirmed = ok; st.total = tot;
                                if (ok === tot && tot > 0) {
                                    st.tries = 5;
                                    
                                } else if (st.tries >= 5) {
                                    
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        if (time >= _trollLocLogAt) { console.warn("[trollLoc] push/verify: " + e); _trollLocLogAt = time + 5; }
                    }
                    // Local half: rewrite every leaderboard line's location text to
                    // the tagged string. The game's own Update() rewrites these
                    // lines each frame from each player's tracker value, so
                    // re-asserting locally every frame is what guarantees all
                    // lines show it on our screen instantly (the serverside push
                    // above is what makes it stick for everyone else).
                    // The TMP renders hex color tags (proven by our own location).
                    try {
                        if (!_trollLocLineCls) {
                            _trollLocLineCls = _classQuiet("BigScary.GamePlayer.Leaderboard.LocationLeaderboardLineComponent");
                            if (!_trollLocLineCls) {
                                if (time >= _trollLocLogAt) { console.warn("[trollLoc] line class missing"); _trollLocLogAt = time + 5; }
                                return;
                            }
                        }
                        const found = _findAllOfType(_trollLocLineCls, "trollLocLine", true);
                        if (!found || found.isNull?.() || found.length === 0) {
                            if (time >= _trollLocLogAt) { console.warn("[trollLoc] no lines"); _trollLocLogAt = time + 5; }
                            return;
                        }
                        const tagged = "";
                        let n = 0;
                        for (let i = 0; i < found.length; i++) {
                            const line = arrObj(found, i);
                            if (!line) continue;
                            try {
                                const locTmp = line.field("locationDisplaySpot").value;
                                if (!locTmp || locTmp.isNull?.()) continue;
                                locTmp.method("set_text").invoke(Il2Cpp.string(tagged));
                                n++;
                            } catch (_) { }
                        }
                        if (n > 0 && time >= _trollLocLogAt) {
                            console.log("[trollLoc] rewrote " + n + "/" + found.length + " lines");
                            _trollLocLogAt = time + 5;
                        }
                    } catch (e) {
                        if (time >= _trollLocLogAt) { console.warn("[trollLoc] error: " + e); _trollLocLogAt = time + 5; }
                    }
                },
                disableMethod: () => {
                    if (_trollLocUnsubJoin) { try { _trollLocUnsubJoin(); } catch (_) { } _trollLocUnsubJoin = null; }
                    _trollLocState = null;
                    
                },
                toolTip: "Clears everyone's location on the leaderboard."
            }),

      if (value == null) return "";

        if (typeof value.content === "string") return value.content;

        return String(value);
      } catch (_) {
        return "";
      }
    };

      if (failureCount <= 5) {
        console.error(

          error
        );
      }
    };

        "BigScary.CloudItems.CosmeticSO"

    // ---- Reorganize mods into named categories (4-9) ----
    (function reorg() {
        function take(txt) { for (const cat of buttons) { if (!Array.isArray(cat)) continue; const i = cat.findIndex(b => b && b.buttonText === txt); if (i >= 0) return cat.splice(i, 1)[0]; } return null; }
        function move(idx, txts) { if (!Array.isArray(buttons[idx])) buttons[idx] = []; for (const t of txts) { const b = take(t); if (b) buttons[idx].push(b); } }
        function rename(oldT, newT) { for (const cat of buttons) { if (!Array.isArray(cat)) continue; const b = cat.find(x => x && x.buttonText === oldT); if (b) { b.buttonText = newT; return; } } }
        take("Full auto");
        take("Zombie Gun");
        take("Spawn all monsters gun");
        rename("Infinite damage", "One shot");
        rename("Change Room Player Count", "Change room player cap");
        move(4, ["Add 9999 scraps", "Max fire rate", "Infinite ammo", "Infinite range", "One shot", "Infinite health", "Unlock all guns and roles", "Kill all monsters"]);
        move(5, ["Destroy Gun", "Ban Gun", "Destroy all", "Open Staff", "Anti Game Close"]);
        move(6, ["Set Master", "Lock Room", "Unlock Room", "Change room player cap"]);
        move(7, ["Custom Name", "Name Spammer", "Random Color", "Give Report Me Hat"]);
        move(8, ["Rig Spam", "Rig Gun", "Toggle Gravity"]);
        const nav = (txt, idx, tip) => new ButtonInfo({ buttonText: txt, isTogglable: false, method: () => { currentCategory = idx; currentPage = 0; }, toolTip: tip });
        buttons[0].push(
            nav("Extraction Mods", 4, "Extraction gamemode mods."),
            nav("Overpowered Mods", 5, "Overpowered / spawning mods."),
            nav("Room Mods", 6, "Room control mods."),
            nav("Player Mods", 7, "Player identity mods."),
            nav("Rig Mods", 8, "Rig / avatar mods."),
            nav("Voxel Mods", 9, "Voxel gamemode mods.")
        );
    })();

    let _menuSndConvert = null;
    let _menuSndSingle = null;
    let _menuSndAudioClip = null;
    let _menuSndSrc = null;
    const _menuSndBytes = {};
    const _menuSndClips = {};

    // arr.elements.handle is garbage on this build. Il2CppArray layout is
    // { klass*, monitor*, bounds*, max_length } then payload, so data begins
    // at ptrSize*4. Verified on-device: +24 = length 44, +32 = 'RIFF'.
    function _menuSndArrData(a) { return arrData(a); }

    function _menuSndWavToFloats(u8) {
        try {
            const dv = new DataView(u8.buffer);
            if (dv.getUint32(0, false) !== 0x52494646) { console.error("[MenuSound] not RIFF"); return null; } // 'RIFF'
            let channels = 1, rate = 44100, bits = 16, dataOff = -1, dataLen = 0, fmtTag = 1;
            let off = 12;
            while (off + 8 <= u8.length) {
                const id = dv.getUint32(off, false); const sz = dv.getUint32(off + 4, true);
                if (id === 0x666d7420) { // 'fmt '
                    fmtTag = dv.getUint16(off + 8, true); channels = dv.getUint16(off + 10, true);
                    rate = dv.getUint32(off + 12, true); bits = dv.getUint16(off + 22, true);
                } else if (id === 0x64617461) { dataOff = off + 8; dataLen = sz; } // 'data'
                off += 8 + sz + (sz & 1);
            }
            if (dataOff < 0) { console.error("[MenuSound] no data chunk"); return null; }
            const out = [];
            if (fmtTag === 3 && bits === 32) { for (let i = 0; i < dataLen; i += 4) out.push(dv.getFloat32(dataOff + i, true)); }
            else if (bits === 16) { for (let i = 0; i < dataLen; i += 2) out.push(dv.getInt16(dataOff + i, true) / 32768); }
            else if (bits === 8) { for (let i = 0; i < dataLen; i++) out.push((u8[dataOff + i] - 128) / 128); }
            else if (bits === 24) { for (let i = 0; i < dataLen; i += 3) { let v = u8[dataOff + i] | (u8[dataOff + i + 1] << 8) | (u8[dataOff + i + 2] << 16); if (v & 0x800000) v |= ~0xffffff; out.push(v / 8388608); } }
            else { console.error("[MenuSound] unsupported bits=" + bits + " fmt=" + fmtTag); return null; }
            return { data: out, channels, rate };
        } catch (e) { console.error("[MenuSound] wav parse", e); return null; }
    }

    function _menuSndEmbeddedBytes(file) {
        try {
            if (_menuSndBytes[file]) return _menuSndBytes[file];
            const encoded = MENU_SND_BASE64[file];
            if (!encoded) { console.error("[MenuSound] no embedded payload for " + file); return null; }
            if (!_menuSndConvert) _menuSndConvert = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("mscorlib").image.class("System.Convert");
            const managed = _menuSndConvert.method("FromBase64String", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string(encoded));
            if (!managed || managed.isNull?.()) return null;
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(_menuSndArrData(managed).readByteArray(managed.length));
            _menuSndBytes[file] = bytes;
            return bytes;
        } catch (e) { console.error("[MenuSound] embedded decode " + file, e); return null; }
    }

    function _menuSndSource() {
        try {
            if (_menuSndSrc && !_menuSndSrc.isNull?.()) return _menuSndSrc;
            const AudioSourceClass = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.AudioModule").image.class("UnityEngine.AudioSource");
            const go = GameObject.alloc();
            go.method(".ctor", 1).invoke(Il2Cpp.string("ArcaneMenuSound"));
            try { Object.method("DontDestroyOnLoad", 1).invoke(go); } catch (_) { }
            const src = addComponent(go, AudioSourceClass);
            try { src.method("set_spatialBlend", 1).invoke(0.0); } catch (_) { }
            try { src.method("set_playOnAwake", 1).invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
            _menuSndSrc = src;
            return src;
        } catch (e) { _menuSndBroken = true; console.warn("[MenuSound] AudioSource unavailable: " + e); return null; }
    }

    function _menuSndClip(file) {
        try {
            if (_menuSndClips[file] && !_menuSndClips[file].isNull?.()) return _menuSndClips[file];
            const embeddedBytes = _menuSndEmbeddedBytes(file);
            const wav = embeddedBytes ? _menuSndWavToFloats(embeddedBytes) : null;
            if (!wav) { _menuSndBroken = true; console.warn("[MenuSound] embedded WAV unreadable on this build; sounds off"); return null; }
            if (!_menuSndAudioClip) _menuSndAudioClip = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("UnityEngine.AudioModule").image.class("UnityEngine.AudioClip");
            if (!_menuSndSingle) _menuSndSingle = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly("mscorlib").image.class("System.Single");
            const perCh = Math.floor(wav.data.length / wav.channels);
            const clip = _menuSndAudioClip.method("Create", 5).invoke(Il2Cpp.string("menu_" + file), perCh, wav.channels, wav.rate, false);
            try { clip.method("set_hideFlags", 1).invoke(61); } catch (_) { }
            const fa = Il2Cpp.array(_menuSndSingle, wav.data.length);
            const scaled = new Float32Array(wav.data.length);
            for (let i = 0; i < wav.data.length; i++) { let v = wav.data[i]; scaled[i] = v > 1 ? 1 : (v < -1 ? -1 : v); }
            _menuSndArrData(fa).writeByteArray(scaled.buffer);
            clip.method("SetData", 2).invoke(fa, 0);
            _menuSndClips[file] = clip;
            return clip;
        } catch (e) { console.error("[MenuSound] load " + file, e); return null; }
    }

    let _menuSndBroken = false;
    function playMenuSound(file) {
        if (!menuSoundsEnabled || _menuSndBroken) return;
        try {
            const src = _menuSndSource();
            const clip = _menuSndClip(file);
            if (!src || !clip) return;
            src.method("PlayOneShot", 1).invoke(clip);
        } catch (e) {
            _menuSndBroken = true;
            console.warn("[MenuSound] disabled for this session (" + e + ")");
        }
    }

    function getIndex(buttonText) {
        let button = buttonMap.get(buttonText);
        if (!button) {
            rebuildButtonMap();
            button = buttonMap.get(buttonText);
        }
        return button;
    }
    // Shared button-activation logic â€” called by the VR hand-collider hook AND the PC mouse-click path.
    function handleButtonActivate(goName) {
        ARC.step("click: " + goName);
        const _time = Time.method("get_time").invoke();
        if (_time <= buttonClickDelay) return;
        buttonClickDelay = _time + 0.35;
        captureTemplateMenuInput(0.14);
        // Handle sidebar category clicks
        if (goName.startsWith("CAT_")) {
            const catIdx = parseInt(goName.substring(4));
            if (!isNaN(catIdx)) {
                try { playMenuSound("button.wav"); } catch (_) { }
                currentCategory = catIdx;
                currentPage = 0;
                reloadMenu();
                return;
            }
        }
        const button = getIndex(goName);
        if (!button) return;
        try { playMenuSound("button.wav"); } catch (_) { }
        if (button.isTogglable) {
            button.enabled = !button.enabled;
            _toggleDirty = true; // outline refreshes via the cheap recolor pass, no full rebuild
            if (button.enabled) {
                try {
                    button.enableMethod?.();
                }
                catch (e) {
                    button.enabled = false;
                    console.error(`[Toggle Enable] ${button.buttonText}:`, e);
                }
            }
            else {
                try {
                    button.disableMethod?.();
                }
                catch (e) {
                    console.error(`[Toggle Disable] ${button.buttonText}:`, e);
                }
            }
        }
        else {
            const _pc = currentCategory, _pp = currentPage, _sq = searchQuery;
            try {
                button.method?.();
            }
            catch (e) {
                console.error(`[Button] ${button.buttonText}:`, e);
            }
            if (currentCategory !== _pc || currentPage !== _pp || searchQuery !== _sq) reloadMenu();
        }
    }
    const ButtonActivation = GorillaReportButton.method("OnTriggerEnter");
    let _buttonActivationDepth = 0;
    ButtonActivation.implementation = function (collider) {
        let rawName = "";
        try {
            const nameObj = this.method("get_name").invoke();
            rawName = String(nameObj?.content ?? nameObj?.toString?.() ?? "");
            if (rawName.length >= 2 && rawName[0] === '"' && rawName[rawName.length - 1] === '"')
                rawName = rawName.slice(1, -1);
        } catch (_) { }

        if (rawName.startsWith("@")) {
            try {
                if (collider && referenceCollider && !collider.isNull?.() && !referenceCollider.isNull?.() &&
                    collider.handle.equals(referenceCollider.handle)) {
                    handleButtonActivate(rawName.slice(1));
                }
            } catch (e) { pcLog("ButtonActivation", e); }
            return;
        }

        // Every menu button uses ComputerTerminalKey only as a trigger component; its game-owned
        // tracking fields were never initialized. If a name wrapper is temporarily unavailable,
        // recognize our parent root and never fall through to AddTrackedCollider.
        try {
            let tf = this.method("get_transform").invoke();
            for (let depth = 0; tf && !tf.isNull?.() && depth < 8; depth++) {
                const go = tf.method("get_gameObject").invoke();
                const n = String(go?.method("get_name").invoke()?.content ?? "");
                if (n === "ArcaneTemplateMenuRoot") return;
                tf = tf.method("get_parent").invoke();
            }
        } catch (_) { }
        if (_buttonActivationDepth > 0) return;
        _buttonActivationDepth++;
        try {
            ARC.warnOnce("triggerPassthrough", "[ButtonActivation] passing through to original for non-menu obj: " + rawName);
            this.method("OnTriggerEnter").invoke(collider);
        }
        catch (e) { ARC.warnOnce("triggerPassthroughErr", "[ButtonActivation] passthrough error: " + e); }
        finally { _buttonActivationDepth--; }
    };
    let _inputOutBool = null;
    let _inputOutVec2 = null;
    let _axisSourceLogged = false;
    let _axisProbeFrames = 0;
    function updateInput() {
        const leftDevice = InputDevices.method("GetDeviceAtXRNode", 1).invoke(4);
        const rightDevice = InputDevices.method("GetDeviceAtXRNode", 1).invoke(5);
        if (!_inputOutBool) _inputOutBool = Memory.alloc(1);
        if (!_inputOutVec2) _inputOutVec2 = Memory.alloc(8);
        const outBool = _inputOutBool;
        const outVec2 = _inputOutVec2;
        if (!_axisSourceLogged && _axisProbeFrames < 900) {
            _axisProbeFrames++;
            try {
                for (const probe of [["L", leftDevice], ["R", rightDevice]]) {
                    for (const usage of ["primary2DAxis", "secondary2DAxis", "thumbstick"]) {
                        try {
                            outVec2.writeFloat(0); outVec2.add(4).writeFloat(0);
                            const ok = device_TryGet(probe[1], usage, outVec2);
                            const x = outVec2.readFloat(), y = outVec2.add(4).readFloat();
                            if (ok && (Math.abs(x) > 0.15 || Math.abs(y) > 0.15)) {
                                _axisSourceLogged = true;
                                console.log("[Arcane] STICK SOURCE = " + probe[0] + "." + usage +
                                    " (" + x.toFixed(2) + ", " + y.toFixed(2) + ")");
                            }
                        } catch (_) { }
                    }
                }
            } catch (_) { }
        }
        function device_TryGet(dev, usageName, outPtr) {
            try { return dev.method("TryGetFeatureValue", 2).invoke(CommonUsages.field(usageName).value, outPtr); }
            catch (_) { return false; }
        }
        function readAxis2D(device) {
            try {
                const readUsage = (usage) => {
                    try {
                        outVec2.writeFloat(0);
                        outVec2.add(4).writeFloat(0);
                        const ok = device.method("TryGetFeatureValue", 2).invoke(usage, outVec2);
                        if (ok) {
                            return [
                                axisDeadzone(outVec2.readFloat()),
                                axisDeadzone(outVec2.add(4).readFloat())
                            ];
                        }
                    }
                    catch (_) { }
                    return [0, 0];
                };
                const candidates = [];
                try {
                    candidates.push(readUsage(CommonUsages.field("primary2DAxis").value));
                }
                catch (_) { }
                try {
                    candidates.push(readUsage(CommonUsages.field("secondary2DAxis").value));
                }
                catch (_) { }
                try {
                    candidates.push(readUsage(CommonUsages.field("thumbstick").value));
                }
                catch (_) { }
                let best = [0, 0];
                let bestMag = 0;
                for (const candidate of candidates) {
                    const mag = Math.abs(candidate[0]) + Math.abs(candidate[1]);
                    if (mag > bestMag) {
                        best = candidate;
                        bestMag = mag;
                    }
                }
                return best;
            }
            catch (_) { }
            return [0, 0];
        }
        function readBool(device, usage) {
            try {
                outBool.writeU8(0);
                const ok = device.method("TryGetFeatureValue", 2).invoke(usage, outBool);
                return !!ok && outBool.readU8() !== 0;
            } catch (_) { return false; }
        }
        leftPrimary = readBool(leftDevice, CommonUsages.field("primaryButton").value);
        leftSecondary = readBool(leftDevice, CommonUsages.field("secondaryButton").value);
        leftGrab = readBool(leftDevice, CommonUsages.field("gripButton").value);
        leftTrigger = readBool(leftDevice, CommonUsages.field("triggerButton").value);
        leftStick = readBool(leftDevice, CommonUsages.field("primary2DAxisClick").value);
        rightPrimary = readBool(rightDevice, CommonUsages.field("primaryButton").value);
        rightSecondary = readBool(rightDevice, CommonUsages.field("secondaryButton").value);
        rightTrigger = readBool(rightDevice, CommonUsages.field("triggerButton").value);
        rightGrab = readBool(rightDevice, CommonUsages.field("gripButton").value);
        rightStick = readBool(rightDevice, CommonUsages.field("primary2DAxisClick").value);
        [leftStickX, leftStickY] = readAxis2D(leftDevice);
        [rightStickX, rightStickY] = readAxis2D(rightDevice);
    }
    // ===== PC / FLATSCREEN MODE HELPERS =====
    // The game runs the NEW Input System, so read keyboard/mouse via Keyboard.current / Mouse.current.
    // Legacy UnityEngine.Input is only a fallback (it THROWS under the new system).
    // Throttled logger â€” surfaces the REAL failure instead of swallowing it, but at most once per 3s per
    // unique message so it can't spam at frame rate.
    const _pcLogged = new Map();
    function pcLog(tag, e) {
        try {
            const msg = (e && e.message) ? e.message : String(e);
            const key = tag + "|" + msg;
            const now = Date.now();
            if ((_pcLogged.get(key) || 0) + 3000 > now) return;
            _pcLogged.set(key, now);
            console.error("[PC] " + tag + ": " + msg);
        } catch (_) { /* the logger itself must never throw */ }
    }
    let ISKeyboardClass = null, ISMouseClass = null;
    function ensureInputLegacy() {
        if (InputLegacy) return InputLegacy;
        for (const asm of ["UnityEngine.InputLegacyModule", "UnityEngine.CoreModule", "UnityEngine"]) {
            try { InputLegacy = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image.class("UnityEngine.Input"); if (InputLegacy) return InputLegacy; } catch (e) { pcLog("ensureInputLegacy(" + asm + ")", e); }
        }
        return InputLegacy;
    }
    function ensureMouse() {
        if (ISMouseClass) return ISMouseClass;
        for (const asm of ["Unity.InputSystem", "UnityEngine.InputSystem"]) {
            try { ISMouseClass = Il2Cpp.domain.assembly(asm).image.class("UnityEngine.InputSystem.Mouse"); if (ISMouseClass) return ISMouseClass; } catch (e) { pcLog("ensureMouse(" + asm + ")", e); }
        }
        return ISMouseClass;
    }
    // Mouse cursor position in screen pixels, [x, y]. New Input System first, legacy fallback.
    function pcMousePos() {
        try {
            const M = ensureMouse();
            if (M) {
                const m = M.method("get_current").invoke();
                if (m && !m.isNull?.()) {
                    const posCtl = m.method("get_position").invoke();
                    if (posCtl && !posCtl.isNull?.()) {
                        const v = posCtl.method("ReadValue").invoke();
                        return [v.field("x").value, v.field("y").value];
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { pcLog("pcMousePos InputSystem", e); }
        try { const I = ensureInputLegacy(); if (I) { const mp = I.method("get_mousePosition").invoke(); return [mp.field("x").value, mp.field("y").value]; } } catch (e) { pcLog("pcMousePos legacy", e); }
        return null;
    }
    // Robust camera lookup: Camera.main only works if a camera is tagged "MainCamera", which this game
    // may not do â€” so fall back to Camera.current, then to scanning every Camera in the scene. Cached.
    let _pcCamCache = null;
    function pcMainCamera() {
        try { if (_pcCamCache && !_pcCamCache.isNull?.()) return _pcCamCache; } catch (_) { _pcCamCache = null; }
        try { const c = Camera.method("get_main").invoke(); if (c && !c.isNull?.()) { _pcCamCache = c; return c; } } catch (e) { pcLog("Camera.main", e); }
        try { const c = Camera.method("get_current").invoke(); if (c && !c.isNull?.()) { _pcCamCache = c; return c; } } catch (e) { pcLog("Camera.current", e); }
        try {
            let arr = null;
            try { arr = Object.method("FindObjectsByType").overload("System.Type", "UnityEngine.FindObjectsSortMode").invoke(Camera.type.object, 0); }
            catch (_) { arr = Object.method("FindObjectsByType", 1).inflate(Camera).invoke(0); }
            if (arr && arr.length > 0) {
                for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    try { const c = arrObj(arr, i); if (c && !c.isNull?.() && c.method("get_enabled").invoke()) { _pcCamCache = c; return c; } } catch (e) { pcLog("Camera scan[" + i + "]", e); }
                }
                _pcCamCache = arrObj(arr, 0);
                return _pcCamCache;
            }
        } catch (e) { pcLog("FindObjectsByType(Camera)", e); }
        return null;
    }
    // Ray from the camera through the mouse cursor, as plain arrays the bridge marshals into Vector3.
    function pcCameraRay() {
        try {
            const cam = pcMainCamera();
            if (!cam) return null;
            const ct = cam.method("get_transform").invoke();
            const cp = ct.method("get_position").invoke();
            const ox = cp.field("x").value, oy = cp.field("y").value, oz = cp.field("z").value;
            const mpos = pcMousePos();
            if (!mpos) return null;
            const mx = mpos[0], my = mpos[1];
            const wp = cam.method("ScreenToWorldPoint", 1).invoke([mx, my, 2.0]);
            let dx = wp.field("x").value - ox, dy = wp.field("y").value - oy, dz = wp.field("z").value - oz;
            const L = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz) || 1;
            return { origin: [ox, oy, oz], dir: [dx / L, dy / L, dz / L], camPos: cp, camTransform: ct };
        } catch (e) { pcLog("pcCameraRay", e); return null; }
    }
    // VR-only, zero-fade visibility controller. The left-controller Y button toggles
    // only after it has first been observed released, so stale XR input cannot auto-open it.
    function tickTemplateMenu() {
        flushTemplateMenuRetiredMaterials();
        _syncArcaneRoomState();
        let vrToggleEdge = false;
        if (!templateMenuVrToggleArmed) {
            if (!leftSecondary) templateMenuVrToggleArmed = true;
        } else {
            vrToggleEdge = !!(leftSecondary && !templateMenuPrevVrToggle);
        }
        templateMenuPrevVrToggle = !!leftSecondary;

        if (vrToggleEdge) {
            captureTemplateMenuInput(0.18);
            templateMenuOpen = !templateMenuOpen;
            console.log("[toggle] menu -> " + (templateMenuOpen ? "OPEN" : "CLOSED"));
            try { playMenuSound(templateMenuOpen ? "open.wav" : "close.wav"); } catch (_) { }
            menuSnapNextFrame = true;
            if (templateMenuOpen) {
                templateMenuBuildDelayTicks = 1;
                // Reuse the intact hierarchy on reopen; page/category rebuilds
                // still use the existing deferred teardown path.
                try { if (unityAlive(menu)) menu.method("SetActive").invoke(true); } catch (_) { }
                try { if (unityAlive(reference)) reference.method("SetActive").invoke(true); } catch (_) { }
            } else {
                templateMenuRebuildRequested = false;
                // Closing is a visibility change, not a rebuild. Destroying the
                // full TMP/outlined hierarchy in the XR input frame is what
                // eventually escaped Unity as Il2CppExceptionWrapper.
                try { if (unityAlive(menu)) menu.method("SetActive").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
                try { if (unityAlive(reference)) reference.method("SetActive").invoke(false); } catch (_) { }
                resetTemplateMenuVisualCache();
            }
        }

        pcMenuOpen = false;
        templateMenuInputCaptured = time < templateMenuInputCaptureUntil;
        if (templateMenuRebuildRequested) {
            templateMenuRebuildRequested = false;
            destroyTemplateMenu();
            resetTemplateMenuVisualCache();
            if (templateMenuOpen) templateMenuBuildDelayTicks = Math.max(templateMenuBuildDelayTicks, 1);
            return;
        }
        if (!templateMenuOpen) return;
        if (templateMenuBuildDelayTicks > 0) {
            templateMenuBuildDelayTicks--;
            return;
        }

        if (currentNotification && time > notifactionResetTime) {
            currentNotification = "";
            const _ps = "Page " + (currentPage + 1) + " / " + Math.max(1, Math.ceil((buttons[currentCategory] || []).length / (currentCategory === 20 ? 7 : MENU_ITEMS_PER_PAGE)));
            if (!_setNotifTextInPlace(_ps)) reloadMenu();
            return;
        }
        if (!unityAlive(menu)) {
            console.log("[TemplateMenu] building rounded menu after explicit toggle");
            try {
                renderMenu();
                console.log("[TemplateMenu] menu ready");
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("[TemplateMenu] build failed:", e);
                destroyTemplateMenu();
                templateMenuOpen = false;
                pcMenuOpen = false;
                templateMenuInputCaptured = false;
                resetTemplateMenuVisualCache();
                return;
            }
        } else {
            recenterMenu();
        }

        updateLiveMenuThemeVisuals();
        if (!unityAlive(reference)) {
            try { renderReference(); } catch (e) { console.error("[TemplateMenu] hand pointer:", e); }
        }
    }
    let LateUpdate = null;
    const updateHookCandidates = [
        { klass: PCClass, label: "PlayerController", names: ["LateUpdate", "Update"] },
        { klass: GTPlayerClass, label: "GorillaLocomotion", names: ["LateUpdate", "Update"] },
        { klass: NetPlayer, label: "NetPlayer", names: ["LateUpdate", "Update"] },
        { klass: PCClass, label: "PlayerController", names: ["FixedUpdate", "OnUpdate", "Tick", "PlayerUpdate", "LocomotionUpdate"] },
        { klass: GTPlayerClass, label: "GorillaLocomotion", names: ["FixedUpdate", "OnUpdate", "Tick", "PlayerUpdate", "LocomotionUpdate"] },
        { klass: NetPlayer, label: "NetPlayer", names: ["FixedUpdate", "OnUpdate", "Tick", "PlayerUpdate", "LocomotionUpdate"] }
    ];
    for (const candidate of updateHookCandidates) {
        for (const name of candidate.names) {
            try {
                LateUpdate = candidate.klass.method(name);
                console.log("[hook] Found update method: " + candidate.label + "." + name);
                break;
            }
            catch (_) { }
        }
        if (LateUpdate)
            break;
    }
    if (!LateUpdate) {
        console.error("[hook] No update method found anywhere, menu will not tick");
    }
    if (LateUpdate) {
        try { LateUpdate.revert(); } catch (_) { }
        try { Interceptor.flush(); } catch (_) { }
        Interceptor.attach(LateUpdate.virtualAddress, {
            onEnter: function () {
                try {
                    if (!refreshRuntimeRefs()) {
                        runtimeRefMissCount++;
                        if (runtimeRefMissCount === 1 || runtimeRefMissCount % 120 === 0) {
                            console.warn("[LateUpdate] player rig (GTPlayer) unavailable; waiting for VR rig.");
                        }
                        return;
                    }
                    runtimeRefMissCount = 0;
                    const _tickT0 = Date.now();
                    deltaTime = Time.method("get_deltaTime").invoke();
                    time = Time.method("get_time").invoke();
                    runArcaneMainThreadTasks();
                    menuAnimTime += deltaTime;
                    computeThemeColors();

                    try { updateInput(); } catch (e) { pcLog("updateInput", e); }
                    try { tickTemplateMenu(); } catch (e) { pcLog("template menu", e); }
                    try { normalizeArcaneModInput(); } catch (e) { pcLog("normalize input", e); }
                    try { _pollPlayerChanges(); } catch (e) { pcLog("player poll", e); }

                    _gunRenderedThisFrame = false;
                    frameCount++;

                    try {
                        if (!_configLoadedOnce) { _configLoadedOnce = true; if (ArcaneConfig.load(false)) console.log("[Config] appearance/settings loaded; active mods were not auto-restored"); }
                        if (_configAutoSave && time > _configSaveTimer) { _configSaveTimer = time + 5; ArcaneConfig.save(); }
                    } catch (_) { }

                    for (let categoryIndex = 0; categoryIndex < buttons.length; categoryIndex++) {
                        const categoryButtons = buttons[categoryIndex] || [];
                        for (let buttonIndex = 0; buttonIndex < categoryButtons.length; buttonIndex++) {
                            const b = categoryButtons[buttonIndex];
                            if (!b || !b.enabled || !b.method) continue;
                            try {
                                b.method();
                                b.__failCount = 0;
                                b.__nextErrorLogTime = 0;
                            }
                            catch (e) {
                                logButtonRuntimeError(b, e);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (!_gunRenderedThisFrame) hideGunVisuals();
                    prevLeftGrab = leftGrab;
                    prevRightGrab = rightGrab;
                    try { ARC.frame(Date.now() - _tickT0); } catch (_) { }
                }
                catch (e) {
                    ARC.err("LateUpdate (lastStep=" + ARC.lastStep + ")", e);
                }
            }
        });
        console.log("[hook] attached via Interceptor.attach (original runs natively after onEnter)");
    }
    try { _loadEmbeddedSegoeBundle(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[Arcane] font preload: " + e); }
    console.log(["[Arcane] Big Scary menu loaded (" + TARGET.gameAssembly + ")"].join("\n"));
});
